# Blockborough
Controls: tap a palette tool (Road / Homes / Shops / Plant / Park / Raze), then tap or drag on the 16x22 grid to build. Desktop: 1-6 pick a tool, arrows/WASD move the cursor, Space or Enter builds, P pauses, F changes speed, N starts a new city.
Loop: every ~6s month, taxes come in and upkeep goes out. Homes grow through 3 density tiers when they have road access, power (a plant linked by road) and a shop within 5 tiles; parks raise desirability, plants lower it nearby, and overloaded roads (red, jammed traffic dots) slow growth.
Warnings: red dot = no road, yellow = no power, blue = no shop. If funds run out, building is blocked until taxes recover.
Goals: 500 / 2000 / 5000 residents, each with a celebration; sandbox continues afterwards. City autosaves to localStorage, best population is kept, NEW CITY reseeds the terrain (water and hills are unbuildable).

# Stomp Circuit

Controls: touch LEFT / RIGHT throttle buttons drive both directions, BOOST button spends charge for a thrust; on desktop use arrows or A/D plus space (Enter/R restarts on the score screen).
Loop: a 90-second freestyle run in a procedurally seeded side-view arena of ramps, dirt mounds, car stacks and a bus jump.
Scoring: crush and flatten cars, bank airtime, backflips/frontflips (hold a throttle in the air to lean) and nose wheelies; each trick raises the combo multiplier, which decays after 5 idle seconds.
Fail state: landing on the roof or beaching the truck kills the combo and burns 3 seconds of recovery flip; the timer running out shows the score screen with the persistent localStorage best, RETRY THIS ARENA, and NEXT ARENA to reseed.

# Lunker Lake
Touch: hold anywhere to see the cast arc, flick UP to cast. Drag to work the lure (fast drag = FAST TWITCH, slow drag = SLOW DRAG; tap = single twitch). On STRIKE! tap to set the hook, then HOLD to reel and RELEASE to give line.
Keyboard: hold Space/Enter to charge the cast (Up/Down or W/S aim), release to cast; tap Space to twitch, hold Space to slow-drag; Space sets the hook; hold Space to reel. L = trophy log, N = next lake, M = mute.
Loop: 8 species live in shallow/mid/deep bands and each prefers a lure action — match depth + action to draw a strike. Tension pegged red snaps the line; too much slack lets the fish off. Landed weight adds to the session score (best score + per-species best weights in localStorage).
Lake is seeded from the calendar day; NEXT LAKE re-stocks a fresh seeded lake and restarts the session.

  window.onerror = function(msg, src, line) {
    var c = document.getElementById('screen');
    if (!c) return;
    var x = c.getContext('2d');
    x.fillStyle = '#000'; x.fillRect(0,0,256,240);
    x.fillStyle = '#f44'; x.font = '8px monospace'; x.textBaseline = 'top';
    x.fillText('ERROR:', 4, 4);
    x.fillStyle = '#fff';
    var words = (msg + ' ' + (src||'') + ':' + line).split(' ');
    var ln = '', y = 16;
    for (var i=0; i<words.length; i++) {
      if ((ln+' '+words[i]).length > 30) { x.fillText(ln, 4, y); y+=10; ln=words[i]; }
      else ln=(ln?ln+' ':'')+words[i];
    }
    if (ln) x.fillText(ln, 4, y);
  };

Wanderlight — top-down adventure. Boots straight into play and auto-resumes your last save.
Touch: drag anywhere on the LEFT half for a floating stick (4-way move); right side A = blade, B = item; PACK = inventory, SOUND = mute.

Loop: explore Aurelay, clear the 8 vaults for their Lumen Shards, then climb Ashen Peak and unmake Sable to free Elowen.
Fail = hearts empty ("THE LIGHT FADES"); tap A / press Enter to restart instantly. Best shard count persists in localStorage.

# Curbside — endless skate (portrait, canvas + vanilla JS)
Controls: tap = ollie; in the air swipe LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN = Backspin Curl / Gutter Whip / Skylatch Grab / Drop Shove; swipe UP over a rail or ledge = grind, then press-and-micro-drag to hold balance, quick tap to pop out. Keyboard: space or enter = ollie/pop, arrows or WASD = tricks and grind balance.
Loop: procedural street (stairs, rails, ledges, gaps, hydrants, cones, traffic) auto-scrolls; clean landings build speed, sketchy ones bleed it, tricks and grinds chain a combo multiplier that banks on a clean landing.
Fail: mid-rotation touchdowns, lost balance, gaps and obstacles cause a ragdoll bail that ends the run and posts trick score + distance.
Best score persists in localStorage ("curbside.best"); tap the game-over card to restart instantly.

  <script type="module">
    import { Game } from './src/game.js';

    const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
    const container = document.getElementById('game-container');

    function fitViewport() {
      const vw = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
      const vh = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
      const aspect = 256 / 224;
      let width = vw;
      let height = width / aspect;
      if (height > vh) {
        height = vh;
        width = height * aspect;
      }
      canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(width)}px`;
      canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(height)}px`;
      document.body.classList.toggle('portrait', vw < vh);
    }

    fitViewport();
    window.addEventListener('resize', fitViewport, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', fitViewport, { passive: true });
    container.addEventListener('touchmove', (event) => event.preventDefault(), { passive: false });
    container.addEventListener('gesturestart', (event) => event.preventDefault(), { passive: false });

    const game = new Game(canvas);
    game.input.attachTouchControls({
      stick: document.getElementById('stick'),
      knob: document.getElementById('stick-knob'),
      jump: document.getElementById('jump'),
      attack: document.getElementById('attack'),
      menu: document.getElementById('menu'),
    });
    window.game = game;

    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const hint = document.getElementById('hint');
      if (hint) hint.style.opacity = '0';
    }, 7000);
  </script>

function abilitySpec(u,name){const j=JOBS[u.job],common={name,range:1,minRange:1,cost:0,kind:"physical",factor:1,desc:"",presentation:"slash"};if(name==="Attack")return{...common,range:j.role==="ranged"?5:j.role==="mage"||j.role==="healer"?3:j.role==="bruiser"?2:1,factor:j.role==="ranged"?1.05:1,presentation:j.role==="ranged"?"arrow":j.role==="mage"?"arcane":j.role==="healer"?"holy":"slash"};const specs={"Shield Bash":{range:1,factor:1.2,desc:"Damage and push",knock:1,presentation:"shield"},Rampart:{range:0,minRange:0,kind:"buff",desc:"Brace and taunt",presentation:"buff"},"Aimed Shot":{range:5,factor:1.9,kind:"physical",charged:true,desc:"Charged high damage",presentation:"arrow"},Pin:{range:4,factor:.82,kind:"physical",desc:"Damage and delay",presentation:"arrow"},Fireball:{range:4,factor:1.15,kind:"magic",cost:16,charged:true,aoe:1,desc:"Charged 3 x 3 blast",presentation:"fireball"},"Frost Lance":{range:4,factor:1.05,kind:"magic",cost:10,desc:"Damage and slow",presentation:"frost"},Heal:{range:3,minRange:0,factor:1.45,kind:"heal",cost:10,desc:"Restore ally HP",presentation:"heal"},Bless:{range:3,minRange:0,factor:1,kind:"buff",cost:12,desc:"PA and accuracy for 2 turns",presentation:"bless"},Chakra:{range:0,minRange:0,factor:1,kind:"chakra",desc:"Restore self HP and MP",presentation:"chakra"},"Wave Fist":{range:2,factor:1.05,kind:"physical",desc:"Shockwave punch",presentation:"wave"},Backstab:{range:1,factor:2,kind:"physical",desc:"Huge back bonus",backOnly:true,presentation:"backstab"},"Steal Tempo":{range:1,factor:1,kind:"steal",desc:"Drain CT, gain Tempo",presentation:"steal"}};return{...common,...(specs[name]||{})};}
function actionValidTiles(u,s){return s.name==="Rampart"||s.name==="Chakra"?[{c:u.c,r:u.r}]:rangeTiles(u,s);}function targetAt(c,r){return unitAt(c,r,null);}
function hasBuff(u,name){return u.buffs.some(b=>b.name===name&&b.duration>0);}function addTimedBuff(u,name,duration,mods){const old=u.buffs.find(b=>b.name===name);if(old){old.duration=Math.max(old.duration,duration);old.appliedOnTurn=state.active===u?state.turnSerial:-1;return old;}const b={name,duration,mods:mods||{},appliedOnTurn:state.active===u?state.turnSerial:-1};u.buffs.push(b);return b;}function buffMod(u,name,field){const b=u.buffs.find(x=>x.name===name&&x.duration>0);return b&&b.mods[field]||0;}function effectiveDefense(u){return u.baseDefense+buffMod(u,"rampart","defense");}function effectivePA(u){return u.pa+buffMod(u,"blessed","pa");}
function validTarget(u,s,c,r){if(!inside(c,r)||terrainAt(c,r).terrain==="water")return false;const d=dist(u,{c,r}),min=s.minRange==null?1:s.minRange;if(d>s.range||d<min)return false;const t=targetAt(c,r);if(s.name==="Rampart"||s.kind==="chakra")return c===u.c&&r===u.r;if(s.backOnly&&(!t||relativeFacing(u,t)!=="BACK"))return false;if(s.kind==="heal"||s.kind==="buff")return!!t&&t.team===u.team;if(s.kind==="steal")return!!t&&t.team!==u.team;if(s.aoe)return true;if(s.kind==="physical"||s.kind==="magic")return!!t&&t.team!==u.team;return false;}
function preview(u,s,t){const sourceH=terrainAt(u.c,u.r).h,targetH=terrainAt(t.c,t.r).h,adv=sourceH-targetH,dir=relativeFacing(u,t);let hit=s.kind==="magic"?92:78;hit+=facingHitBonus(dir)+clamp(adv*7,-18,22)+buffMod(u,"blessed","accuracy");if(s.backOnly&&dir!=="BACK")hit=20;hit=clamp(hit,15,98);const raw=s.kind==="magic"?u.ma*s.factor:effectivePA(u)*s.factor,height=(s.name==="Aimed Shot"?1+Math.max(0,adv)*.12:1+adv*.03);return{hit,damage:Math.max(1,Math.round(raw*height*facingMult(dir)- (s.kind==="physical"?effectiveDefense(t):0))),dir,adv};}
function seededTie(a,b,salt){function h(str){let n=(state.seed^salt)>>>0;for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++)n=Math.imul(n^str.charCodeAt(i),16777619)>>>0;return n>>>0;}return h(a.id||a)-h(b.id||b);}function compareReady(a,b){return b.ct-a.ct||seededTie(a,b,state.tieSalt)||String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id));}
function queueForecast(){const sim=state.units.filter(u=>u.alive).map(u=>({id:u.id,ct:u.ct-(state.active&&u===state.active?100:0),speed:u.speed})),ids=[];let guard=0;while(ids.length<6&&guard++<600){let ready=sim.filter(x=>x.ct>=100);if(!ready.length){const min=Math.min(...sim.map(x=>Math.max(0,100-x.ct)));sim.forEach(x=>x.ct+=min);ready=sim.filter(x=>x.ct>=100);}ready.sort(compareReady);const pick=ready[0];ids.push(pick.id);pick.ct-=100;}return ids;}
function livingCount(){return state.units.filter(u=>u.alive).length;}function beginNextTurn(){if(state.ended)return;state.active=null;state.mode="clock";let guard=0;while(!state.active&&guard++<300){let ready=state.units.filter(u=>u.alive&&u.ct>=100);if(!ready.length){state.tick++;state.units.forEach(u=>{if(u.alive)u.ct+=u.speed;});ready=state.units.filter(u=>u.alive&&u.ct>=100);}if(ready.length){ready.sort(compareReady);state.active=ready[0];}}if(!state.active){state.units.filter(u=>u.alive).forEach(u=>u.ct+=20);return beginNextTurn();}state.turnSerial++;state.selected=state.active;state.active.acted=false;state.active.moveUsed=false;state.origin={c:state.active.c,r:state.active.r};state.confirmTargetKey=null;focusUnit(state.active);if(state.active.pending){state.mode="charge-resolve";startChargeResolve(state.active);updateHUD();return;}if(state.active.team==="enemy"){state.mode="ai";updateHUD();schedule();setTimeout(()=>runAI(state.active),120);}else{state.mode="move";updateHUD();schedule();}}
function tickBuffs(u){for(let i=u.buffs.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=u.buffs[i];if(b.appliedOnTurn===state.turnSerial){b.appliedOnTurn=-1;continue;}b.duration--;if(b.duration<=0)u.buffs.splice(i,1);}}
function finishTurn(){const u=state.active;if(!u||state.motion||state.sequence)return;tickBuffs(u);u.ct=Math.max(0,u.ct-100);u.acted=true;state.roundTurns++;const quota=Math.max(1,livingCount());if(state.roundTurns>=quota){state.roundTurns=0;state.round++;gainWaystoneTempo();}state.action=null;state.aim=null;state.confirmTargetKey=null;state.origin=null;state.active=null;state.mode="clock";checkEnd();if(!state.ended){updateHUD();beginNextTurn();}}
function gainWaystoneTempo(){for(const team of ["player","enemy"]){let gain=0;for(const stone of state.waystones)if(state.units.some(u=>u.alive&&u.team===team&&dist(u,stone)<=1))gain++;state.tempo[team]=clamp(state.tempo[team]+gain,0,6);}}
function checkEnd(){const p=state.units.some(u=>u.alive&&u.team==="player"),e=state.units.some(u=>u.alive&&u.team==="enemy");if(!p||!e){if(state.sequence){state.endPending=true;return;}state.ended=true;state.mode="ended";document.getElementById("bannerTitle").textContent=e?"DEFEAT":"VICTORY";document.getElementById("bannerText").textContent=e?"The Emberhold line has fallen.":"The field is yours.";document.getElementById("banner").hidden=false;updateHUD();}}
function startMove(u,path,after){if(!path.length){if(after)after();return;}u.moveUsed=true;state.motion={unit:u,path,index:0,progress:0,after};u.x=u.c;u.y=u.r;state.anim=true;schedule();}
function updateMotion(dt){const m=state.motion;if(!m)return;const stepDur=110;m.progress+=dt;while(m.progress>=stepDur&&m.index<m.path.length){m.progress-=stepDur;const step=m.path[m.index++],from=m.index===1?{c:state.origin.c,r:state.origin.r}:m.path[m.index-2];m.unit.c=step.c;m.unit.r=step.r;m.unit.x=step.c;m.unit.y=step.r;m.unit.face=faceDir(from.c,from.r,step.c,step.r);invalidateBoardCache();}if(m.index>=m.path.length){m.unit.x=m.unit.c;m.unit.y=m.unit.r;state.motion=null;state.anim=false;state.sortDirty=true;if(m.after)m.after();updateHUD();}}
function unitDrawPoint(u,out){out=out||nextPoint();if(state.motion&&state.motion.unit===u){const m=state.motion,t=clamp(m.progress/110,0,1),from=m.index===0?{c:state.origin.c,r:state.origin.r}:m.path[m.index-1],to=m.path[m.index]||from,a=viewPoint(from.c,from.r),b=viewPoint(to.c,to.r);out.x=lerp(a.x,b.x,t);out.y=lerp(a.y,b.y,t);return out;}const p=viewPoint(u.c,u.r);out.x=p.x;out.y=p.y;return out;}function updateHpTweens(dt){for(const u of state.units){const h=u.hpTween;if(!h)continue;h.t+=dt;const q=clamp(h.t/h.dur,0,1);u.hpVisual=lerp(h.from,h.to,easeInOutQuad(q));if(q>=1){u.hpVisual=h.to;u.hpTween=null;}}}
function pathPoint(seq,out){out=out||nextPoint();const a=boardWorld(seq.unit.c,seq.unit.r),b=boardWorld(seq.c,seq.r),q=clamp((seq.t-seq.commitAt)/Math.max(1,seq.impactAt-seq.commitAt),0,1),e=easeInOutQuad(q);out.x=lerp(a.x,b.x,e);out.y=lerp(a.y,b.y,e)-Math.sin(Math.PI*e)*(seq.spec.name==="Fireball"?54:30)-22;return out;}
function setHpTween(u,to,dur){const from=u.hpVisual==null?u.hp:u.hpVisual;u.hp=to;u.hpTween={from,to,dur,t:0};}function easeInQuad(t){return t*t;}function easeInOutQuad(t){return t<.5?2*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2;}function easeOutBack(t){const c1=1.70158,c3=c1+1;return 1+c3*Math.pow(t-1,3)+c1*Math.pow(t-1,2);}
function chooseMove(c,r){if(state.mode!=="move"||!state.active||state.active.team!=="player")return;const u=state.active,p=pathTo(u,c,r);if(!p.length){if(c===u.c&&r===u.r){state.mode="action";showToast("Choose an action");updateHUD();}return;}startMove(u,p,()=>{state.mode="action";state.selected=u;updateHUD();});}
function undoMove(){if(!state.active||!state.origin||state.mode!=="action"||!state.active.moveUsed)return;const u=state.active;u.c=state.origin.c;u.r=state.origin.r;u.x=u.c;u.y=u.r;u.moveUsed=false;u.face=u.team==="player"?"S":"N";invalidateBoardCache();state.mode="move";state.action=null;state.aim=null;updateHUD();draw(performance.now(),true);}
function chooseAction(name){if(!state.active||(state.mode!=="action"&&state.mode!=="move"))return;const u=state.active;if(name==="Stay"){state.mode="action";updateHUD();return;}if(name==="Surge"||name==="Rally"){spendTempo(name);return;}if(name==="Wait"||name==="End Turn"){finishTurn();return;}const s=abilitySpec(u,name);if(u.mp<s.cost){showToast("Not enough MP");return;}state.action=s;state.mode="aim";state.aim=null;state.confirmTargetKey=null;invalidateBoardCache();updateHUD();schedule();}
function spendTempo(name){const cost=name==="Surge"?2:3,u=state.active;if(!u||state.tempo[u.team]<cost)return;state.tempo[u.team]-=cost;if(name==="Surge"){u.ct+=60;floatText(...Object.values(boardCenter(u)),"SURGE","#ffd36c");burst(...Object.values(boardCenter(u)),"#ffd36c",12);}else{state.units.filter(a=>a.alive&&a.team===u.team&&a!==u&&dist(a,u)>0&&dist(a,u)<=1).forEach(a=>{const amt=Math.min(a.maxHp-a.hp,18);if(amt){setHpTween(a,a.hp+amt,220);floatText(...Object.values(boardCenter(a)),"+"+amt,"#86f5bc",{kind:"heal"});}});burst(...Object.values(boardCenter(u)),"#86f5bc",12);}finishTurn();}
function resolveLockedTarget(u,s,c,r,id){if(!id)return{c,r,targetId:null};const t=state.units.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!t||!t.alive||t.team===u.team||!validTarget(u,s,t.c,t.r))return{c,r,targetId:id,fizzle:true};return{c:t.c,r:t.r,targetId:id};}
function confirmTarget(c,r){if(state.mode!=="aim"||!state.active||!state.action)return;const u=state.active,s=state.action;if(!validTarget(u,s,c,r)){showToast("No valid target");return;}const t=targetAt(c,r);if(s.backOnly&&t&&relativeFacing(u,t)!=="BACK"){showToast("Backstab needs the rear");return;}if(s.name==="Rampart"||s.name==="Chakra"){startActionAnimation(u,s,u.c,u.r,false,false);return;}if(s.charged){u.mp-=s.cost;u.pending={name:s.name,c,r,targetId:s.aoe?null:t&&t.id||null,team:t&&t.team||null};floatText(...Object.values(boardCenter(u)),"CHARGING","#c6a4ff",{kind:"buff",size:14});burst(...Object.values(boardCenter(u)),"#c6a4ff",13,{speed:18,spread:42,vy:-18});startChargeTelegraph(u,s,c,r);return;}if(s.cost)u.mp-=s.cost;startActionAnimation(u,s,c,r,false,false);}

function presentationFor(s){return s.presentation||"slash";}function addReaction(seq,t,p,o){seq.reactions.push({unit:t,x:p.x,y:p.y,hit:o.hit,crit:o.crit,dx:Math.sign(t.c-seq.unit.c),dy:Math.sign(t.r-seq.unit.r)});}
function prepareOutcomes(seq){const s=seq.spec,u=seq.unit,targets=[];if(seq.fizzle)return[];if(s.aoe){for(const t of state.units)if(t.alive&&t.team!==u.team&&Math.abs(t.c-seq.c)<=1&&Math.abs(t.r-seq.r)<=1)targets.push(t);}else{const t=seq.targetId?state.units.find(x=>x.id===seq.targetId&&x.alive):targetAt(seq.c,seq.r);if(t&&t.team!==u.team)targets.push(t);}const out=[];for(const t of targets){const pre=preview(u,s,t),hit=state.combatRng()*100<=pre.hit,crit=pre.dir==="BACK"||s.backOnly;out.push({targetId:t.id,hit,crit,damage:hit?Math.max(1,Math.round(pre.damage*(.9+state.combatRng()*.2))):0,pre});}return out;}

function completeSequence(seq){if(state.sequence!==seq)return;if(!seq.chargeOnly&&!seq.hitApplied)actionImpact(seq);state.hitstop=0;emitSequenceExtras(seq);state.anim=null;state.sequence=null;state.mode="action-resolved";if(state.endPending){state.endPending=false;checkEnd();}else finishTurn();}function fastForwardSequence(){if(state.sequence)completeSequence(state.sequence);}

function aiMove(u,target){if(u.moveUsed){finishTurn();return;}const map=reachable(u),current=dist(u,target);let best=null;for(const e of map.values()){if(e.d===0||dist(e,target)>=current)continue;const score=dist(e,target)-(terrainAt(e.c,e.r).h>terrainAt(target.c,target.r).h?.3:0);if(!best||score<best.score||score===best.score&&(e.d>best.d||e.d===best.d&&seededTie(e,{id:key(e.c,e.r)},31)<0))best={...e,score};}if(best)startMove(u,best.path,()=>aiAct(u,target));else finishTurn();}
function aiTempo(u,target){target=target||bestTarget(u);if(state.tempo[u.team]>=3&&state.units.some(a=>a.alive&&a.team===u.team&&a!==u&&dist(a,u)===1&&a.hp<a.maxHp*.8)){spendTempo("Rally");return true;}const attack=abilitySpec(u,"Attack"),low=target&&target.hp<target.maxHp*.45,canStrike=target&&validTarget(u,attack,target.c,target.r),wouldFinish=canStrike&&preview(u,attack,target).damage>=target.hp,canReach=target&&Array.from(reachable(u).values()).some(p=>p.d>0&&dist(p,target)<=attack.range);if(state.tempo[u.team]>=2&&low&&(wouldFinish||canReach)){spendTempo("Surge");return true;}return false;}

  if(!spec&&target){for(const name of j.abilities.slice().reverse().concat(["Attack"])){const s=abilitySpec(u,name);if(u.mp<s.cost)continue;if(validTarget(u,s,target.c,target.r)){spec=s;t=target;break;}}}if(spec&&t){state.action=spec;const c=t.c,r=t.r;if(spec.charged){u.mp-=spec.cost;u.pending={name:spec.name,c,r,targetId:spec.aoe?null:t.id,team:t.team};floatText(...Object.values(boardCenter(u)),"CHARGING","#c6a4ff",{kind:"buff",size:14});startChargeTelegraph(u,spec,c,r);}else{if(spec.cost)u.mp-=spec.cost;startActionAnimation(u,spec,c,r,false,false,t.id);}return;}if(target){if(u.moveUsed){finishTurn();return;}aiMove(u,target);}else finishTurn();}

# EMBERHOLD Pocket Tactics - NOTES
Loop: boot straight into a 4v5 skirmish; each turn move your glowing unit and act until one side is wiped. Win/lose banner offers instant restart; fewest rounds to a win is saved to localStorage.
Touch: tap your unit to show its move range, tap a blue tile to move, tap a red enemy (or an action, then a tile) to aim - irreversible actions need a second tap on the target or the CONFIRM chip. END TURN is always in the top bar.
Camera: one-finger drag pans, pinch or double-tap empty space zooms, +/- chips on the board also zoom. MENU holds skirmish select, restart, random map, rotate, speed and how-to-play.
Keyboard: WASD / arrows move the tile cursor, Space or Enter selects/confirms, Esc cancels an aim, E ends the turn, R restarts the map, M toggles the menu.
Port bar: rules, AI, balance and the deterministic sim are untouched - only input, HUD layout and canvas fit changed (logical 1200x760 board, 960x608 backing store).

--- NOTES.md ---
# Steamline

LOOP: colour-coded trains enter at the green depot on a timetable (top strip). Tap a junction to flip its switch and send each train down the siding whose station matches its colour. Delivering before the train's patience bar empties scores full points and builds a combo; late scores less; reaching the red terminus undelivered scores nothing. A new station and junction appear every 2 deliveries (up to 6) and the spawn rate keeps climbing.
FAIL: any train-to-train collision ends the run. Best score is saved in localStorage. Tap the overlay or press Enter/R to restart instantly.
TOUCH: tap a junction = flip switch; tap a train = hold/release it at the next signal; drag = pan; pinch or double-tap = zoom.
KEYS: 1-6 flip switch N; Tab select train, Space hold/release; WASD/arrows pan; Q/E or -/+ zoom; 0 or F refit; R restart.

--- NOTES.md ---
Ace Vector is a seeded eight-wave arcade dogfight.
Touch: drag the left stick to pitch/turn and hold FIRE to shoot.
Touch: tap FLARE for incoming ace missiles; it has a cooldown.
Touch: tap WINGMAN to order an attack on your locked target.
Keyboard: arrows/WASD steer, Space/Enter fire, F/Shift flare, Enter restarts.

# Ridge Glider
Controls: drag anywhere vertically — up = flare (slow, climb, min sink), down = dive (speed, penetration). Desktop: Up/W and Down/S; Space/Enter to relaunch.
Loop: soar a seeded ridgeline downwind. Slow up in thermals (shimmering columns with circling birds) and in the blue lift band above windward slopes; dive through sink.
Scoring: 1 point per metre of distance, plus a landing-zone bonus for a gentle touchdown inside a marked LZ (every 2 km). Best score persists in localStorage.
Fail: hitting terrain fast, or stalling into the hill. Tap/Space relaunches instantly into a fresh seed.

   106	  var aw = Math.max(60, vw - p.x * 2), ah = Math.max(60, vh - p.t - p.b);

   134	function gapAhead(tr){
   135	  var net = G.net, e = net.edges[tr.edge];
   136	  var kids = childrenIdx(net, tr.edge), best = Infinity;
   137	  for (var i = 0; i < G.trains.length; i++){
   138	    var o = G.trains[i]; if (o === tr) continue;
   139	    if (o.edge === tr.edge){ if (o.s > tr.s) best = Math.min(best, o.s - tr.s); }
   140	    else if (kids.indexOf(o.edge) >= 0) best = Math.min(best, (e.len - tr.s) + o.s);
   141	  }
   142	  return best;
   143	}

   196	/* ---------- update ---------- */
   197	function update(dt){
   198	  if (G.tween){
   199	    var T = G.tween;
   200	    T.k = Math.min(1, T.k + dt / 0.55);
   201	    var k = smoothstep(0, 1, T.k);
   202	    G.cam.x = T.x0 + (T.x - T.x0) * k;
   203	    G.cam.y = T.y0 + (T.y - T.y0) * k;
   204	    G.cam.s = T.s0 + (T.s - T.s0) * k;
   205	    if (T.k >= 1) G.tween = null;
   206	  }
   207	  if (flashT > 0){ flashT -= dt; if (flashT <= 0) elFlash.style.opacity = '0'; }
   208	  if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 14);
   209	
   210	  for (var i = G.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
   211	    var p = G.parts[i];
   212	    p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   213	    if (!p.txt){ p.vx *= 0.94; p.vy *= 0.94; p.vy += 40 * dt; }
   214	    if (p.life <= 0) G.parts.splice(i, 1);
   215	  }
   216	  if (G.over) return;
   217	
   218	  G.time += dt;
   219	  if (G.hintT < 99){ G.hintT += dt; if (G.hintT > 11) elHint.style.opacity = '0'; }
   220	
   221	  /* spawns */
   222	  while (G.queue.length && G.queue[0].t <= G.time){
   223	    if (entryBlocked()){ for (var q = 0; q < G.queue.length; q++) G.queue[q].t += 0.6; break; }
   224	    spawnTrain(G.queue.shift().color);
   225	    G.interval = Math.max(1.7, 6.4 - G.delivered * 0.115);
   226	    retimeQueue();
   227	    fillQueue();
   228	  }
   229	  if (G.queue.length < 4) fillQueue();
   230	
   231	  /* trains */
   232	  for (var ti = G.trains.length - 1; ti >= 0; ti--){
   233	    var tr = G.trains[ti], net = G.net, e = net.edges[tr.edge];
   234	    if (!e){ G.trains.splice(ti, 1); continue; }
   235	    tr.patience -= dt;
   236	
   237	    if (tr.dwell > 0){
   238	      tr.dwell -= dt; tr.v = 0;
   239	      if (tr.dwell <= 0){
   240	        tr.stationDone = true;
   241	        deliver(tr, e.seg);
   242	      }
   243	    } else {
   244	      var base = tr.done ? BASE_SPEED * 1.35 : BASE_SPEED;
   245	      var cap = base;
   246	      var lim = function(d){ var a = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 2 * DECEL * d)); if (a < cap) cap = a; };
   247	
   248	      if (e.stationS !== null && !tr.stationDone && tr.s <= e.stationS) lim(e.stationS - tr.s);
   249	      if (tr.hold){
   250	        if (e.signalS !== null && tr.s <= e.signalS) lim(e.signalS - tr.s);
   251	        else {
   252	          var ni = nextEdgeIdx(net, tr.edge);
   253	          if (ni >= 0 && net.edges[ni] && net.edges[ni].signalS !== null)
   254	            lim((e.len - tr.s) + net.edges[ni].signalS);
   255	        }
   256	      }
   257	      var g = gapAhead(tr);
   258	      if (g < Infinity) lim(Math.max(0, g - FOLLOW_GAP));
   259	
   260	      if (cap > tr.v) tr.v = Math.min(cap, tr.v + ACCEL * dt);
   261	      else tr.v = Math.max(cap, tr.v - DECEL * 1.6 * dt);
   262	      if (tr.v < 0) tr.v = 0;
   263	
   264	      tr.s += tr.v * dt;
   265	
   266	      /* station arrival */
   267	      if (e.stationS !== null && !tr.stationDone && tr.s >= e.stationS - 0.8){
   268	        tr.s = e.stationS; tr.v = 0; tr.dwell = DWELL;
   269	      }
   270	      /* signal hold */
   271	      if (tr.hold && e.signalS !== null && tr.s >= e.signalS - 0.8 && tr.s <= e.signalS + 2){
   272	        tr.s = e.signalS; tr.v = 0;
   273	      }
   274	      /* edge transition */
   275	      if (tr.s >= e.len){
   276	        var over = tr.s - e.len;
   277	        var nx = nextEdgeIdx(net, tr.edge);
   278	        if (nx < 0){
   279	          if (!tr.done){ G.missed++; G.combo = 0; flash('rgba(239,68,68,.12)');
   280	            popup(tr.x, tr.y, 'MISSED', '#f87171'); beep(120, 0.2, 'sawtooth', 0.06, 70); }
   281	          G.trains.splice(ti, 1); continue;
   282	        }
   283	        tr.edge = nx; tr.s = over; tr.stationDone = false;
   284	      }
   285	    }
   286	    var pt = polyAt(G.net.edges[tr.edge].poly, tr.s);
   287	    tr.x = pt.x; tr.y = pt.y; tr.tx = pt.tx; tr.ty = pt.ty;
   288	  }
   289	
   290	  /* collisions */
   291	  for (var a = 0; a < G.trains.length; a++){
   292	    for (var b = a + 1; b < G.trains.length; b++){
   293	      var A = G.trains[a], B = G.trains[b];
   294	      if (Math.abs(A.x - B.x) > COLLIDE_DIST || Math.abs(A.y - B.y) > COLLIDE_DIST) continue;
   295	      if (Math.hypot(A.x - B.x, A.y - B.y) < COLLIDE_DIST){ gameOver(A, B); return; }
   296	    }
   297	  }
   298	}

   309	  }
   310	  elOScore.textContent = G.score;
   311	  elOBest.textContent = 'BEST ' + best;
   312	  setTimeout(function(){ elOver.classList.add('on'); }, 460);
   313	}

   392	    ctx.strokeStyle = st.color; ctx.lineWidth = 3.2; roundRect(-26, -17, 52, 34, 8); ctx.stroke();
   393	    ctx.fillStyle = st.color;
   394	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 8.5, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   395	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.22)';
   396	    ctx.fillRect(-20, -13, 40, 2.6); ctx.fillRect(-20, 10.4, 40, 2.6);
   397	    ctx.restore();
   398	  }
   399	
   400	  /* trains */
   401	  for (i = 0; i < G.trains.length; i++) drawTrain(G.trains[i], i === G.sel);
   402	
   403	  /* particles */
   404	  for (i = 0; i < G.parts.length; i++){
   405	    var p = G.parts[i], al = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
   406	    if (p.txt){
   407	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, al * 1.6);
   408	      ctx.fillStyle = p.c; ctx.font = '700 ' + (14 / S + 5) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   409	      ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText(p.txt, p.x, p.y);
   410	    } else {
   411	      ctx.globalAlpha = al; ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
   412	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * (0.4 + al), 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   413	    }
   414	  }
   415	  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   416	  ctx.restore();
   417	}

   420	function cap(p, color, kind){
   421	  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(p.ty, p.tx));
   422	  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1620'; roundRect(-7, -17, 14, 34, 5); ctx.fill();
   423	  ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; roundRect(-7, -17, 14, 34, 5); ctx.stroke();
   424	  ctx.fillStyle = color;
   425	  for (var i = -1; i <= 1; i++){
   426	    ctx.beginPath();
   427	    if (kind === 'in') ctx.arc(0, i * 9, 2.6, 0, 6.2832);
   428	    else { ctx.moveTo(-3.5, i * 9 - 3.5); ctx.lineTo(3, i * 9); ctx.lineTo(-3.5, i * 9 + 3.5); ctx.closePath(); }
   429	    ctx.fill();
   430	  }
   431	  ctx.restore();
   432	}

   434	function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r){
   435	  ctx.beginPath();
   436	  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   437	  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   438	  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   439	  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   440	  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   441	  ctx.closePath();
   442	}

   444	function drawTrain(tr, selected){
   445	  var ang = Math.atan2(tr.ty, tr.tx);
   446	  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(tr.x, tr.y); ctx.rotate(ang);
   447	  var col = tr.done ? '#94a3b8' : tr.color;
   448	  if (selected){
   449	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35; ctx.fillStyle = '#a7f0fb';
   450	    roundRect(-20, -13, 40, 26, 9); ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   451	  }
   452	  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.45)'; roundRect(-15, -7, 30, 15, 4); ctx.fill();
   453	  ctx.fillStyle = col; roundRect(-15, -8, 30, 15, 4); ctx.fill();
   454	  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.32)'; roundRect(2, -6, 10, 5, 2); ctx.fill();
   455	  ctx.strokeStyle = tr.hold ? '#ef4444' : 'rgba(6,12,18,.85)';
   456	  ctx.lineWidth = tr.hold ? 2.4 : 1.6; roundRect(-15, -8, 30, 15, 4); ctx.stroke();
   457	  if (!tr.done && tr.patience <= 0){
   458	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 110);
   459	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fb923c'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; roundRect(-17, -10, 34, 19, 5); ctx.stroke();
   460	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   461	  }
   462	  ctx.restore();
   463	
   464	  if (!tr.done){
   465	    var f = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tr.patience / PATIENCE));
   466	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,14,20,.75)';
   467	    ctx.fillRect(tr.x - 13, tr.y - 17, 26, 4);
   468	    ctx.fillStyle = f > 0.45 ? '#34d399' : (f > 0.18 ? '#fbbf24' : '#ef4444');
   469	    ctx.fillRect(tr.x - 12, tr.y - 16.2, 24 * f, 2.4);
   470	  }
   471	  if (tr.hold){
   472	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
   473	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tr.x, tr.y + 15, 3.6, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   474	  }
   475	}

   505	function localPos(ev){ return { x: ev.clientX, y: ev.clientY }; }

   507	cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(ev){
   508	  audio();
   509	  cv.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
   510	  ptrs.set(ev.pointerId, localPos(ev));
   511	  if (ptrs.size === 1){ panned = false; downT = performance.now(); downPos = localPos(ev); }
   512	  else if (ptrs.size === 2){
   513	    var a = Array.from(ptrs.values());
   514	    pinch = { d: Math.hypot(a[0].x - a[1].x, a[0].y - a[1].y),
   515	              m: { x: (a[0].x + a[1].x) / 2, y: (a[0].y + a[1].y) / 2 }, s: G.cam.s };
   516	    panned = true;
   517	  }

   519	}, { passive: false });

   521	cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function(ev){
   522	  if (!ptrs.has(ev.pointerId)) return;
   523	  var prev = ptrs.get(ev.pointerId), cur = localPos(ev);
   524	  ptrs.set(ev.pointerId, cur);
   525	  if (ptrs.size >= 2 && pinch){
   526	    var a = Array.from(ptrs.values());
   527	    var d = Math.hypot(a[0].x - a[1].x, a[0].y - a[1].y);
   528	    var m = { x: (a[0].x + a[1].x) / 2, y: (a[0].y + a[1].y) / 2 };
   529	    var ns = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(3, pinch.s * (d / (pinch.d || 1))));
   530	    var before = s2w(m.x, m.y);
   531	    G.cam.s = ns; G.tween = null;
   532	    var after = s2w(m.x, m.y);
   533	    G.cam.x += before.x - after.x; G.cam.y += before.y - after.y;
   534	    G.cam.x -= (m.x - pinch.m.x) / G.cam.s; G.cam.y -= (m.y - pinch.m.y) / G.cam.s;
   535	    pinch.m = m;
   536	  } else if (ptrs.size === 1){
   537	    var dx = cur.x - prev.x, dy = cur.y - prev.y;
   538	    if (!panned && downPos && Math.hypot(cur.x - downPos.x, cur.y - downPos.y) > 9) panned = true;
   539	    if (panned){ G.cam.x -= dx / G.cam.s; G.cam.y -= dy / G.cam.s; G.tween = null; }
   540	  }
   541	  ev.preventDefault();
   542	}, { passive: false });

   544	function endPtr(ev){
   545	  if (!ptrs.has(ev.pointerId)) return;
   546	  var pos = ptrs.get(ev.pointerId);
   547	  ptrs.delete(ev.pointerId);
   548	  if (ptrs.size < 2) pinch = null;
   549	  if (ptrs.size === 0 && !panned && performance.now() - downT < 500) tap(pos);
   550	  ev.preventDefault();
   551	}

   557	  G.tween = null;

   563	function tap(pos){
   564	  var now = performance.now();
   565	  if (G.over) return;
   566	  if (lastTapPos && now - lastTap < 320 && Math.hypot(pos.x - lastTapPos.x, pos.y - lastTapPos.y) < 40){
   567	    lastTap = 0;
   568	    if (G.cam.s < 1.25){
   569	      var w = s2w(pos.x, pos.y);
   570	      tweenTo(w.x, w.y, 1.7);
   571	    } else fitCam(false);
   572	    return;
   573	  }
   574	  lastTap = now; lastTapPos = pos;
   575	
   576	  /* trains first (generous hit area) */
   577	  var hitR = Math.max(26, 17 * G.cam.s), bestD = 1e9, bestI = -1, i, p, d;
   578	  for (i = 0; i < G.trains.length; i++){
   579	    p = w2s(G.trains[i].x, G.trains[i].y);
   580	    d = Math.hypot(p.x - pos.x, p.y - pos.y);
   581	    if (d < hitR && d < bestD){ bestD = d; bestI = i; }
   582	  }
   583	  if (bestI >= 0){
   584	    var tr = G.trains[bestI];
   585	    tr.hold = !tr.hold; G.sel = bestI;
   586	    beep(tr.hold ? 320 : 480, 0.06, 'square', 0.05);
   587	    return;
   588	  }
   589	  /* switches */
   590	  var swR = Math.max(28, 15 * G.cam.s); bestD = 1e9; bestI = -1;
   591	  for (i = 0; i < G.net.n; i++){
   592	    p = w2s(G.net.nodes[i].x, G.net.nodes[i].y);
   593	    d = Math.hypot(p.x - pos.x, p.y - pos.y);
   594	    if (d < swR && d < bestD){ bestD = d; bestI = i; }
   595	  }
   596	  if (bestI >= 0) toggleSwitch(bestI);
   597	}
   598	
   599	function toggleSwitch(i){
   600	  if (i < 0 || i >= G.net.n) return;
   601	  G.net.sw[i] = !G.net.sw[i];
   602	  var nd = G.net.nodes[i];
   603	  burst(nd.x, nd.y, '#67e8f9', 6);
   604	  beep(560, 0.05, 'square', 0.05, 700);
   605	  G.hintT = 99; elHint.style.opacity = '0';
   606	}

   629	    }
   630	    ev.preventDefault(); return;
   631	  }

     1	'use strict';

     4	function mulberry32(a){
     5	  return function(){
     6	    a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
     7	    var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
     8	    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
     9	    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    10	  };
    11	}
    12	
    13	function smoothstep(a, b, x){
    14	  x = (x - a) / (b - a);
    15	  if (x < 0) x = 0; else if (x > 1) x = 1;
    16	  return x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
    17	}
    18	
    19	function polyBuild(pts){
    20	  var cum = [0], L = 0;
    21	  for (var i = 1; i < pts.length; i++){
    22	    L += Math.hypot(pts[i].x - pts[i-1].x, pts[i].y - pts[i-1].y);
    23	    cum.push(L);
    24	  }
    25	  return { pts: pts, cum: cum, len: L };
    26	}
    27	
    28	function polyAt(p, s){
    29	  if (s < 0) s = 0; else if (s > p.len) s = p.len;
    30	  var lo = 0, hi = p.cum.length - 1, m;
    31	  while (lo < hi - 1){ m = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (p.cum[m] <= s) lo = m; else hi = m; }
    32	  var a = p.pts[lo], b = p.pts[lo+1] || p.pts[lo];
    33	  var seg = (p.cum[lo+1] - p.cum[lo]) || 1;
    34	  var t = (s - p.cum[lo]) / seg;
    35	  var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y, dl = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    36	  return { x: a.x + dx * t, y: a.y + dy * t, tx: dx / dl, ty: dy / dl };
    37	}
    38	
    39	/* Serpentine main line: down the left column, round the bottom, up the right column. */
    40	var SPINE_CX = 100, SPINE_TOP = -80, SPINE_HB = 300, SPINE_R = 100;
    41	function buildSpine(){
    42	  var pts = [], y, k, th;
    43	  for (y = SPINE_TOP; y <= SPINE_HB; y += 10) pts.push({ x: -SPINE_CX, y: y });
    44	  for (k = 1; k <= 44; k++){
    45	    th = Math.PI - Math.PI * k / 44;
    46	    pts.push({ x: Math.cos(th) * SPINE_R, y: SPINE_HB + Math.sin(th) * SPINE_R });
    47	  }
    48	  for (y = SPINE_HB - 10; y >= SPINE_TOP; y -= 10) pts.push({ x: SPINE_CX, y: y });
    49	  return polyBuild(pts);
    50	}
    51	
    52	/* Sample a stretch of spine, optionally bowed outward by D (a station siding). */
    53	function sampleEdge(spine, s0, s1, D){
    54	  var L = s1 - s0, N = Math.max(8, Math.round(L / 6)), pts = [], k, u, s, p, w;
    55	  for (k = 0; k <= N; k++){
    56	    u = k / N; s = s0 + L * u;
    57	    p = polyAt(spine, s);
    58	    w = D > 0 ? D * smoothstep(0, 0.36, u) * (1 - smoothstep(0.64, 1, u)) : 0;
    59	    pts.push({ x: p.x - p.ty * w, y: p.y + p.tx * w });
    60	  }
    61	  return { pts: pts, midIdx: Math.round(N / 2) };
    62	}
    63	
    64	var NET_S0 = 70, NET_SEG = 150, NET_D = 95, NET_EXIT = 92, NET_MAX = 6;
    65	
    66	function makeEdge(kind, seg, pts){
    67	  var p = polyBuild(pts);
    68	  var path = new Path2D();
    69	  path.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    70	  for (var i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) path.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
    71	  /* first ~78 units, used to show which way a switch is set */
    72	  var head = new Path2D();
    73	  head.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    74	  for (i = 1; i < pts.length && p.cum[i] < 78; i++) head.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
    75	  return { kind: kind, seg: seg, poly: p, len: p.len, path: path, headPath: head,
    76	           stationS: null, stationPt: null, signalS: p.len > 62 ? p.len - 24 : null,
    77	           signalPt: null, dirPt: polyAt(p, Math.min(26, p.len)) };
    78	}
    79	
    80	/* n = station count. Edge index layout: 0 entry, 1+2i main_i, 2+2i side_i, 1+2n exit. */
    81	function buildNet(spine, n, colors){
    82	  var jS = [], i;
    83	  for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) jS.push(NET_S0 + NET_SEG * i);
    84	  var edges = [];
    85	  edges.push(makeEdge('entry', -1, sampleEdge(spine, 0, jS[0], 0).pts));
    86	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++){
    87	    edges.push(makeEdge('main', i, sampleEdge(spine, jS[i], jS[i+1], 0).pts));
    88	    var sd = sampleEdge(spine, jS[i], jS[i+1], NET_D);
    89	    var e = makeEdge('side', i, sd.pts);
    90	    e.stationS = e.poly.cum[sd.midIdx];
    91	    e.stationPt = polyAt(e.poly, e.stationS);
    92	    edges.push(e);
    93	  }
    94	  var endS = Math.min(spine.len, jS[n] + NET_EXIT);
    95	  var ex = makeEdge('exit', -1, sampleEdge(spine, jS[n], endS, 0).pts);
    96	  ex.signalS = null;
    97	  edges.push(ex);
    98	
    99	  var all = new Path2D();
   100	  for (i = 0; i < edges.length; i++){
   101	    all.addPath(edges[i].path);
   102	    if (edges[i].signalS !== null) edges[i].signalPt = polyAt(edges[i].poly, edges[i].signalS);
   103	  }
   104	
   105	  var nodes = [], stations = [];
   106	  for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) nodes.push(polyAt(spine, jS[i]));
   107	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++){
   108	    var sp = edges[2 + 2*i].stationPt;
   109	    stations.push({ x: sp.x, y: sp.y, tx: sp.tx, ty: sp.ty, color: colors[i % colors.length], i: i });
   110	  }
   111	  return { n: n, jS: jS, edges: edges, nodes: nodes, stations: stations, allPath: all,
   112	           entryPt: polyAt(edges[0].poly, 0), exitPt: polyAt(ex.poly, ex.len),
   113	           exitIdx: 1 + 2*n, sw: new Array(n).fill(false) };
   114	}
   115	
   116	function childIdx(net, seg){ return net.sw[seg] ? 2 + 2*seg : 1 + 2*seg; }
   117	
   118	function nextEdgeIdx(net, ei){
   119	  var e = net.edges[ei];
   120	  if (e.kind === 'exit') return -1;
   121	  var j = (e.kind === 'entry' ? -1 : e.seg) + 1;
   122	  return j < net.n ? childIdx(net, j) : net.exitIdx;
   123	}
   124	
   125	/* Both possible successors - used for safe following across a junction. */
   126	function childrenIdx(net, ei){
   127	  var e = net.edges[ei];
   128	  if (e.kind === 'exit') return [];
   129	  var j = (e.kind === 'entry' ? -1 : e.seg) + 1;
   130	  return j < net.n ? [1 + 2*j, 2 + 2*j] : [net.exitIdx];
   131	}
   132	
   133	function netBounds(net){
   134	  var b = { x0: 1e9, y0: 1e9, x1: -1e9, y1: -1e9 };
   135	  for (var i = 0; i < net.edges.length; i++){
   136	    var pts = net.edges[i].poly.pts;
   137	    for (var k = 0; k < pts.length; k++){
   138	      if (pts[k].x < b.x0) b.x0 = pts[k].x;
   139	      if (pts[k].x > b.x1) b.x1 = pts[k].x;
   140	      if (pts[k].y < b.y0) b.y0 = pts[k].y;
   141	      if (pts[k].y > b.y1) b.y1 = pts[k].y;
   142	    }
   143	  }
   144	  b.x0 -= 34; b.x1 += 34; b.y0 -= 30; b.y1 += 30;
   145	  return b;
   146	}

    56	  function terrain(s) {

    61	    function samp(fx, fy) {
    62	      var gx = fx * (cw - 1), gy = fy * (ch - 1);
    63	      var x0 = Math.floor(gx), y0 = Math.floor(gy);
    64	      var x1 = Math.min(cw - 1, x0 + 1), y1 = Math.min(ch - 1, y0 + 1);
    65	      var tx = gx - x0, ty = gy - y0;
    66	      tx = tx * tx * (3 - 2 * tx); ty = ty * ty * (3 - 2 * ty);
    67	      var a = cp[y0 * cw + x0], b = cp[y0 * cw + x1], c = cp[y1 * cw + x0], d = cp[y1 * cw + x1];

   225	  // ---------- monthly tick ----------
   226	  function tick(s) {
   227	    var i, k, x, y;
   228	    analyze(s);
   229	
   230	    // --- growth / decay
   231	    var grew = [];
   232	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   233	      var tt = s.t[k];
   234	      if (tt !== T.HOME && tt !== T.SHOP) continue;
   235	      x = k % W; y = (k / W) | 0;
   236	      var ok = s.acc[k] && s.pow[k] && s.svc[k];

   239	      if (ok) {

   241	        rate += Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.8, s.des[k] * 0.16));
   242	        rate *= cong ? 0.35 : 1;

   244	        s.g[k] += rate;
   245	        if (s.g[k] >= 3 && s.d[k] < 2) { s.d[k]++; s.g[k] = 0; grew.push(k); }
   246	      } else {
   247	        s.g[k] -= 0.7;
   248	        if (s.g[k] <= -3) { s.g[k] = 0; if (s.d[k] > 0) s.d[k]--; }
   249	      }

   253	    var pop = 0, jobs = 0;

   257	    }
   258	    s.pop = pop;
   259	    if (pop > s.best) s.best = pop;
   260	
   261	    var tax = Math.round(30 + pop * 0.55 + Math.min(jobs, pop) * 0.30);
   262	    var up = 0;
   263	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   264	      if (s.t[k] === T.ROAD) up += 0.4;
   265	      else if (s.t[k] === T.POWER) up += 22;
   266	      else if (s.t[k] === T.PARK) up += 2;
   267	      else if (s.t[k] === T.HOME) up += 0.8 * (s.d[k] + 1);
   268	      else if (s.t[k] === T.SHOP) up += 1.2 * (s.d[k] + 1);
   269	    }

   271	    s.income = tax; s.upkeep = up;
   272	    s.funds += tax - up;
   273	    if (s.funds < 0) s.funds = 0;
   274	    // emergency relief so a bankrupt city can always dig itself out
   275	    if (s.funds < 70 && tax - up <= 0) s.funds += 30;
   276	    s.broke = false;

   279	    var lvl = -1;
   280	    while (s.goal < GOALS.length && pop >= GOALS[s.goal]) { lvl = s.goal; s.goal++; }
   281	    return { grew: grew, net: tax - up, goalHit: lvl };

   284	  function stamp(s, type, rad, amt) {
   285	    for (var y = 0; y < H; y++) for (var x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   286	      var k = y * W + x;
   287	      if (s.t[k] !== type) continue;
   288	      var d = s.d[k] || 0;
   289	      for (var ny = y - rad; ny <= y + rad; ny++) for (var nx = x - rad; nx <= x + rad; nx++) {
   290	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   291	        var m = Math.max(Math.abs(nx - x), Math.abs(ny - y));
   292	        s.des[ny * W + nx] += amt * (1 - m / (rad + 1)) * (1 + d * 0.15);
   293	      }
   294	    }

   297	  function roadCong(s, x, y) {
   298	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

   300	      if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;

   302	      if (s.t[k] === T.ROAD && s.load[k] > ROAD_CAP) return true;
   303	    }
   304	    return false;

   329	      return s;
   330	    } catch (e) { return null; }
   331	  }

    40	    S.TOOLS.forEach(function (t, i) {
    41	      var d = document.createElement('div');
    42	      d.className = 'tool'; d.dataset.i = i;
    43	      d.innerHTML = '<div class="sw" style="background:' + t.col + '"></div>' +
    44	        '<div class="nm">' + t.name + '</div><div class="pr">$' + t.cost + '</div>';
    45	      elTools.appendChild(d);
    46	    });
    47	    elTools.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    48	      var el = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.tool') : null;
    49	      if (!el) return;
    50	      e.preventDefault();
    51	      tool = +el.dataset.i;
    52	      syncTools(); beep(660, 0.05, 'square', 0.05);
    53	      hideTip(); updateTip();
    54	    });
    55	    syncTools();
    56	  }
    57	  function syncTools() {
    58	    var kids = elTools.children;
    59	    for (var i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
    60	      kids[i].classList.toggle('sel', i === tool);
    61	      kids[i].classList.toggle('poor', state && state.funds < S.TOOLS[i].cost);
    62	    }
    63	  }

    65	  // ---------- hud ----------
    66	  function fmt(n) { return n >= 1000 ? (n / 1000).toFixed(n >= 10000 ? 0 : 1) + 'k' : String(n | 0); }
    67	  function syncHud() {
    68	    var s = state;
    69	    elPop.textContent = fmt(s.pop);
    70	    elCash.textContent = '$' + fmt(s.funds);
    71	    elCash.classList.toggle('bad', s.funds < 60);
    72	    var net = s.income - s.upkeep;
    73	    elInc.textContent = (net >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + fmt(Math.abs(net));
    74	    elInc.style.color = net >= 0 ? '#7fd6a2' : '#ff7a6b';
    75	    elMon.textContent = String(s.month);
    76	    if (s.goal < S.GOALS.length) {
    77	      var g = S.GOALS[s.goal], prev = s.goal ? S.GOALS[s.goal - 1] : 0;
    78	      elGoal.textContent = 'Goal ' + fmt(g);
    79	      elBar.style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (s.pop - prev) / (g - prev) * 100)) + '%';
    80	    } else {
    81	      elGoal.textContent = 'Sandbox  best ' + fmt(Math.max(s.best, S.bestScore()));
    82	      elBar.style.width = '100%';
    83	    }
    84	    syncTools();
    85	  }

    87	  function toast(a, b, ms) {
    88	    tA.textContent = a; tB.textContent = b || '';
    89	    elToast.classList.add('on');
    90	    clearTimeout(toast._t);
    91	    toast._t = setTimeout(function () { elToast.classList.remove('on'); }, ms || 2600);
    92	  }
    93	  function setTip(txt) {
    94	    if (txt === tipTxt) return;
    95	    tipTxt = txt;
    96	    elTip.style.transition = 'opacity .4s';
    97	    if (!txt) { elTip.style.opacity = '0'; return; }
    98	    elTip.textContent = txt; elTip.style.opacity = '1';
    99	  }
   100	  function hideTip() { firstBuild = true; }
   101	
   102	  // one short contextual line, never more than one at a time
   103	  function updateTip() {
   104	    var s = state, needRoad = 0, needPow = 0, needShop = 0, homes = 0, plants = 0, shops = 0;
   105	    for (var k = 0; k < S.W * S.H; k++) {
   106	      var t = s.t[k];
   107	      if (t === T.POWER) { plants++; continue; }
   108	      if (t === T.SHOP) shops++;
   109	      if (t !== T.HOME && t !== T.SHOP) continue;
   110	      if (t === T.HOME) homes++;
   111	      if (!s.acc[k]) needRoad++;
   112	      else if (!s.pow[k]) needPow++;
   113	      else if (!s.svc[k]) needShop++;
   114	    }
   115	    if (!firstBuild) return setTip('Pick a tool below, then drag on the map to build.');
   116	    if (!homes) return setTip('Place Homes next to a road to start growing.');
   117	    if (needRoad) return setTip('Red dot = no road. Build a road beside it.');
   118	    if (needPow) return setTip(plants ? 'Yellow dot = no power. Connect it by road to a plant.' : 'Yellow dot = no power. Build a Plant on the road network.');
   119	    if (needShop) return setTip(shops ? 'Blue dot = no shop within 5 tiles.' : 'Blue dot = build Shops within 5 tiles of homes.');
   120	    setTip('');
   121	  }
   122	
   123	  // ---------- layout ----------
   124	  function layout() {
   125	    var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
   126	    R.resize(Math.max(80, r.width - 4), Math.max(80, r.height - 4));
   127	  }

   129	  // ---------- city lifecycle ----------
   130	  function prime(s) {
   131	    var f = s.funds, m = s.month, g = s.goal, p = s.pop;
   132	    S.tick(s);
   133	    s.funds = f; s.month = m; s.goal = g; s.pop = p || s.pop;
   134	    S.tick(s); s.funds = f; s.month = m; s.goal = g;
   135	  }
   136	  function newCity() {
   137	    state = S.blank((Math.random() * 4294967295) >>> 0);
   138	    state.best = S.bestScore();
   139	    prime(state);
   140	    R.markDirty();
   141	    S.save(state);
   142	    syncHud();
   143	    firstBuild = false; tipTxt = null; updateTip();
   144	    toast('NEW CITY', 'Fresh land. Build roads first.', 1800);
   145	    beep(300, 0.14, 'sawtooth', 0.05);
   146	  }
   147	  function boot() {
   148	    state = S.load();
   149	    if (!state) { state = S.blank((Math.random() * 4294967295) >>> 0); state.best = S.bestScore(); }
   150	    prime(state);
   151	    R.markDirty();
   152	    syncHud();
   153	    for (var k = 0; k < S.W * S.H; k++) if (state.t[k] === T.HOME) { firstBuild = true; break; }
   154	    updateTip();
   155	  }
   156	
   157	  // recompute access/power/service so warning badges and the hint react instantly
   158	  function refresh() { if (state) { S.analyze(state); updateTip(); } }
   159	
   160	  // ---------- placement ----------
   161	  function tryPlace(gx, gy) {
   162	    var k = gy * S.W + gx;
   163	    if (k === lastPaint) return;
   164	    lastPaint = k;
   165	    var t = S.TOOLS[tool];
   166	    var pre = state.t[k];
   167	    if (state.funds < t.cost) {
   168	      R.popText(gx, gy, 'BROKE', '#ff7a6b'); beep(120, 0.12, 'square', 0.05);
   169	      return;
   170	    }
   171	    var ok = S.place(state, gx, gy, t);
   172	    if (!ok) {
   173	      if (pre === T.WATER || pre === T.HILL) { R.popText(gx, gy, 'NO', '#ff9a6b'); beep(150, 0.07, 'square', 0.04); }
   174	      return;
   175	    }
   176	    R.markDirty();
   177	    R.burst(gx, gy, t.id === 'raze' ? '#cfd6da' : t.col, t.id === 'power' ? 16 : 8);
   178	    R.popText(gx, gy, '-$' + t.cost, '#ffd479');
   179	    if (t.id === 'power') R.kick(6);
   180	    beep(t.id === 'raze' ? 220 : 520 + tool * 40, 0.05, t.id === 'raze' ? 'sawtooth' : 'square', 0.045);
   181	    syncHud();
   182	    hideTip(); updateTip();
   183	  }
   184	
   185	  function toGrid(ev) {
   186	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   187	    return R.pick(ev.clientX - r.left, ev.clientY - r.top);
   188	  }
   189	
   190	  function bindInput() {
   191	    cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
   192	      e.preventDefault();
   193	      if (cv.setPointerCapture) { try { cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (x) {} }
   194	      painting = true; lastPaint = -1;
   195	      var g = toGrid(e); if (g) { cur = g; tryPlace(g.x, g.y); }
   196	    }, { passive: false });
   197	    cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
   198	      var g = toGrid(e);
   199	      if (g) cur = g;
   200	      if (painting && g) { e.preventDefault(); tryPlace(g.x, g.y); }
   201	    }, { passive: false });
   202	    function up() { painting = false; lastPaint = -1; refresh(); }
   203	    cv.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
   204	    cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
   205	    cv.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { if (!painting) cur = null; });
   206	    cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   207	    document.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   208	    document.addEventListener('gesturestart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   209	    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   210	
   211	    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   212	      var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
   213	      if (k >= '1' && k <= '6') { tool = +k - 1; syncTools(); hideTip(); updateTip(); return; }
   214	      if (!cur) cur = { x: 8, y: 11 };
   215	      if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') { cur.x = Math.max(0, cur.x - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   216	      else if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') { cur.x = Math.min(S.W - 1, cur.x + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   217	      else if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'w') { cur.y = Math.max(0, cur.y - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   218	      else if (k === 'arrowdown' || k === 's') { cur.y = Math.min(S.H - 1, cur.y + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   219	      else if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') { lastPaint = -1; tryPlace(cur.x, cur.y); refresh(); e.preventDefault(); }
   220	      else if (k === 'p') togglePause();
   221	      else if (k === 'n') newCity();
   222	      else if (k === 'f') cycleSpeed();
   223	    });
   224	
   225	    bPause.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); togglePause(); });
   226	    bSpeed.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); cycleSpeed(); });
   227	    bNew.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
   228	      e.preventDefault();
   229	      if (bNew._arm) { clearTimeout(bNew._t); bNew._arm = false; bNew.textContent = 'NEW CITY'; newCity(); return; }
   230	      bNew._arm = true; bNew.textContent = 'SURE?';
   231	      bNew._t = setTimeout(function () { bNew._arm = false; bNew.textContent = 'NEW CITY'; }, 2200);
   232	    });
   233	
   234	    window.addEventListener('resize', layout);
   235	    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { setTimeout(layout, 120); });
   236	    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden && state) S.save(state); });
   237	  }
   238	
   239	  function togglePause() { paused = !paused; bPause.textContent = paused ? 'RESUME' : 'PAUSE'; bPause.classList.toggle('hot', paused); }
   240	  function cycleSpeed() { spIdx = (spIdx + 1) % SPEEDS.length; speed = SPEEDS[spIdx]; bSpeed.textContent = 'SPEED ' + speed + 'x'; }
   241	
   242	  // ---------- monthly tick ----------
   243	  function doTick() {
   244	    var res = S.tick(state);
   245	    for (var i = 0; i < res.grew.length && i < 12; i++) {
   246	      var k = res.grew[i], x = k % S.W, y = (k / S.W) | 0;
   247	      R.burst(x, y, state.t[k] === T.HOME ? '#7ee59a' : '#66c6f5', 7);
   248	    }
   249	    if (res.grew.length) beep(880, 0.06, 'triangle', 0.05);
   250	    if (res.goalHit >= 0) {
   251	      var g = S.GOALS[res.goalHit];
   252	      R.kick(9); chord(440);
   253	      var msg = res.goalHit === 0 ? 'A real town now.' :
   254	                res.goalHit === 1 ? 'Borough status achieved.' : 'A proper city. Sandbox unlocked.';
   255	      toast(fmt(g) + ' RESIDENTS', msg, 3400);
   256	      for (var b = 0; b < 26; b++) {
   257	        R.burst((Math.random() * S.W) | 0, (Math.random() * S.H) | 0, ['#ffe9a8', '#7fd6a2', '#66c6f5'][b % 3], 5);
   258	      }
   259	    } else if (state.funds < 40) {
   260	      toast('TREASURY LOW', 'Taxes rise with residents. Wait a month.', 1800);
   261	    }
   262	    S.save(state);
   263	    syncHud();
   264	    updateTip();
   265	  }
   266	
   267	  // ---------- loop ----------
   268	  var last = 0, acc = 0;
   269	  function frame(ts) {
   270	    if (!last) last = ts;
   271	    var dt = Math.min(0.05, (ts - last) / 1000); last = ts;
   272	    if (!paused) {
   273	      acc += dt * 1000 * speed;
   274	      while (acc >= S.TICK_MS) { acc -= S.TICK_MS; doTick(); }
   275	    }
   276	    R.draw(state, dt, { cur: cur, toolCost: S.TOOLS[tool].cost });
   277	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   278	  }
   279	
   280	  // ---------- start ----------
   281	  function start() {
   282	    if (running) return;
   283	    running = true;
   284	    startScreen.classList.add('hide');
   285	    audio(); if (ac && ac.resume) ac.resume();
   286	    beep(520, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.06);
   287	    layout();
   288	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   289	  }
   290	
   291	  R.init(cv);
   292	  buildToolbar();
   293	  boot();
   294	  bindInput();
   295	  layout();
   296	  document.getElementById('startGo').addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); start(); });
   297	  startScreen.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); start(); });
   298	  // draw one frame behind the overlay so the city is visible immediately
   299	  R.draw(state, 0, { cur: null, toolCost: 0 });
   300	})(window);

     1	/* Blockborough - rendering */
     2	(function (G) {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	  var S = G.Sim, W = S.W, H = S.H, T = S.T;
     5	
     6	  var cv, cx, cell = 20, ox = 0, oy = 0, cssW = 0, cssH = 0, dpr = 1;
     7	  var parts = [], floats = [], dots = [], roadList = [], roadDirty = true;
     8	  var shake = 0, time = 0;
     9	
    10	  function init(canvas) {
    11	    cv = canvas; cx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    12	  }
    13	
    14	  function resize(availW, availH) {
    15	    cell = Math.floor(Math.min(availW / W, availH / H));
    16	    if (cell < 8) cell = 8;
    17	    cssW = cell * W; cssH = cell * H;
    18	    var longAxis = Math.max(cssW, cssH);
    19	    dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 960 / longAxis);
    20	    cv.style.width = cssW + 'px'; cv.style.height = cssH + 'px';
    21	    cv.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr); cv.height = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
    22	    cx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    23	    cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    24	    ox = 0; oy = 0;
    25	    return { w: cssW, h: cssH };
    26	  }
    27	
    28	  function pick(px, py) {
    29	    var x = Math.floor((px - ox) / cell), y = Math.floor((py - oy) / cell);
    30	    return S.inb(x, y) ? { x: x, y: y } : null;
    31	  }
    32	
    33	  function markDirty() { roadDirty = true; }
    34	  function kick(a) { shake = Math.min(9, shake + a); }
    35	
    36	  function burst(x, y, col, n) {
    37	    if (parts.length > 260) return;
    38	    var cxp = ox + (x + 0.5) * cell, cyp = oy + (y + 0.5) * cell;
    39	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    40	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, sp = 20 + Math.random() * 70;
    41	      parts.push({ x: cxp, y: cyp, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 20, l: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.35, m: 0, c: col });
    42	    }
    43	  }
    44	  function popText(x, y, txt, col) {
    45	    if (floats.length > 10) floats.shift();
    46	    floats.push({ x: ox + (x + 0.5) * cell, y: oy + (y + 0.3) * cell, t: txt, c: col, l: 1.1, m: 0 });
    47	  }
    48	
    49	  // ---------- traffic ----------
    50	  function rebuildRoads(s) {
    51	    roadList.length = 0;
    52	    for (var k = 0; k < W * H; k++) if (s.t[k] === T.ROAD) roadList.push(k);
    53	    roadDirty = false;
    54	    for (var i = dots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    55	      if (s.t[dots[i].b] !== T.ROAD) dots.splice(i, 1);
    56	    }
    57	  }
    58	  function roadNbrs(s, k) {
    59	    var x = k % W, y = (k / W) | 0, out = [];
    60	    if (x > 0 && s.t[k - 1] === T.ROAD) out.push(k - 1);
    61	    if (x < W - 1 && s.t[k + 1] === T.ROAD) out.push(k + 1);
    62	    if (y > 0 && s.t[k - W] === T.ROAD) out.push(k - W);
    63	    if (y < H - 1 && s.t[k + W] === T.ROAD) out.push(k + W);
    64	    return out;
    65	  }
    66	  function updDots(s, dt) {
    67	    if (roadDirty) rebuildRoads(s);
    68	    var want = Math.min(64, Math.floor(s.pop / 45) + (roadList.length ? 3 : 0));
    69	    while (dots.length > want) dots.pop();
    70	    while (dots.length < want && roadList.length) {
    71	      var b = roadList[(Math.random() * roadList.length) | 0];
    72	      var nb = roadNbrs(s, b);
    73	      dots.push({ b: b, a: nb.length ? nb[(Math.random() * nb.length) | 0] : b, p: Math.random(), s: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.7 });
    74	    }
    75	    for (var i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
    76	      var d = dots[i];
    77	      var slow = s.load[d.b] > S.ROAD_CAP ? 0.32 : 1;
    78	      d.p += dt * d.s * slow;
    79	      while (d.p >= 1) {
    80	        d.p -= 1;
    81	        var prev = d.b; d.b = d.a;
    82	        if (s.t[d.b] !== T.ROAD) { d.b = roadList.length ? roadList[(Math.random() * roadList.length) | 0] : d.b; prev = -1; }
    83	        var nb2 = roadNbrs(s, d.b);
    84	        if (nb2.length > 1) { var f = nb2.filter(function (v) { return v !== prev; }); if (f.length) nb2 = f; }
    85	        d.a = nb2.length ? nb2[(Math.random() * nb2.length) | 0] : d.b;
    86	      }
    87	    }
    88	  }
    89	
    90	  // ---------- tile art ----------
    91	  function grassCol(k) {
    92	    var v = ((k * 2654435761) >>> 0) % 3;
    93	    return v === 0 ? '#2d4632' : v === 1 ? '#314b36' : '#2a4130';
    94	  }
    95	
    96	  function drawTile(s, x, y) {
    97	    var k = y * W + x, t = s.t[k];
    98	    var px = ox + x * cell, py = oy + y * cell, c = cell;
    99	
   100	    if (t === T.WATER) {
   101	      var wob = Math.sin(time * 1.3 + x * 0.7 + y * 0.5) * 0.5 + 0.5;
   102	      cx.fillStyle = '#17384f'; cx.fillRect(px, py, c, c);
   103	      cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,200,235,' + (0.05 + wob * 0.07) + ')';
   104	      cx.fillRect(px, py + c * 0.35, c, c * 0.22);
   105	      return;
   106	    }
   107	    if (t === T.HILL) {
   108	      cx.fillStyle = '#3c4440'; cx.fillRect(px, py, c, c);
   109	      cx.fillStyle = '#4d5750';
   110	      cx.beginPath(); cx.moveTo(px + c * 0.5, py + c * 0.18);
   111	      cx.lineTo(px + c * 0.88, py + c * 0.82); cx.lineTo(px + c * 0.12, py + c * 0.82);
   112	      cx.closePath(); cx.fill();
   113	      cx.fillStyle = '#5d6a63';
   114	      cx.beginPath(); cx.moveTo(px + c * 0.5, py + c * 0.18);
   115	      cx.lineTo(px + c * 0.5, py + c * 0.82); cx.lineTo(px + c * 0.12, py + c * 0.82);
   116	      cx.closePath(); cx.fill();
   117	      return;
   118	    }
   119	
   120	    cx.fillStyle = grassCol(k); cx.fillRect(px, py, c, c);
   121	
   122	    if (t === T.ROAD) {
   123	      var cong = s.load[k] > S.ROAD_CAP;
   124	      cx.fillStyle = cong ? '#5a3f3c' : '#454f55';
   125	      cx.fillRect(px, py, c, c);
   126	      cx.fillStyle = cong ? 'rgba(255,120,90,0.30)' : 'rgba(230,235,240,0.14)';
   127	      var m = c * 0.42;
   128	      if (x > 0 && s.t[k - 1] === T.ROAD) cx.fillRect(px, py + m, c * 0.6, c * 0.16);
   129	      if (x < W - 1 && s.t[k + 1] === T.ROAD) cx.fillRect(px + c * 0.4, py + m, c * 0.6, c * 0.16);
   130	      if (y > 0 && s.t[k - W] === T.ROAD) cx.fillRect(px + m, py, c * 0.16, c * 0.6);
   131	      if (y < H - 1 && s.t[k + W] === T.ROAD) cx.fillRect(px + m, py + c * 0.4, c * 0.16, c * 0.6);
   132	      cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)';
   133	      cx.fillRect(px, py, c, 1); cx.fillRect(px, py, 1, c);
   134	      return;
   135	    }
   136	    if (t === T.PARK) {
   137	      cx.fillStyle = '#3f6a35'; cx.fillRect(px + 1, py + 1, c - 2, c - 2);
   138	      cx.fillStyle = '#7ec24a';
   139	      var r = c * 0.17;
   140	      cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(px + c * 0.34, py + c * 0.38, r, 0, 6.284); cx.fill();
   141	      cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(px + c * 0.66, py + c * 0.60, r * 0.85, 0, 6.284); cx.fill();
   142	      cx.fillStyle = '#2f5228'; cx.fillRect(px + c * 0.32, py + c * 0.45, c * 0.05, c * 0.2);
   143	      return;
   144	    }
   145	    if (t === T.HOME || t === T.SHOP || t === T.POWER) drawBuilding(s, x, y, px, py, c, t, k);
