   110	      var an = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = spd * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9);
   111	      parts.push({
   112	        x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(an) * s, vy: Math.sin(an) * s - spd * 0.35,
   113	        l: life * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7), m: life, s: sz * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.9),
   114	        c: c, g: 1
   115	      });
   116	    }
   117	  }
   118	  function pop(x, y, txt, c) {
   119	    if (pops.length > 14) pops.shift();
   120	    pops.push({ x: x, y: y, t: txt, l: 1.1, c: c || '#ffd166' });
   121	  }
   122	  function kick(a) { shake = Math.min(26, shake + a); }
   123	
   124	  function mult() { return Math.min(9, 1 + Math.floor(G.combo / 2)); }
   125	  function award(pts, label, x, y, col) {
   126	    var m = mult();
   127	    var v = Math.round(pts * m);
   128	    G.score += v;
   129	    if (label) pop(x, y, label + '  +' + v, col);
   130	    G.combo++;
   131	    G.comboT = 5;
   132	    if (mult() > G.maxCombo) G.maxCombo = mult();
   133	    G.boost = Math.min(100, G.boost + 16);
   134	    SFX.trick(Math.min(4, Math.floor(G.combo / 2)));
   135	  }
   136	
   137	  // ---------- physics helpers ----------
   138	  function bodyPoints(b) {
   139	    var ca = Math.cos(b.a), sa = Math.sin(b.a), p = [];
   140	    var c = [[-HW, -HH], [HW, -HH], [HW, HH], [-HW, HH]];
   141	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   142	      p.push([b.x + c[i][0] * ca - c[i][1] * sa, b.y + c[i][0] * sa + c[i][1] * ca, c[i][0], c[i][1]]);
   143	    }
   144	    return p;
   145	  }
   146	
   147	  function crushObs(o, targetTop, impact, px) {
   148	    var top = o.top0 - o.h;
   149	    if (targetTop <= top + 1.5) return false;
   150	    if (o.tough) {
   151	      if (impact < 210) return false;
   152	      targetTop = top + Math.min(targetTop - top, 14 + impact * 0.05);
   153	    }
   154	    var nh = Math.max(0, o.top0 - targetTop);
   155	    if (nh >= o.h - 0.5) return false;
   156	    var removed = o.h - nh;
   157	    o.h = nh;
   158	    o.hit = 1;
   159	    o.wob = Math.min(1, o.wob + removed / 20);
   160	    if (!o.started) { o.started = true; G.crushes++; }
   161	    var big = o.tough || removed > 12;
   162	    G.score += Math.round(removed * 5 * mult());
   163	    spark(px, top + 4, big ? 16 : 9, o.type === 'bus' ? '#ffcf5a' : 'hsl(' + o.hue + ',60%,62%)', 190, 3.4, 0.55);
   164	    spark(px, top + 4, 6, '#cfd6e6', 150, 2.4, 0.4);
   165	    SFX.crush(big);
   166	    kick(big ? 13 : 7);
   167	    if (o.h <= 1.5 && !o.dead) {
   168	      o.dead = true;
   169	      G.flat++;
   170	      award(220, o.type === 'bus' ? 'BUS FLATTENED' : 'FLATTENED', px, top - 10, '#ff8f6b');
   171	      spark(px, top, 18, '#ffffff', 230, 3, 0.6);
   172	      kick(16);
   173	    }
   174	    return true;
   175	  }
   176	
   177	  // resolve deep horizontal penetration into a still-solid obstacle
   178	  function wallPass(b) {
   179	    var pts = bodyPoints(b);
   180	    for (var w = 0; w < 2; w++) pts.push([b.wheels[w].wx, b.wheels[w].wy + WR * 0.6, 0, 0]);
   181	    for (var k = 0; k < W.obs.length; k++) {
   182	      var o = W.obs[k];
   183	      if (o.h <= 1.5) continue;
   184	      var top = o.top0 - o.h, l = o.x - o.w * 0.5, r = o.x + o.w * 0.5;
   185	      for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
   186	        var p = pts[i];
   187	        if (p[0] < l || p[0] > r || p[1] < top + 16) continue;
   188	        // push out the near side
   189	        var dl = p[0] - l, dr = r - p[0];
   190	        if (dl < dr) { b.x -= Math.min(dl, 6); if (b.vx > 0) b.vx *= -0.15; }
   191	        else { b.x += Math.min(dr, 6); if (b.vx < 0) b.vx *= -0.15; }
   192	        b.av *= 0.9;
   193	        // grinding: sustained shoving chews through even tough obstacles
   194	        o.press = (o.press || 0) + 1;
   195	        if (o.press > 10) {
   196	          o.press = 0;
   197	          crushObs(o, top + 11, 9999, Math.max(l + 8, Math.min(r - 8, p[0])));
   198	        }
   199	        return;
   200	      }
   201	    }
   202	  }
   203	
   204	  function crushPass(b) {
   205	    var pts = [];
   206	    for (var w = 0; w < 2; w++) pts.push([b.wheels[w].wx, b.wheels[w].wy + WR]);
   207	    var bp = bodyPoints(b);
   208	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) pts.push([bp[i][0], bp[i][1]]);
   209	    var spd = Math.abs(b.vx), fall = Math.max(0, b.vy);
   210	    var impact = Math.max(spd * 0.8, fall);
   211	    for (var k = 0; k < W.obs.length; k++) {
   212	      var o = W.obs[k];
   213	      if (o.h <= 1.5) continue;
   214	      var top = o.top0 - o.h, l = o.x - o.w * 0.5, r = o.x + o.w * 0.5;
   215	      for (var j = 0; j < pts.length; j++) {
   216	        var p = pts[j];
   217	        if (p[0] < l || p[0] > r) continue;
   218	        if (p[1] > top + 1.5) { crushObs(o, p[1], impact, Math.max(l + 8, Math.min(r - 8, p[0]))); break; }
   219	      }
   220	    }
   221	  }
   222	
   223	  function step(dt) {
   224	    var b = truck;
   225	    var thr = 0, lean = 0;
   226	    var live = G.state === 'play' && G.wreck <= 0;
   227	    var L = K.l || touchL, R = K.r || touchR;
   228	    if (live) {
   229	      if (L && !R) thr = -1;
   230	      if (R && !L) thr = 1;
   231	      lean = thr;
   232	    }
   233	
   234	    // gravity
   235	    b.vy += GRAV * dt;
   236	
   237	    crushPass(b);
   238	    wallPass(b);
   239	
   240	    var contacts = 0, groundSpd = 0, wheelDown = [false, false];
   240	    var contacts = 0, groundSpd = 0, wheelDown = [false, false];
   241	    var ca = Math.cos(b.a), sa = Math.sin(b.a);
   242	    var dx = -sa, dy = ca; // body "down"
   243	
   244	    for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   245	      var wh = b.wheels[i];
   246	      var ax = b.x + wh.lx * ca - wh.ly * sa;
   247	      var ay = b.y + wh.lx * sa + wh.ly * ca;
   248	      var len = SUS_MAX, grounded = false, pen = 0;
   249	
   250	      if (dy > 0.25) {
   251	        var probe = W.at(ax + dx * SUS_MAX);
   252	        var Ln = (probe.y - WR - ay) / dy;
   253	        if (Ln < SUS_MAX) {
   254	          grounded = true;
   255	          len = Math.max(SUS_MIN, Ln);
   256	          if (Ln < SUS_MIN) pen = Math.min(30, SUS_MIN - Ln);
   257	        }
   258	      }
   259	      wh.len = len;
   260	      wh.wx = ax + dx * wh.len;
   261	      wh.wy = ay + dy * wh.len;
   262	      wh.grounded = grounded;
   263	      wh.comp = (SUS_MAX - wh.len) / (SUS_MAX - SUS_MIN);
   264	      wheelDown[i] = grounded;
   265	
   266	      if (grounded) {
   267	        contacts++;
   268	        var rx = ax - b.x, ry = ay - b.y;
   269	        var pvx = b.vx - b.av * ry, pvy = b.vy + b.av * rx;
   270	        var comp = SUS_MAX - len;
   271	        var vn = pvx * dx + pvy * dy; // + = compressing
   272	        var F = SUS_K * comp + 300 * pen + SUS_C * vn;
   273	        if (F < 0) F = 0;
   274	        if (F > 5200) F = 5200;
   275	        var fx = -dx * F, fy = -dy * F;
   276	        b.vx += fx / MASS * dt; b.vy += fy / MASS * dt;
   277	        b.av += (rx * fy - ry * fx) / INER * dt;
   278	
   279	        // ground tangent
   280	        var g2 = W.at(wh.wx);
   281	        var sl = g2.slope, nl = Math.sqrt(1 + sl * sl);
   282	        var tx = 1 / nl, ty = sl / nl;
   283	        var vt = pvx * tx + pvy * ty;
   284	        groundSpd += vt;
   285	        var drive = thr * ENGINE - vt * ROLL;
   286	        if (thr === 0) drive -= vt * 2.2;
   287	        var grip = Math.min(1, comp / 5);
   288	        var ftx = tx * drive * grip, fty = ty * drive * grip;
   289	        b.vx += ftx / MASS * dt; b.vy += fty / MASS * dt;
   290	        b.av += (rx * fty - ry * ftx) / INER * dt * 0.85;
   291	        wh.spin += vt / WR * dt;
   292	      } else {
   293	        wh.spin += (thr * 9 + b.vx / WR * 0.5) * dt;
   294	      }
   295	    }
   296	
   297	    // body corner collision (roof / nose scrape)
   298	    var pts = bodyPoints(b), bodyHit = false;
   299	    for (var c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
   300	      var p = pts[c];
   301	      var g = W.at(p[0]);
   302	      if (p[1] > g.y) {
   303	        bodyHit = true;
   304	        var depth = p[1] - g.y;
   305	        b.y -= Math.min(depth, 5) * 0.55;
   306	        var sl2 = g.slope, n2 = Math.sqrt(1 + sl2 * sl2);
   307	        var nx = sl2 / n2, ny = -1 / n2;
   308	        var rx2 = p[0] - b.x, ry2 = p[1] - b.y;
   309	        var pvx2 = b.vx - b.av * ry2, pvy2 = b.vy + b.av * rx2;
   310	        var vn2 = pvx2 * nx + pvy2 * ny;
   311	        if (vn2 < 0) {
   312	          var rn = rx2 * ny - ry2 * nx;
   313	          var jj = -(1.05) * vn2 / (1 / MASS + rn * rn / INER);
   314	          b.vx += jj * nx / MASS; b.vy += jj * ny / MASS;
   315	          b.av += (rx2 * (jj * ny) - ry2 * (jj * nx)) / INER;
   316	          if (vn2 < -140) { spark(p[0], p[1], 5, '#ffd166', 130, 2.2, 0.35); kick(4); }
   317	        }
   318	        // scrape friction
   319	        b.vx *= 1 - Math.min(0.5, 4 * dt);
   320	        b.av *= 1 - Math.min(0.6, 5 * dt);
   321	      }
   322	    }
   323	
   324	    // air control
   325	    if (contacts === 0 && !bodyHit) {
   326	      if (live) b.av -= lean * AIR_TQ * dt; // right throttle = nose up = backflip
   327	      b.av *= 1 - 0.10 * dt;
   328	      b.air += dt; b.airRot += b.av * dt;
   329	      b.grounded = 0;
   330	    } else {
   331	      b.av *= 1 - Math.min(0.85, 2.6 * dt);
   332	      b.grounded += dt;
   333	    }
   334	    if (b.av > AV_MAX) b.av = AV_MAX;
   335	    if (b.av < -AV_MAX) b.av = -AV_MAX;
   336	
   337	    // boost
   338	    var bReq = (K.b || touchB) && live && G.boost > 1;
   339	    G.boosting = bReq;
   340	    if (bReq) {
   341	      var f = 1900;
   342	      b.vx += Math.cos(b.a) * f * dt;
   343	      b.vy += Math.sin(b.a) * f * dt;
   344	      G.boost = Math.max(0, G.boost - 42 * dt);
   345	      b.flame = 1;
   346	      if (!step._bs) { SFX.boost(); step._bs = 1; }
   347	      if (Math.random() < 0.85) {
   348	        var ex = b.x - Math.cos(b.a) * 44, ey = b.y - Math.sin(b.a) * 44;
   349	        parts.push({ x: ex, y: ey, vx: -Math.cos(b.a) * 220 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60, vy: -Math.sin(b.a) * 220 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60, l: 0.3, m: 0.3, s: 4, c: '#5adcff', g: 0.1 });
   350	      }
   351	      kick(1.6);
   352	    } else { step._bs = 0; b.flame *= 0.85; }
   353	
   354	    // air drag
   355	    b.vx *= 1 - 0.12 * dt; b.vy *= 1 - 0.06 * dt;
   356	
   357	    // integrate
   358	    b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.a += b.av * dt;
   359	    if (b.a > Math.PI) b.a -= Math.PI * 2; else if (b.a < -Math.PI) b.a += Math.PI * 2;
   360	
   361	    // arena bounds
   362	    if (b.x < 40) { b.x = 40; b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx) * 0.3; }
   363	    if (b.x > W.w - 40) { b.x = W.w - 40; b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx) * 0.3; }
   364	    if (b.y > W.base + 500) { b.y = W.baseY(b.x) - 60; b.vy = 0; b.vx = 0; }
   365	
   366	    // dirt spray
   367	    if (contacts && Math.abs(b.vx) > 140 && Math.random() < 0.55) {
   368	      var wq = b.wheels[b.vx > 0 ? 0 : 1];
   369	      parts.push({
   370	        x: wq.wx, y: wq.wy + WR - 3, vx: -b.vx * 0.22 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
   371	        vy: -Math.random() * 110 - 20, l: 0.45, m: 0.45, s: 3, c: '#7a5c3a', g: 1
   372	      });
   373	    }
   374	
   375	    // ---- trick resolution ----
   376	    var upsideDown = Math.cos(b.a) < -0.25;
   377	    if (G.wreck <= 0 && G.state === 'play') {
   378	      if (b.air > 0 && (contacts > 0 || bodyHit)) {
   379	        // landed
   380	        var at = b.air, ar = b.airRot;
   381	        b.air = 0; b.airRot = 0;
   382	        G.airTotal += at;
   383	        if (upsideDown && at > 0.15) {
   384	          wreckOut();
   385	        } else if (at > 0.22) {
   386	          var fl = Math.floor(Math.abs(ar) / (Math.PI * 2 - 0.7));
   387	          if (fl > 0) {
   388	            G.flips += fl;
   389	            award(380 * fl, (ar < 0 ? 'BACKFLIP' : 'FRONTFLIP') + (fl > 1 ? ' x' + fl : ''), b.x, b.y - 60, '#7dffb0');
   390	            kick(9);
   391	          }
   392	          if (at > 0.55) {
   393	            award(Math.round(at * 130), at > 1.3 ? 'HUGE AIR' : 'AIR', b.x, b.y - 40, '#9fd0ff');
   394	          }
   395	          SFX.land(Math.abs(b.vy) + 200);
   396	          kick(Math.min(12, 3 + at * 5));
   397	          spark(b.x, b.y + 26, 8, '#8a6a44', 150, 2.6, 0.4);
   398	        } else if (bodyHit && upsideDown) {
   399	          wreckOut();
   400	        }
   401	      }
   402	      // beached: on the roof, or stood up on nose/tail and going nowhere
   403	      var beached = upsideDown || (Math.abs(b.a) > 1.15 && Math.abs(b.vx) < 70);
   404	      if (beached && (contacts > 0 || bodyHit) && b.air === 0 && Math.abs(b.av) < 3.2) {
   405	        b.rollT = (b.rollT || 0) + dt;
   406	        if (b.rollT > 0.4) wreckOut();
   407	      } else b.rollT = 0;
   408	
   409	      // wheelies
   410	      var one = (wheelDown[0] !== wheelDown[1]);
   411	      var nose = wheelDown[1] && !wheelDown[0] && b.a > 0.22;
   412	      var back = wheelDown[0] && !wheelDown[1] && b.a < -0.22;
   413	      if (one && (nose || back) && Math.abs(b.vx) > 40) {
   414	        b.wheelieT += dt;
   415	        G.score += Math.round(55 * mult() * dt);
   416	        G.comboT = Math.max(G.comboT, 1.2);
   417	        if (b.wheelieT > 0.75 && !b.wheelieAwarded) {
   418	          b.wheelieAwarded = true;
   419	          award(160, nose ? 'NOSE WHEELIE' : 'WHEELIE', b.x, b.y - 46, '#ffd166');
   420	        }
   421	      } else { b.wheelieT = 0; b.wheelieAwarded = false; }
   422	    }
   423	
   424	    // wreck recovery
   425	    if (G.wreck > 0) {
   426	      G.wreck -= dt;
   427	      var tgt = 0;
   428	      b.a += (tgt - b.a) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.2);
   429	      b.av *= 0.85;
   430	      b.vx *= 1 - Math.min(0.9, 3 * dt);
   431	      if (G.wreck <= 0) {
   432	        G.wreck = 0;
   433	        b.a = 0; b.av = 0; b.air = 0; b.airRot = 0;
   434	        b.y = Math.min(b.y, W.baseY(b.x) - 46);
   435	        b.vy = -80;
   436	      }
   437	    }
   438	
   439	    // combo decay
   440	    if (G.comboT > 0) { G.comboT -= dt; if (G.comboT <= 0) G.combo = 0; }
   441	
   442	    // engine sfx
   443	    SFX.engine(Math.abs(thr) + (G.boosting ? 0.6 : 0), Math.abs(b.vx), contacts === 0);
   444	
   445	    // timer
   446	    if (G.state === 'play') {
   447	      G.t -= dt;
   448	      if (G.t <= 0) { G.t = 0; endRun(); }
   449	    }
   450	  }
   451	
   452	  function wreckOut() {
   453	    if (G.wreck > 0) return;
   454	    G.wreck = 3;
   455	    G.combo = 0; G.comboT = 0;
   456	    truck.air = 0; truck.airRot = 0;
   457	    pop(truck.x, truck.y - 40, 'WRECKED  -3s', '#ff6b6b');
   458	    spark(truck.x, truck.y, 20, '#ff6b6b', 210, 3.2, 0.6);
   459	    kick(20);
   460	    SFX.wreck();
   461	  }
   462	
   463	  function endRun() {
   464	    G.state = 'over';
   465	    SFX.quiet();
   466	    SFX.over();
   467	    if (G.score > G.best) { G.best = G.score; saveBest(G.score); }
   468	    elFin.textContent = G.score.toLocaleString();
   469	    elBest.textContent = 'BEST ' + G.best.toLocaleString();
   470	    elStats.innerHTML =
   471	      'CRUSHED <b>' + G.crushes + '</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; FLATTENED <b>' + G.flat + '</b><br>' +
   472	      'FLIPS <b>' + G.flips + '</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; AIRTIME <b>' + G.airTotal.toFixed(1) + 's</b><br>' +
   473	      'BEST MULTIPLIER <b>x' + G.maxCombo + '</b>';
   474	    over.classList.add('show');
   475	  }

   477	  // ---------- rendering ----------
   478	  function resize() {
   479	    var dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
   480	    var w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight;
   481	    var bw = Math.round(w * dpr), bh = Math.round(h * dpr);
   482	    var long = Math.max(bw, bh);
   483	    if (long > 960) { var k = 960 / long; bw = Math.round(bw * k); bh = Math.round(bh * k); }
   484	    cv.width = bw; cv.height = bh;
   485	    cw = bw; ch = bh;
   486	    S = cw / 390;
   487	    zoom = Math.min(cw / 440, ch / 640);
   488	    zoom = Math.max(zoom, cw / 1000);
   489	  }
   490	  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   491	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { setTimeout(resize, 120); });
   492	
   493	  var skyGrad = null, skyKey = '';
   494	  function sky() {
   495	    var key = cw + 'x' + ch;
   496	    if (skyKey !== key) {
   497	      skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, ch);
   498	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1b1f33');
   499	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#2e2a45');
   500	      skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5a3f4e');
   501	      skyKey = key;
   502	    }
   503	    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
   504	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
   505	  }
   506	
   507	  var OX = 0, OY = 0;
   508	  function sx(x) { return (x - cam.x) * zoom + OX; }
   509	  function sy(y) { return (y - cam.y) * zoom + OY; }
   510	
   511	  function drawTerrain() {
   512	    var vw = viewW();
   513	    var x0 = cam.x - vw * 0.6, x1 = cam.x + vw * 0.6;
   514	    x0 = Math.max(-200, x0); x1 = Math.min(W.w + 200, x1);
   515	    ctx.beginPath();
   516	    ctx.moveTo(sx(x0), ch + 10);
   517	    var stp = 7;
   518	    for (var x = x0; x <= x1; x += stp) ctx.lineTo(sx(x), sy(W.baseY(x)));
   519	    ctx.lineTo(sx(x1), ch + 10);
   520	    ctx.closePath();
   520	    ctx.closePath();
   521	    var gr = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, sy(W.base - 380), 0, sy(W.base + 120));
   522	    gr.addColorStop(0, '#6b5236');
   523	    gr.addColorStop(0.35, '#4e3c28');
   524	    gr.addColorStop(1, '#2c2419');
   525	    ctx.fillStyle = gr; ctx.fill();
   526	    // top edge
   527	    ctx.beginPath();
   528	    for (var x2 = x0, first = true; x2 <= x1; x2 += stp) {
   529	      var px = sx(x2), py = sy(W.baseY(x2));
   530	      if (first) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); first = false; } else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
   531	    }
   532	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#a5834f'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 3 * zoom * 0.6); ctx.stroke();
   533	  }
   534	
   535	  function drawDeco() {
   536	    ctx.save();
   537	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.32;
   538	    for (var i = 0; i < W.deco.length; i++) {
   539	      var d = W.deco[i];
   540	      var px = (d.x - cam.x) * zoom * 0.45 + OX;
   541	      if (px < -80 || px > cw + 80) continue;
   542	      var base = sy(W.base + 30);
   543	      var hh = d.h * zoom * 0.8;
   544	      ctx.fillStyle = '#171a2b';
   545	      ctx.fillRect(px - 16 * d.s * zoom, base - hh, 32 * d.s * zoom, hh);
   546	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
   547	      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.10;
   548	      for (var r = 1; r < 4; r++) ctx.fillRect(px - 8 * d.s * zoom, base - hh + r * 14 * zoom, 5 * zoom, 6 * zoom);
   549	      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.32;
   550	    }
   551	    ctx.restore();
   552	  }
   553	
   554	  function drawObs() {
   555	    for (var i = 0; i < W.obs.length; i++) {
   556	      var o = W.obs[i];
   557	      var px = sx(o.x);
   558	      if (px < -160 || px > cw + 160) continue;
   559	      var top = o.top0 - o.h;
   560	      var wpx = o.w * zoom, hpx = Math.max(2, o.h * zoom);
   561	      var flat = 1 - o.h / o.h0;
   562	      o.hit *= 0.86;
   563	      var sat = o.type === 'bus' ? 55 : 58;
   564	      var lum = 46 - flat * 16;
   565	      ctx.save();
   566	      ctx.translate(px, sy(o.top0));
   567	      var wob = Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.02) * o.wob * 2 * zoom;
   568	      o.wob *= 0.93;
   569	      ctx.translate(wob, 0);
   570	      // body
   571	      ctx.fillStyle = o.hit > 0.15 ? '#fff' : 'hsl(' + o.hue + ',' + sat + '%,' + lum + '%)';
   572	      ctx.fillRect(-wpx / 2, -hpx, wpx, hpx);
   573	      // roof highlight
   574	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.14 + o.hit * 0.5) + ')';
   575	      ctx.fillRect(-wpx / 2, -hpx, wpx, Math.max(1.5, hpx * 0.22));
   576	      // dark base
   577	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)';
   578	      ctx.fillRect(-wpx / 2, -Math.max(1.5, hpx * 0.16), wpx, Math.max(1.5, hpx * 0.16));
   579	      // windows
   580	      if (o.h > o.h0 * 0.4) {
   581	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,220,255,.30)';
   582	        if (o.type === 'bus') {
   583	          for (var k = 0; k < 5; k++) ctx.fillRect(-wpx / 2 + wpx * 0.08 + k * wpx * 0.172, -hpx * 0.78, wpx * 0.12, hpx * 0.34);
   584	        } else {
   585	          ctx.fillRect(-wpx * 0.26, -hpx * 0.82, wpx * 0.5, hpx * 0.34);
   586	        }
   587	      }
   588	      // crumple lines
   589	      if (flat > 0.15) {
   590	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, zoom);
   591	        for (var q = 1; q < 4; q++) {
   592	          ctx.beginPath();
   593	          ctx.moveTo(-wpx / 2 + wpx * q / 4, -hpx);
   594	          ctx.lineTo(-wpx / 2 + wpx * q / 4 + (q % 2 ? 3 : -3) * zoom, 0);
   595	          ctx.stroke();
   596	        }
   597	      }
   598	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.4 * zoom);
   599	      ctx.strokeRect(-wpx / 2, -hpx, wpx, hpx);
   600	      ctx.restore();
   601	    }
   602	  }
   603	
   604	  function drawTruck() {
   605	    var b = truck, ang = b.a;
   606	    // wheels (world space - they ride the suspension)
   607	    for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   608	      var wh = b.wheels[i];
   609	      var wx = sx(wh.wx), wy = sy(wh.wy), r = WR * zoom;
   610	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(wx, wy, r, 0, 6.2832);
   611	      ctx.fillStyle = '#15161d'; ctx.fill();
   612	      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, r * 0.28);
   613	      ctx.strokeStyle = wh.grounded ? '#3d4152' : '#2a2d3a';
   614	      ctx.stroke();
   615	      // treads
   616	      ctx.save();
   617	      ctx.translate(wx, wy); ctx.rotate(wh.spin);
   618	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4f63'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, r * 0.14);
   619	      for (var k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
   620	        var a2 = k * 1.2566;
   621	        ctx.beginPath();
   622	        ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a2) * r * 0.28, Math.sin(a2) * r * 0.28);
   623	        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a2) * r * 0.86, Math.sin(a2) * r * 0.86);
   624	        ctx.stroke();
   625	      }
   626	      ctx.fillStyle = '#8d93a8';
   627	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r * 0.24, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   628	      ctx.restore();
   629	      // suspension link
   630	      var ca2 = Math.cos(ang), sa2 = Math.sin(ang);
   631	      var ax = sx(b.x + wh.lx * ca2 - wh.ly * sa2), ay = sy(b.y + wh.lx * sa2 + wh.ly * ca2);
   632	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ax, ay); ctx.lineTo(wx, wy);
   633	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6f7591'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 3.5 * zoom); ctx.stroke();
   634	    }
   635	
   636	    // body
   637	    ctx.save();
   638	    ctx.translate(sx(b.x), sy(b.y));
   639	    ctx.rotate(ang);
   640	    var hw = HW * zoom, hh = HH * zoom;
   641	    // flame
   642	    if (b.flame > 0.05) {
   643	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(90,220,255,' + (0.5 * b.flame) + ')';
   644	      ctx.beginPath();
   645	      ctx.moveTo(-hw, -hh * 0.3); ctx.lineTo(-hw - (18 + Math.random() * 16) * zoom, 0); ctx.lineTo(-hw, hh * 0.5);
   646	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   647	    }
   648	    var gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -hh, 0, hh);
   649	    gg.addColorStop(0, '#e8ecfa'); gg.addColorStop(0.5, '#b9c0d6'); gg.addColorStop(1, '#6d7490');
   650	    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
   651	    ctx.beginPath();
   652	    var rr = 5 * zoom;
   653	    ctx.moveTo(-hw + rr, -hh);
   654	    ctx.lineTo(hw - rr, -hh); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hw, -hh, hw, -hh + rr);
   655	    ctx.lineTo(hw, hh - rr); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hw, hh, hw - rr, hh);
   656	    ctx.lineTo(-hw + rr, hh); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-hw, hh, -hw, hh - rr);
   657	    ctx.lineTo(-hw, -hh + rr); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-hw, -hh, -hw + rr, -hh);
   658	    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   659	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#20232e'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 2 * zoom); ctx.stroke();
   660	    // cab
   661	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
   662	    ctx.fillRect(-hw * 0.1, -hh * 1.75, hw * 0.72, hh * 0.85);
   663	    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3040';
   664	    ctx.fillRect(hw * 0.12, -hh * 1.6, hw * 0.42, hh * 0.5);
   665	    // roll bar
   666	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff8f6b'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 2.4 * zoom);
   667	    ctx.beginPath();
   668	    ctx.moveTo(-hw * 0.55, -hh); ctx.lineTo(-hw * 0.25, -hh * 1.9); ctx.lineTo(hw * 0.05, -hh * 1.9);
   669	    ctx.stroke();
   670	    // stripe
   671	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8f6b';
   672	    ctx.fillRect(-hw, -hh * 0.15, hw * 2, hh * 0.3);
   673	    ctx.restore();
   674	  }
   675	
   676	  function drawParticles(dt) {
   677	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   678	      var p = parts[i];
   679	      p.l -= dt;
   680	      if (p.l <= 0) { parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   681	      p.vy += GRAV * 0.55 * p.g * dt;
   682	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   683	      var a = Math.max(0, p.l / p.m);
   684	      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
   685	      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
   686	      var s = p.s * zoom * (0.5 + a * 0.7);
   687	      ctx.fillRect(sx(p.x) - s / 2, sy(p.y) - s / 2, s, s);
   688	    }
   689	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   690	  }
   691	
   692	  function drawPops(dt) {
   693	    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   694	    for (var i = pops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   695	      var p = pops[i];
   696	      p.l -= dt;
   697	      if (p.l <= 0) { pops.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   698	      var t = 1 - p.l / 1.1;
   699	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, p.l * 2.2);
   700	      ctx.font = '800 ' + (13 * S) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   701	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
   702	      ctx.fillText(p.t, sx(p.x) + 1.5, sy(p.y) - t * 46 * zoom + 1.5);
   703	      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
   704	      ctx.fillText(p.t, sx(p.x), sy(p.y) - t * 46 * zoom);
   705	    }
   706	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   707	  }
   708

   715	    ctx.fillText(G.score.toLocaleString(), pad + 2, pad + 28 * S + 2);
   716	    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   717	    ctx.fillText(G.score.toLocaleString(), pad, pad + 28 * S);
   718	    ctx.font = '700 ' + (10 * S) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   719	    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a91a8';
   720	    ctx.fillText('BEST ' + G.best.toLocaleString(), pad, pad + 42 * S);
   721

   723	    ctx.textAlign = 'right';

   736	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
   737	      ctx.fillRect(cw - pad - bw, by, bw * Math.max(0, G.comboT / 5), bh);
   738	    }
   739	
   740	    // wreck notice
   741	    if (G.wreck > 0) {
   742	      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   743	      ctx.font = '900 ' + (18 * S) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   744	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
   745	      ctx.fillText('RECOVERING  ' + G.wreck.toFixed(1), cw / 2, ch * 0.32);
   746	    }
   747	
   748	    // hint
   749	    if (hintT > 0) {
   750	      ctx.textAlign = 'center';

   755	      ctx.fillStyle = '#e8ecfa';

   757	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   758	    }
   759

   761	    var pw = cw * 0.42, px0 = cw / 2 - pw / 2, py0 = pad + 6 * S;
   762	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.12)';
   763	    ctx.fillRect(px0, py0, pw, 3 * S);
   764	    ctx.fillStyle = '#5adcff';
   765	    ctx.fillRect(px0 + pw * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, truck.x / W.w)) - 2 * S, py0 - 1.5 * S, 4 * S, 6 * S);
   766	  }
   767	
   768	  // ---------- loop ----------
   769	  function frame(now) {
   770	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   771	    if (!lastT) lastT = now;
   772	    var dt = (now - lastT) / 1000;
   773	    lastT = now;
   774	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   775	    if (dt <= 0) return;
   776	
   777	    if (G.state === 'play') {
   778	      var sub = Math.min(5, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(dt / 0.009)));
   779	      for (var i = 0; i < sub; i++) step(dt / sub);
   780	    } else {
   781	      SFX.engine(0, 0, false);
   782	    }
   783	    if (hintT > 0) hintT -= dt;
   784	
   785	    // camera
   786	    var tx = truck.x + truck.vx * 0.22;
   787	    var ty = truck.y - 30;
   788	    var gy = W.baseY(truck.x);
   789	    if (ty > gy - 60) ty = gy - 60;
   790	    cam.x += (tx - cam.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 6.5);
   791	    cam.y += (ty - cam.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
   792	    var halfW = viewW() / 2;
   793	    if (cam.x < halfW - 40) cam.x = halfW - 40;
   794	    if (cam.x > W.w - halfW + 40) cam.x = W.w - halfW + 40;
   795	
   796	    shake *= 1 - Math.min(0.9, 6 * dt);
   797	    OX = cw / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * S;
   798	    OY = ch * 0.62 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * S;
   799	
   800	    // draw
   801	    sky();
   802	    drawDeco();
   803	    drawTerrain();
   804	    drawObs();
   805	    drawParticles(dt);
   806	    drawTruck();
   807	    drawPops(dt);
   808	    hud();
   809	
   810	    // boost meter DOM
   811	    bfill.style.width = G.boost.toFixed(0) + '%';
   812	    if (G.boost < 2) bBoost.classList.add('empty'); else bBoost.classList.remove('empty');
   813	  }
   814	
   815	  resize();
   816	  reset((Math.random() * 1e9) | 0);
   817	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   818	})();
--- world.js ---
     1	// Stomp Circuit - procedural arena
     2	var World = (function () {
     3	  var STEP = 8;
     4	
     5	  function rngFrom(seed) {
     6	    var a = seed >>> 0;
     7	    return function () {
     8	      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
     9	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    10	      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    11	      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    12	    };
    13	  }
    14	
    15	  function make(seed) {
    16	    var R = rngFrom(seed);
    17	    var w = 3600, base = 520;
    18	    var n = Math.ceil(w / STEP) + 1;
    19	    var h = new Float32Array(n); // height above base (positive = up)
    20	    var i, j;
    21	
    22	    function bump(cx, halfw, amp, pow) {
    23	      var i0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((cx - halfw) / STEP));
    24	      var i1 = Math.min(n - 1, Math.ceil((cx + halfw) / STEP));
    25	      for (var k = i0; k <= i1; k++) {
    26	        var t = (k * STEP - cx) / halfw;
    27	        if (t < -1 || t > 1) continue;
    28	        var f = Math.cos(t * Math.PI * 0.5);
    29	        h[k] += amp * Math.pow(f, pow || 1.6);
    30	      }
    31	    }
    32	    // kicker ramp: rise to amp over len, sharp lip, drop back
    33	    function ramp(x0, len, amp, dir) {
    34	      var i0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(x0 / STEP));
    35	      var i1 = Math.min(n - 1, Math.ceil((x0 + len) / STEP));
    36	      for (var k = i0; k <= i1; k++) {
    37	        var t = (k * STEP - x0) / len;
    38	        t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    39	        var u = dir > 0 ? t : 1 - t;
    40	        h[k] += amp * Math.pow(u, 2.0);
    41	      }
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    // rolling base noise
    45	    var p1 = R() * 100, p2 = R() * 100;
    46	    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    47	      var x = i * STEP;
    48	      h[i] = Math.sin(x * 0.0035 + p1) * 9 + Math.sin(x * 0.0091 + p2) * 5;
    49	    }
    50	
    51	    var obs = [];
    52	    function car(x, y, tier) {
    53	      var cw = 50 + Math.floor(R() * 14);
    54	      obs.push({ x: x, w: cw, h: 24, h0: 24, top0: y, type: 'car', tier: tier, hue: Math.floor(R() * 360), dead: false, hit: 0, wob: 0 });
    55	    }
    56	
    57	    // ---- features laid out left to right ----
    58	    var cx = 300;
    59	    var feats = [];
    60	    // guaranteed: at least 2 car stacks, 1 bus, 2 ramps, mounds
    61	    var plan = ['ramp', 'stack', 'mound', 'ramp', 'bus', 'stack', 'mound', 'ramp', 'stack'];
    62	    // shuffle tail lightly but keep bus in the middle-ish
    63	    for (i = plan.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    64	      if (plan[i] === 'bus' || plan[i - 1] === 'bus') continue;
    65	      j = Math.floor(R() * (i + 1));
    66	      if (plan[j] === 'bus') continue;
    67	      var t = plan[i]; plan[i] = plan[j]; plan[j] = t;
    68	    }
    69	
    70	    for (i = 0; i < plan.length; i++) {
    71	      var kind = plan[i];
    72	      var gap = 90 + R() * 70;
    73	      if (kind === 'mound') {
    74	        var hw = 90 + R() * 70, amp = 42 + R() * 46;
    75	        bump(cx + hw, hw, amp, 1.5);
    76	        feats.push({ t: 'mound', x: cx + hw });
    77	        cx += hw * 2 + gap;
    78	      } else if (kind === 'ramp') {
    79	        var rl = 108 + R() * 58, ra = 95 + R() * 52, dir = R() < 0.72 ? 1 : -1;
    80	        ramp(cx, rl, ra, dir);
    81	        feats.push({ t: 'ramp', x: cx + rl * 0.5 });
    82	        cx += rl + gap + 40;
    83	      } else if (kind === 'stack') {
    84	        feats.push({ t: 'stack', x: cx + 40 });
    85	        cx += 130 + gap;
    86	      } else if (kind === 'bus') {
    87	        // launch ramp then the bus then a landing mound
    88	        ramp(cx, 140, 124, 1);
    89	        feats.push({ t: 'ramp', x: cx + 65 });
    90	        cx += 130 + 70;
    91	        feats.push({ t: 'bus', x: cx + 85 });
    92	        cx += 240;
    93	        bump(cx + 100, 120, 52, 1.4);
    94	        cx += 240 + gap;
    95	      }
    96	      if (cx > w - 620) break;
    97	    }
    98	
    99	    // end bowls (quarter-pipe walls so you can turn around)
   100	    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   101	      var xx = i * STEP;
   102	      var d = Math.min(xx, w - xx);
   103	      if (d < 260) {
   104	        var u = 1 - d / 260;
   105	        h[i] += Math.pow(u, 2.4) * 340;
   106	      }
   107	    }
   108	
   109	    // no unclimbable vertical steps in either travel direction (~56 deg cap)
   110	    var MR = 15;
   111	    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) if (h[i] > h[i - 1] + MR) h[i] = h[i - 1] + MR;
   112	    for (i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) if (h[i] > h[i + 1] + MR) h[i] = h[i + 1] + MR;
   113	
   114	    function baseY(x) {
   115	      var fi = x / STEP;
   116	      var i0 = Math.floor(fi);
   117	      if (i0 < 0) i0 = 0; if (i0 > n - 2) i0 = n - 2;
   118	      var f = fi - i0;
   119	      return base - (h[i0] * (1 - f) + h[i0 + 1] * f);
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    // place obstacles now that terrain exists
   123	    for (i = 0; i < feats.length; i++) {
   124	      var F = feats[i];
   125	      if (F.t === 'stack') {
   126	        var cols = 1 + (R() < 0.55 ? 1 : 0);
   127	        var rows = 1 + Math.floor(R() * 3);
   128	        for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
   129	          var sx = F.x + c * 66;
   130	          var gy = baseY(sx);
   131	          for (var rw = 0; rw < rows; rw++) car(sx, gy - rw * 24, rw);
   132	        }
   133	      } else if (F.t === 'bus') {
   134	        var by = baseY(F.x);

   163	        var y = baseY(x);
   164	        var slope;

   174	        }
   175	        return { y: y, slope: slope, obs: solid };
   176	      }
   177	    };
   178	    return W;
   179	  }

    66	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + 260, this.gy, 'street');
    67	    var n = irnd(1, 3);
    68	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) this.obs.push({ x: this.gx + 90 + i * 40, y: this.gy - 22, w: 14, h: 22, k: 'cone' });
    69	    this.gx += 260;
    70	    this.flat(rnd(120, 190));
    71	  },
    72	  fCar: function (d) {
    73	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + 420, this.gy, 'street');
    74	    var moving = Math.random() < 0.45;
    75	    this.cars.push({
    76	      x: this.gx + 150, y: this.gy - 52, w: 120, h: 52,
    77	      vx: moving ? -rnd(50, 110) : 0, hue: pick([8, 42, 190, 320, 265])
    78	    });
    79	    this.gx += 420;
    80	    this.flat(rnd(130, 200));
    81	  },
    82	  fRamp: function () {
    83	    var len = 130, rise = 42;
    84	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + len, this.gy - rise, 'ramp');
    85	    this.gx += len; this.gy -= rise;
    86	    this.flat(rnd(180, 300));
    87	  },
    88	  fDrop: function () { // curb drop
    89	    this.gy += 26;
    90	    this.flat(rnd(220, 340));
    91	  },
    92	
    93	  gen: function (aheadX, dist) {
    94	    var d = clamp(dist / 3000, 0, 1);
    95	    var guard = 0;
    96	    while (this.gx < aheadX && guard++ < 40) {
    97	      // keep the street from wandering off the bottom of the world
    98	      if (this.gy > 520) { this.fRamp(); this.lastKind = 'ramp'; continue; }
    99	      if (this.gy < -260) { this.fDrop(); this.lastKind = 'drop'; continue; }
   100	
   101	      var bag = ['rail', 'ledge', 'stairs', 'gap', 'hydrant', 'car', 'cone', 'flat'];
   102	      if (d > 0.25) bag.push('rail', 'stairs', 'gap');
   103	      if (d > 0.5) bag.push('ledge', 'car', 'gap', 'stairs');
   104	      var k = pick(bag);
   105	      if (k === this.lastKind && Math.random() < 0.7) k = 'flat';
   106	      this.lastKind = k;
   107	      if (k === 'rail') this.fRail(d);
   108	      else if (k === 'ledge') this.fLedge(d);
   109	      else if (k === 'stairs') this.fStairs(d);
   110	      else if (k === 'gap') this.fGap(d);
   111	      else if (k === 'hydrant') this.fHydrant();
   112	      else if (k === 'cone') this.fCone();
   113	      else if (k === 'car') this.fCar(d);
   114	      else this.flat(rnd(200, 380));
   115	      if (Math.random() < 0.22) { this.props.push({ x: this.gx - rnd(40, 160), y: this.gy, k: pick(['hyd', 'post', 'trash']) }); }
   116	    }
   117	  },
   118	
   119	  prune: function (x) {
   120	    var i;
   121	    for (i = this.segs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.segs[i].x1 < x) this.segs.splice(i, 1);
   122	    for (i = this.obs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.obs[i].x + this.obs[i].w < x) this.obs.splice(i, 1);
   123	    for (i = this.cars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.cars[i].x + this.cars[i].w < x) this.cars.splice(i, 1);
   124	    for (i = this.props.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.props[i].x < x) this.props.splice(i, 1);
   125	  },
   126	
   127	  update: function (dt) {
   128	    for (var i = 0; i < this.cars.length; i++) { var c = this.cars[i]; if (c.vx) c.x += c.vx * dt; }
   129	  },
   130	
   131	  segY: function (s, x) {
   132	    if (s.y0 === s.y1) return s.y0;
   133	    return s.y0 + (s.y1 - s.y0) * ((x - s.x0) / (s.x1 - s.x0));
   134	  },
   135	
   136	  // every walkable surface height at x -> array of {y, seg}
   137	  surfaces: function (x, out) {
   138	    out.length = 0;
   139	    for (var i = 0; i < this.segs.length; i++) {
   140	      var s = this.segs[i];
   141	      if (x >= s.x0 && x <= s.x1) out.push({ y: this.segY(s, x), s: s });
   142	    }
   143	    for (var j = 0; j < this.cars.length; j++) {
   144	      var c = this.cars[j];
   145	      if (x >= c.x + 6 && x <= c.x + c.w - 6) out.push({ y: c.y, s: { k: 'roof', x0: c.x, x1: c.x + c.w, car: c } });
   146	    }
   147	    return out;
   148	  }
   149	};

     9	  var cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
    10	  var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

    14	  cv.width = Math.round(cw * dpr);
    15	  cv.height = Math.round(ch * dpr);

    17	  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;

    44	function reset() {
    45	  World.reset();
    46	  P = {
    47	    x: 0, y: 0, vy: 0, v: 280,
    48	    onGround: true, seg: null,
    49	    rot: 0, flip: 0, trick: null, tt: 0, trickRot0: 0, trickFlip0: 0,
    50	    grind: false, grindSeg: null, bal: 0, balv: 0, grindPts: 0, grindT: 0,
    51	    wobble: 0, airT: 0, lastLand: 0,
    52	    combo: [], comboSum: 0,
    53	    rag: null, tuck: 0, groundRef: 0
    54	  };
    55	  score = 0; distPx = 0; shake = 0; flash = 0;
    56	  popups.length = 0; Parts.reset();
    57	  camX = -W * 0.30; camY = -H * 0.66;
    58	  World.gen(P.x + W * 2, 0);
    59	  state = 'run'; tHint = 0;
    60	  SFX.grindStop();

    63	/* ---------------- combo / scoring ---------------- */
    64	function pop(t, sub) {
    65	  popups.push({ t: 0, txt: t, sub: sub });
    66	  if (popups.length > 4) popups.shift();
    67	}
    68	function addCombo(name, val) {
    69	  P.combo.push(name); P.comboSum += val;
    70	  pop(name, '+' + val);
    71	}
    72	function bankCombo(mulOK) {
    73	  if (!P.combo.length) return;
    74	  var mult = mulOK ? P.combo.length : 1;
    75	  var got = Math.round(P.comboSum * mult);
    76	  score += got;
    77	  pop(mult > 1 ? 'x' + mult + ' LANDED' : 'LANDED', '+' + got);
    78	  flash = 0.3; flashCol = mult > 2 ? '#7bf7c0' : '#ffe08a';
    79	  SFX.chime(Math.min(mult, 6));
    80	  P.combo.length = 0; P.comboSum = 0;
    81	}

    83	/* ---------------- tricks ---------------- */
    84	function startTrick(i) {
    85	  var t = TRICKS[i];
    86	  if (!t || P.trick) return;
    87	  P.trick = t; P.tt = 0; P.trickRot0 = P.rot; P.trickFlip0 = P.flip;
    88	  if (t.boost && P.vy > -120) P.vy += t.boost;
    89	  P.tuck = (i === 3) ? 1 : 0;
    90	  SFX.trick(i);
    91	  Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y - 10, 5, { c: '#8fd6ff', s0: 1.5, s1: 3, g: 200, l1: 0.35 });
    92	}
    93	
    94	function popOff(power) {
    95	  P.onGround = false; P.grind = false;
    96	  if (P.grindSeg) endGrind();
    97	  P.vy = -power;
    98	  P.airT = 0;
    99	  SFX.ollie();
   100	  Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y, 7, { c: '#cfd6e6', vy0: -40, vy1: 40, s0: 1.5, s1: 3, l1: 0.4 });
   101	}

   103	/* ---------------- grind ---------------- */
   104	function startGrind(s, y) {
   105	  P.grind = true; P.grindSeg = s; P.y = y; P.vy = 0; P.onGround = false;
   106	  P.bal = rnd(-0.12, 0.12); P.balv = 0; P.grindPts = 0; P.grindT = 0;
   107	  P.trick = null; P.rot = 0; P.flip = 0;
   108	  SFX.grindStart();
   109	  pop(s.k === 'rail' ? 'RAIL SLIDE' : 'LEDGE GRIND', 'HOLD IT');
   110	}
   111	function endGrind() {
   112	  if (P.grindPts > 0) addCombo('GRIND ' + Math.round(P.grindT * 10) / 10 + 's', Math.round(P.grindPts));
   113	  P.grind = false; P.grindSeg = null; P.grindPts = 0;
   114	  SFX.grindStop();
   115	}

   117	/* ---------------- bail ---------------- */
   118	function bail(reason) {
   119	  if (state !== 'run') return;
   120	  state = 'bail';
   121	  SFX.grindStop(); SFX.bail();
   122	  P.combo.length = 0; P.comboSum = 0;
   123	  shake = 18; flash = 0.45; flashCol = '#ff5b6e';
   124	  P.rag = {
   125	    x: P.x, y: P.y - 16, vx: P.v * 0.55, vy: -rnd(220, 380), rot: P.rot, rv: rnd(-9, 9),
   126	    bx: P.x, by: P.y, bvx: P.v * 0.8 + rnd(0, 120), bvy: -rnd(160, 300), brot: 0, brv: rnd(-14, 14),
   127	    t: 0, reason: reason
   128	  };
   129	  Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y - 14, 26, { c: '#ff8fa0', vx0: -180, vx1: 220, vy0: -320, vy1: 40, s0: 2, s1: 5, l1: 0.9, sq: true });
   130	  Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y, 14, { c: '#cfd6e6', vx0: -120, vx1: 180, vy0: -160, vy1: 0, l1: 0.7 });
   131	}
   132	
   133	function gameOver() {
   134	  state = 'over';
   135	  if (total() > best) {
   136	    best = total();
   137	    try { localStorage.setItem('curbside.best', String(best)); } catch (e) { }
   138	  }
   139	}
   140	
   141	/* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   142	function update(dt) {
   143	  timeAll += dt; tHint += dt;
   144	  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 48);
   145	  flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.9);
   146	  for (var i = popups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { popups[i].t += dt; if (popups[i].t > 1.3) popups.splice(i, 1); }
   147	  Parts.update(dt);
   148	  World.update(dt);
   149	
   150	  if (state === 'run') updateRun(dt);
   151	  else if (state === 'bail') {
   152	    var r = P.rag; r.t += dt;
   153	    P.v *= Math.pow(0.16, dt);
   154	    var groundY = bestSurfaceY(r.x);
   155	    r.vy += G * dt; r.x += r.vx * dt; r.y += r.vy * dt; r.rot += r.rv * dt; r.vx *= Math.pow(0.55, dt);
   156	    if (groundY !== null && r.y > groundY - 12) { r.y = groundY - 12; r.vy *= -0.34; r.rv *= 0.5; r.vx *= 0.6; if (Math.abs(r.vy) > 60) Parts.spawn(r.x, groundY, 5, { c: '#9aa4bb', l1: 0.4 }); }
   157	    var gb = bestSurfaceY(r.bx);
   158	    r.bvy += G * dt; r.bx += r.bvx * dt; r.by += r.bvy * dt; r.brot += r.brv * dt; r.bvx *= Math.pow(0.7, dt);
   159	    if (gb !== null && r.by > gb - 3) { r.by = gb - 3; r.bvy *= -0.4; r.brv *= 0.6; }
   160	    camX = lerp(camX, r.x - W * 0.34, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt));
   161	    camY = lerp(camY, r.y - H * 0.6, 1 - Math.pow(0.004, dt));
   162	    if (r.t > 1.15) gameOver();
   163	    if (r.t > 0.4 && (Input.tapPress || Input.tapQuick)) { gameOver(); }
   164	  } else if (state === 'over') {
   165	    if (Input.tapPress || Input.tapQuick) reset();
   166	  }
   167	}
   168	
   169	function bestSurfaceY(x) {
   170	  World.surfaces(x, surfBuf);
   171	  var y = null;
   172	  for (var i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) if (y === null || surfBuf[i].y > y) y = surfBuf[i].y;
   173	  return y;
   174	}
   175	
   176	function updateRun(dt) {
   177	  var i, s;
   178	  // ---- speed ----
   179	  P.v = clamp(P.v + 5 * dt, 240, 660);
   180	  P.x += P.v * dt;
   181	  distPx += P.v * dt;
   182	  P.wobble = Math.max(0, P.wobble - dt * 2.5);
   183	
   184	  World.gen(P.x + W * 2.2, distPx);
   185	  World.prune(P.x - W * 1.2);
   186	
   187	  // ---- input ----
   188	  var sw = Input.swipe;
   189	  if (P.grind) {
   190	    if (Input.tapQuick) { addCombo('POP OUT', 40); popOff(600); }
   191	  } else if (P.onGround) {
   192	    if (Input.tapPress) popOff(660);
   193	  } else {
   194	    if (sw === 3) {
   195	      if (!tryLatchGrind()) startTrick(3);
   196	    } else if (sw) startTrick(sw);
   197	  }
   198	
   199	  // ---- grinding ----
   200	  if (P.grind) {
   201	    var gs = P.grindSeg;
   202	    P.grindT += dt;
   203	    var pts = 45 * dt * (1 + P.grindT * 0.5);
   204	    P.grindPts += pts;
   205	    P.y = World.segY(gs, clamp(P.x, gs.x0, gs.x1));
   206	    // balance
   207	    var ctrl = Input.balance();
   208	    P.balv += (P.bal * 3.4 + Math.sin(timeAll * 7.3) * 0.35 + rnd(-1.1, 1.1)) * dt;
   209	    P.balv -= ctrl * 4.6 * dt;
   210	    P.balv = clamp(P.balv, -3.2, 3.2);
   211	    P.bal += P.balv * dt;
   212	    if (Math.abs(P.bal) >= 1) { bail('lost balance'); return; }
   213	    P.groundRef = P.y;
   214	    Parts.spawn(P.x - 10, P.y, 1, { c: '#ffe66d', vx0: -220, vx1: -60, vy0: -120, vy1: -20, s0: 1, s1: 2.4, l1: 0.35, g: 700 });
   215	    if (P.x > gs.x1) { endGrind(); P.onGround = false; P.vy = -180; }
   216	    camFollow(dt);
   217	    return;
   218	  }
   219	
   220	  // ---- vertical ----
   221	  var prevY = P.y;
   222	  if (P.onGround) {
   223	    // stick to surface / step off
   224	    World.surfaces(P.x, surfBuf);
   225	    var found = null;
   226	    for (i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) {
   227	      var c = surfBuf[i];
   228	      if (c.y >= P.y - 7 && c.y <= P.y + 16) { if (found === null || c.y < found.y) found = c; }
   229	    }
   230	    if (found) { P.y = found.y; P.seg = found.s; P.groundRef = P.y; P.rot = lerp(P.rot, 0, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt)); }
   231	    else { P.onGround = false; P.vy = 40; P.airT = 0; }
   232	  }
   233	  if (!P.onGround) {
   234	    P.airT += dt;
   235	    P.vy += G * dt;
   236	    P.y += P.vy * dt;
   237	    // trick anim
   238	    if (P.trick) {
   239	      P.tt += dt / P.trick.dur;
   240	      var e = easeOut(clamp(P.tt, 0, 1));
   241	      P.rot = P.trickRot0 + P.trick.rot * e;
   242	      P.flip = P.trickFlip0 + P.trick.flip * e;
   243	      if (P.tt >= 1) {
   244	        P.rot = 0; P.flip = 0;
   245	        addCombo(P.trick.n, P.trick.sc);
   246	        P.trick = null; P.tuck = 0;
   247	      }
   248	    }
   249	    // land?
   250	    World.surfaces(P.x, surfBuf);
   251	    var hit = null;
   252	    for (i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) {
   253	      var su = surfBuf[i];
   254	      if (prevY <= su.y + 2 && P.y >= su.y && P.vy > 0) { if (hit === null || su.y < hit.y) hit = su; }
   255	    }
   256	    if (hit) land(hit);
   257	    else if (P.y > P.groundRef + 250) { bail('fell in the gap'); return; }
   258	  }
   259	
   260	  // ---- obstacle collision ----
   261	  var bx0 = P.x - 11, bx1 = P.x + 11, by0 = P.y - 34, by1 = P.y - 2;
   262	  for (i = 0; i < World.obs.length; i++) {
   263	    var o = World.obs[i];
   264	    if (bx1 > o.x && bx0 < o.x + o.w && by1 > o.y && by0 < o.y + o.h) { bail('clipped it'); return; }
   265	  }
   266	  for (i = 0; i < World.cars.length; i++) {
   267	    var car = World.cars[i];
   268	    if (bx1 > car.x + 4 && bx0 < car.x + car.w - 4 && by1 > car.y + 5 && by0 < car.y + car.h) { bail('ate a bumper'); return; }
   269	  }
   270	
   271	  camFollow(dt);
   272	}
   273	
   274	function camFollow(dt) {
   275	  camX = P.x - W * 0.30;
   276	  camY = lerp(camY, P.groundRef - H * 0.66, 1 - Math.pow(0.02, dt));
   277	}
   278	
   279	function tryLatchGrind() {
   280	  for (var i = 0; i < World.segs.length; i++) {
   281	    var s = World.segs[i];
   282	    if (s.k !== 'rail' && s.k !== 'ledge') continue;
   283	    if (P.x < s.x0 - 18 || P.x > s.x1) continue;
   284	    var y = World.segY(s, clamp(P.x, s.x0, s.x1));
   285	    if (P.y > y - 46 && P.y < y + 16) { startGrind(s, y); return true; }
   286	  }
   287	  return false;
   288	}
   289	
   290	function land(hit) {
   291	  var s = hit.s;
   292	  // grindable surface -> auto slide
   293	  if ((s.k === 'rail' || s.k === 'ledge') && P.x < s.x1 - 8) {
   294	    if (P.trick && P.tt < 0.85) { bail('caught the lip'); return; }
   295	    if (P.trick) { addCombo(P.trick.n, P.trick.sc); P.trick = null; }
   296	    startGrind(s, hit.y);
   297	    return;
   298	  }
   299	  var err = Math.abs(angNorm(P.rot));
   300	  var mid = P.trick ? P.tt : 1;          // how far through the trick we are
   301	  P.y = hit.y; P.vy = 0; P.onGround = true; P.seg = s; P.tuck = 0; P.groundRef = P.y;
   302	
   303	  if (mid < 0.7 || err > 0.85) {
   304	    P.trick = null;
   305	    bail(mid < 0.7 ? 'landed mid-rotation' : 'landed sideways');
   306	    return;
   307	  }
   308	  if (P.trick) {
   309	    // scrappy but survivable: near-finished rotation snaps upright, half credit
   310	    var full = mid >= 0.88;
   311	    addCombo(P.trick.n + (full ? '' : ' (SCRAPPY)'), Math.round(P.trick.sc * (full ? 1 : 0.5)));
   312	    P.trick = null;
   313	    if (!full) err = 0.6;
   314	  }
   315	  P.rot = 0; P.flip = 0;
   316	
   317	  if (err < 0.34) {           // clean
   318	    P.v = Math.min(660, P.v + (P.combo.length ? 26 : 8));
   319	    bankCombo(true);
   320	    SFX.land(true);
   321	    Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y, 8, { c: '#cfd6e6', vx0: -140, vx1: -20, vy0: -110, vy1: -10, l1: 0.45 });
   322	  } else {                    // sketchy
   323	    P.v = Math.max(240, P.v - 80);
   324	    P.wobble = 1;
   325	    bankCombo(false);
   326	    shake = Math.max(shake, 7);
   327	    SFX.land(false);
   328	    Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y, 12, { c: '#ffb35c', vx0: -180, vx1: 40, vy0: -140, vy1: 0, l1: 0.5 });
   329	  }
   330	  P.lastLand = timeAll;
   331	}
   332	
   333	/* ---------------- render ---------------- */

   336	function drawSky() {
   337	  var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   338	  g.addColorStop(0, '#191233');
   339	  g.addColorStop(0.45, '#3b2350');
   340	  g.addColorStop(0.72, '#8b3f63');
   341	  g.addColorStop(1, '#e0714f');
   342	  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   343	  // stars
   344	  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
   345	  for (var i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
   346	    var sx = hash(i) * W, sy = hash(i + 90) * H * 0.42;
   347	    var tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(timeAll * 2 + i);
   348	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 + tw * 0.4;
   349	    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1.6, 1.6);
   350	  }
   351	  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   352	  // sun
   353	  var sunY = H * 0.52 - camY * 0.02, sunX = W * 0.72;
   354	  var sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 4, sunX, sunY, 150);
   355	  sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,196,120,0.42)');
   356	  sg.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255,140,110,0.18)');
   357	  sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,120,120,0)');
   358	  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
   359	  ctx.fillRect(sunX - 150, sunY - 150, 300, 300);
   360	}

   362	function drawSkyline(par, bw, hmin, hmax, col, baseFrac) {
   363	  var startX = camX * par;
   364	  var i0 = Math.floor(startX / bw) - 1, n = Math.ceil(W / bw) + 3;
   365	  var baseY = H * baseFrac - camY * par * 0.35;
   366	  ctx.fillStyle = col;
   367	  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   368	    var idx = i0 + i;
   369	    var h = hmin + hash(idx * 1.7) * (hmax - hmin);
   370	    var x = idx * bw - startX;
   371	    ctx.fillRect(x, baseY - h, bw - 3, h + H + 400);
   372	    // windows
   373	    if (par > 0.28) {
   374	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,214,140,0.20)';
   375	      for (var wy = baseY - h + 12; wy < baseY - 8; wy += 18) {
   376	        for (var wx = x + 6; wx < x + bw - 10; wx += 14) {
   377	          if (hash(wx * 0.31 + wy * 0.77 + idx) > 0.55) ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 5, 8);
   378	        }
   379	      }
   380	      ctx.fillStyle = col;
   381	    }
   382	  }
   383	}

   385	function drawWorld() {
   386	  var bottom = camY + H + 60;
   387	  // ground bodies
   388	  for (var i = 0; i < World.segs.length; i++) {
   389	    var s = World.segs[i];
   390	    if (s.x1 < camX - 40 || s.x0 > camX + W + 40) continue;
   391	    var x0 = s.x0 - camX, x1 = s.x1 - camX, y0 = s.y0 - camY, y1 = s.y1 - camY;
   392	    if (s.k === 'street' || s.k === 'stair' || s.k === 'ramp') {
   393	      ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2739';
   394	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x1, H + 60); ctx.lineTo(x0, H + 60); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   395	      ctx.strokeStyle = s.k === 'stair' ? '#6f6a92' : '#57527a';
   396	      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   397	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 - 1); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 - 1); ctx.stroke();
   398	      if (s.k === 'street' && s.x1 - s.x0 > 120) {
   399	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,225,140,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   400	        ctx.setLineDash([16, 22]);
   401	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 + 26); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 + 26); ctx.stroke();
   402	        ctx.setLineDash([]);
   403	      }
   404	    } else if (s.k === 'ledge') {
   405	      ctx.fillStyle = '#3c3752';
   406	      ctx.fillRect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, 40);
   407	      ctx.fillStyle = '#8ff0d4';
   408	      ctx.fillRect(x0, y0 - 3, x1 - x0, 4);
   409	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
   410	      ctx.fillRect(x0, y0 + 22, x1 - x0, 18);
   411	    } else if (s.k === 'rail') {
   412	      // posts
   413	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b6c86'; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
   414	      for (var px = x0 + 8; px < x1; px += 62) {
   415	        var t = (px - x0) / Math.max(1, x1 - x0);
   416	        var py = y0 + (y1 - y0) * t;
   417	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, py); ctx.lineTo(px, py + 48); ctx.stroke();
   418	      }
   419	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#63e6ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 7; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   420	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1); ctx.stroke();
   421	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   422	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 - 2); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 - 2); ctx.stroke();
   423	      ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
   424	    }
   425	  }
   426	  // obstacles
   427	  for (var j = 0; j < World.obs.length; j++) {
   428	    var o = World.obs[j];
   429	    if (o.x + o.w < camX - 20 || o.x > camX + W + 20) continue;
   430	    var ox = o.x - camX, oy = o.y - camY;
   431	    if (o.k === 'hydrant') {
   432	      ctx.fillStyle = '#e8524f';
   433	      ctx.fillRect(ox, oy + 6, o.w, o.h - 6);
   434	      ctx.fillRect(ox - 4, oy + 12, o.w + 8, 6);
   435	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox + o.w / 2, oy + 6, o.w / 2, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   436	    } else if (o.k === 'cone') {
   437	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8a3d';
   438	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ox + o.w / 2, oy); ctx.lineTo(ox + o.w + 3, oy + o.h); ctx.lineTo(ox - 3, oy + o.h); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   439	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9d6'; ctx.fillRect(ox - 1, oy + o.h * 0.45, o.w + 2, 4);
   440	    }
   441	  }
   442	  // cars
   443	  for (var k = 0; k < World.cars.length; k++) {
   444	    var c = World.cars[k];
   445	    if (c.x + c.w < camX - 40 || c.x > camX + W + 40) continue;
   446	    var cx = c.x - camX, cy = c.y - camY;
   447	    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + c.hue + ',48%,44%)';
   448	    ctx.fillRect(cx, cy + 16, c.w, c.h - 16);
   449	    ctx.beginPath();
   450	    ctx.moveTo(cx + 18, cy + 16); ctx.lineTo(cx + 34, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + 84, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + 100, cy + 16);
   451	    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   452	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,230,255,0.55)';
   453	    ctx.fillRect(cx + 36, cy + 3, 44, 12);
   454	    ctx.fillStyle = '#141220';
   455	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + 26, cy + c.h, 12, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   456	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + c.w - 26, cy + c.h, 12, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   457	    if (c.vx) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,180,0.75)'; ctx.fillRect(cx - 4, cy + 26, 6, 7); }
   458	  }
   459	  // props
   460	  for (var m = 0; m < World.props.length; m++) {
   461	    var pr = World.props[m];
   462	    if (pr.x < camX - 20 || pr.x > camX + W + 20) continue;
   463	    var qx = pr.x - camX, qy = pr.y - camY;
   464	    if (pr.k === 'post') { ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4665'; ctx.fillRect(qx, qy - 74, 5, 74); ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd98a'; ctx.fillRect(qx - 5, qy - 80, 16, 7); }
   465	    else if (pr.k === 'trash') { ctx.fillStyle = '#3f4a5c'; ctx.fillRect(qx, qy - 30, 22, 30); ctx.fillStyle = '#586479'; ctx.fillRect(qx - 2, qy - 34, 26, 5); }
   466	    else { ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4665'; ctx.fillRect(qx, qy - 16, 8, 16); }
   467	  }
   468	}

   470	function drawSkater(x, y, rot, flip, grinding, tuck, wob) {
   471	  ctx.save();
   472	  ctx.translate(x, y);
   473	  ctx.rotate(rot + (wob ? Math.sin(timeAll * 40) * 0.09 * wob : 0));
   474	  // board
   475	  var sx = Math.cos(flip);
   476	  ctx.save();
   477	  ctx.scale(sx < 0 ? Math.min(-0.12, sx) : Math.max(0.12, sx), 1);
   478	  ctx.fillStyle = '#f2f3f8';
   479	  ctx.beginPath();
   480	  ctx.moveTo(-22, 0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-25, -6, -18, -6);
   481	  ctx.lineTo(18, -6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(25, -6, 22, 0);
   482	  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   483	  ctx.fillStyle = '#f2a33c';
   484	  ctx.fillRect(-16, -6, 32, 2.5);
   485	  ctx.fillStyle = '#201c2e';
   486	  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-12, 3, 3.4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   487	  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(12, 3, 3.4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   488	  ctx.restore();
   489	  // legs
   490	  var kneeUp = tuck ? 10 : 0;
   491	  ctx.strokeStyle = '#3d6ee0'; ctx.lineWidth = 6; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   492	  ctx.beginPath();
   493	  ctx.moveTo(-11, -6); ctx.lineTo(-6, -20 + kneeUp * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(-2, -28 + kneeUp);
   494	  ctx.moveTo(11, -6); ctx.lineTo(7, -20 + kneeUp * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(2, -28 + kneeUp);
   495	  ctx.stroke();
   496	  // torso
   497	  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94f6a';
   498	  ctx.beginPath();
   499	  ctx.roundRect ? ctx.roundRect(-8, -48 + kneeUp, 16, 22, 5) : ctx.rect(-8, -48 + kneeUp, 16, 22);
   500	  ctx.fill();
   501	  // arms
   502	  ctx.strokeStyle = '#f0d3b0'; ctx.lineWidth = 5;
   503	  ctx.beginPath();
   504	  if (grinding) {
   505	    ctx.moveTo(-4, -44 + kneeUp); ctx.lineTo(-20, -54); ctx.moveTo(4, -44 + kneeUp); ctx.lineTo(20, -52);
   506	  } else if (tuck) {
   507	    ctx.moveTo(-4, -42 + kneeUp); ctx.lineTo(-14, -26); ctx.moveTo(4, -42 + kneeUp); ctx.lineTo(12, -30);
   508	  } else {
   509	    ctx.moveTo(-4, -44); ctx.lineTo(-18, -34); ctx.moveTo(4, -44); ctx.lineTo(16, -50);
   510	  }
   511	  ctx.stroke();
   512	  // head
   513	  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d3b0';
   514	  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -56 + kneeUp, 8, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   515	  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2739';
   516	  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -58 + kneeUp, 8.4, Math.PI * 1.02, TAU * 1.02); ctx.fill();
   517	  ctx.fillRect(2, -60 + kneeUp, 11, 3);
   518	  ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
   519	  ctx.restore();
   520	}

   553	  ctx.save();
   554	  // score panel
   555	  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,10,22,0.42)';

   561	
   562	  // speed bar
   563	  var sp = (P.v - 240) / (660 - 240);
   564	  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)'; ctx.fillRect(14, 56, W - 28, 4);
   565	  ctx.fillStyle = sp > 0.75 ? '#ff8a3d' : '#63e6ff'; ctx.fillRect(14, 56, (W - 28) * clamp(sp, 0, 1), 4);
   566	
   567	  // combo
   568	  if (state === 'run' && P.combo.length) {
   569	    var cy = 96;
   570	    txt('x' + P.combo.length + '  ' + Math.round(P.comboSum), W / 2, cy, 30, '#ffe08a', 'center');
   571	    txt(P.combo[P.combo.length - 1], W / 2, cy + 20, 13, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', 'center');
   572	  }
   573	
   574	  // popups: newest on top, fixed rows so they never overlap
   575	  var rows = Math.min(popups.length, 3);
   576	  for (var i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
   577	    var p = popups[popups.length - 1 - i];
   578	    var a = clamp((1.3 - p.t) * 1.4, 0, 1) * (i === 0 ? 1 : 0.6);
   579	    if (a <= 0.02) continue;

   585	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   586	  }
   587	
   588	  // balance meter
   589	  if (state === 'run' && P.grind) {
   590	    var bw = Math.min(260, W - 60), bx = (W - bw) / 2, by = H - 92;
   591	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,8,18,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(bx - 4, by - 16, bw + 8, 34);

   629	function render() {
   630	  ctx.save();
   631	  if (shake > 0.2) ctx.translate(rnd(-shake, shake) * 0.5, rnd(-shake, shake) * 0.5);
   632	  drawSky();

   636	  drawWorld();

   638	  if (state === 'bail' && P.rag) drawRagdoll(P.rag);
   639	  else {
   640	    var sx = P.x - camX, sy = P.y - camY;
   641	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
   642	    var gy = bestSurfaceY(P.x);
   643	    if (gy !== null) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sx, gy - camY, 20, 5, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
   644	    drawSkater(sx, sy, P.rot, P.flip, P.grind, P.tuck, P.wobble);
   645	  }
   646	  ctx.restore();
   647	  if (flash > 0.01) { ctx.globalAlpha = flash * 0.5; ctx.fillStyle = flashCol; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
   648	  drawHUD();
   649	  if (state === 'over') drawOver();
   650	}

   653	var last = 0;
   654	function frame(now) {
   655	  if (!last) last = now;
   656	  var dt = (now - last) / 1000; last = now;
   657	  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   658	  if (window.innerWidth !== W || window.innerHeight !== H) resize();
   659	  update(dt);
   660	  render();
   661	  Input.endFrame();
   662	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   663	}

   133	function gameOver() {
   134	  state = 'over';
   135	  if (total() > best) {

   141	/* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   142	function update(dt) {
   143	  timeAll += dt; tHint += dt;
   144	  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 48);
   145	  flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.9);
   146	  for (var i = popups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { popups[i].t += dt; if (popups[i].t > 1.3) popups.splice(i, 1); }
   147	  Parts.update(dt);
   148	  World.update(dt);
   149	
   150	  if (state === 'run') updateRun(dt);
   151	  else if (state === 'bail') {
   152	    var r = P.rag; r.t += dt;
   153	    P.v *= Math.pow(0.16, dt);
   154	    var groundY = bestSurfaceY(r.x);
   155	    r.vy += G * dt; r.x += r.vx * dt; r.y += r.vy * dt; r.rot += r.rv * dt; r.vx *= Math.pow(0.55, dt);
   156	    if (groundY !== null && r.y > groundY - 12) { r.y = groundY - 12; r.vy *= -0.34; r.rv *= 0.5; r.vx *= 0.6; if (Math.abs(r.vy) > 60) Parts.spawn(r.x, groundY, 5, { c: '#9aa4bb', l1: 0.4 }); }
   157	    var gb = bestSurfaceY(r.bx);
   158	    r.bvy += G * dt; r.bx += r.bvx * dt; r.by += r.bvy * dt; r.brot += r.brv * dt; r.bvx *= Math.pow(0.7, dt);
   159	    if (gb !== null && r.by > gb - 3) { r.by = gb - 3; r.bvy *= -0.4; r.brv *= 0.6; }
   160	    camX = lerp(camX, r.x - W * 0.34, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt));
   161	    camY = lerp(camY, r.y - H * 0.6, 1 - Math.pow(0.004, dt));
   162	    if (r.t > 1.15) gameOver();
   163	    if (r.t > 0.4 && (Input.tapPress || Input.tapQuick)) { gameOver(); }
   164	  } else if (state === 'over') {
   165	    if (Input.tapPress || Input.tapQuick) reset();
   166	  }
   167	}

   169	function bestSurfaceY(x) {
   170	  World.surfaces(x, surfBuf);
   171	  var y = null;
   172	  for (var i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) if (y === null || surfBuf[i].y > y) y = surfBuf[i].y;
   173	  return y;
   174	}

   176	function updateRun(dt) {
   177	  var i, s;
   178	  // ---- speed ----
   179	  P.v = clamp(P.v + 5 * dt, 240, 660);
   180	  P.x += P.v * dt;
   181	  distPx += P.v * dt;

   189	  if (P.grind) {

   193	  } else {
   194	    if (sw === 3) {

   197	  }
   198	
   199	  // ---- grinding ----
   200	  if (P.grind) {
   201	    var gs = P.grindSeg;
   202	    P.grindT += dt;

   206	    // balance
   207	    var ctrl = Input.balance();

   213	    P.groundRef = P.y;

   215	    if (P.x > gs.x1) { endGrind(); P.onGround = false; P.vy = -180; }
   216	    camFollow(dt);
   217	    return;
   218	  }
   219	
   220	  // ---- vertical ----
   221	  var prevY = P.y;
   222	  if (P.onGround) {
   223	    // stick to surface / step off
   224	    World.surfaces(P.x, surfBuf);
   225	    var found = null;
   226	    for (i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) {
   227	      var c = surfBuf[i];

   229	    }
   230	    if (found) { P.y = found.y; P.seg = found.s; P.groundRef = P.y; P.rot = lerp(P.rot, 0, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt)); }
   231	    else { P.onGround = false; P.vy = 40; P.airT = 0; }
   232	  }
   233	  if (!P.onGround) {
   234	    P.airT += dt;
   235	    P.vy += G * dt;
   236	    P.y += P.vy * dt;
   237	    // trick anim
   238	    if (P.trick) {
   239	      P.tt += dt / P.trick.dur;
   240	      var e = easeOut(clamp(P.tt, 0, 1));
   241	      P.rot = P.trickRot0 + P.trick.rot * e;
   242	      P.flip = P.trickFlip0 + P.trick.flip * e;
   243	      if (P.tt >= 1) {
   244	        P.rot = 0; P.flip = 0;
   245	        addCombo(P.trick.n, P.trick.sc);
   246	        P.trick = null; P.tuck = 0;
   247	      }
   248	    }
   249	    // land?
   250	    World.surfaces(P.x, surfBuf);
   251	    var hit = null;
   252	    for (i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) {
   253	      var su = surfBuf[i];
   254	      if (prevY <= su.y + 2 && P.y >= su.y && P.vy > 0) { if (hit === null || su.y < hit.y) hit = su; }
   255	    }
   256	    if (hit) land(hit);
   257	    else if (P.y > P.groundRef + 250) { bail('fell in the gap'); return; }
   258	  }
   259	
   260	  // ---- obstacle collision ----
   261	  var bx0 = P.x - 11, bx1 = P.x + 11, by0 = P.y - 34, by1 = P.y - 2;
   262	  for (i = 0; i < World.obs.length; i++) {
   263	    var o = World.obs[i];
   264	    if (bx1 > o.x && bx0 < o.x + o.w && by1 > o.y && by0 < o.y + o.h) { bail('clipped it'); return; }
   265	  }
   266	  for (i = 0; i < World.cars.length; i++) {

   268	    if (bx1 > car.x + 4 && bx0 < car.x + car.w - 4 && by1 > car.y + 5 && by0 < car.y + car.h) { bail('ate a bumper'); return; }
   269	  }
   270	
   271	  camFollow(dt);
   272	}

   211	    var v = aim.power * Math.sqrt(W * H * 2.4);
   212	    lure.x = L.rod.x; lure.y = L.rod.y;
   213	    lure.vx = Math.cos(aim.angle) * v;
   214	    lure.vy = -Math.sin(aim.angle) * v;
   215	    lure.inWater = false;
   216	    setState('cast');
   217	    LL.sfx.cast();
   218	  }
   219	  function retrieve(amount) {
   220	    if (!lure.inWater) return;
   221	    lure.x -= amount * 0.60;
   222	    lure.y -= amount * 0.12;
   223	    if (lure.y < L.waterTop + 5) lure.y = L.waterTop + 5;
   224	    if (lure.x <= L.rod.x + 14) resetCast('Line in. Flick up to cast');
   225	  }
   226	  function twitch() {
   227	    if (state !== 'water' || !lure.inWater) return;
   228	    lure.y -= 9; lure.x -= 5;
   229	    if (lure.y < L.waterTop + 5) lure.y = L.waterTop + 5;
   230	    addRipple(lure.x, lure.y, 3);
   231	    LL.sfx.twitch();
   232	    if (lure.x <= L.rod.x + 14) resetCast('Line in. Flick up to cast');
   233	  }
   234	  function resetCast(m) {
   235	    setState('aim'); strikeFish = null; F = null; action = 0; drag.speed = 0;
   236	    fish.forEach(function (f) { f.interest = 0; });
   237	    if (m) say(m);
   238	  }
   239	  function setHook() {
   240	    if (!strikeFish) return;
   241	    var f = strikeFish;
   242	    F = {
   243	      f: f, tension: 0.34, progress: 0, stamina: 1,
   244	      power: 0.45 + Math.min(1.15, f.w / 11),
   245	      ph: Math.random() * 6.28, ph2: Math.random() * 6.28,
   246	      snapT: 0, slackT: 0, t: 0,
   247	      hx: f.x, hy: f.y, thrash: 0
   248	    };
   249	    setState('fight');
   250	    shake = 8; flash = 0.35; flashCol = '#ffe9a8';
   251	    LL.sfx.hook();
   252	    say('HOLD to reel, RELEASE to give line');
   253	  }
   254	  function endFight(kind) {
   255	    var f = F.f;
   256	    if (kind === 'land') {
   257	      score += f.w;
   258	      var rec = false;
   259	      var cur = store.trophy[f.sp.id] || 0;
   260	      if (f.w > cur) { store.trophy[f.sp.id] = f.w; rec = true; }
   261	      if (score > best) { best = score; store.best = Math.round(score * 100) / 100; }
   262	      LL.save(store);
   263	      fish.splice(fish.indexOf(f), 1);
   264	      result = { sp: f.sp, w: f.w, rec: rec, kind: 'land' };
   265	      addParts(L.rod.x + 30, L.waterTop, 26, '#cfeaf6', 220, 90);
   266	      shake = 6; flash = 0.3; flashCol = '#bfe9c8';
   267	      if (rec) LL.sfx.record(); else LL.sfx.land();
   268	    } else {
   269	      result = { sp: f.sp, w: f.w, kind: kind };
   270	      f.interest = 0; f.cool = 6;
   271	      f.x = Math.min(L.xmax, f.x + 40);
   272	      addParts(f.x, f.y, 18, kind === 'snap' ? '#ff8b6b' : '#9fd8ea', 200, 0);
   273	      shake = kind === 'snap' ? 14 : 6;
   274	      flash = 0.4; flashCol = kind === 'snap' ? '#ff7a55' : '#8fd0e8';
   275	      if (kind === 'snap') LL.sfx.snap(); else LL.sfx.escape();
   276	    }
   277	    F = null; strikeFish = null;
   278	    setState('result');
   279	  }
   280	  function finishResult() {
   281	    result = null;
   282	    setState('aim');
   283	    lure.inWater = false;
   284	    if (fish.length === 0) say('Lake is fished out - tap NEXT LAKE');
   285	    else say('Flick up to cast');
   286	  }
   287	
   288	  /* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   289	  var lastDt = 0.016;
   290	  function update(dt) {
   291	    time += dt; stateT += dt;
   292	    if (msgT > 0) msgT -= dt;
   293	    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 26);
   294	    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.6);
   295	
   296	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   297	      var p = parts[i]; p.t += dt;
   298	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 420 * dt;
   299	      if (p.t > p.life) parts.splice(i, 1);
   300	    }
   300	    }
   301	    for (var j = ripples.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
   302	      var rp = ripples[j]; rp.t += dt; rp.r += 46 * dt;
   303	      if (rp.t > rp.life) ripples.splice(j, 1);
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    if (showLog) return;
   307	
   308	    // aim charge (keyboard)
   309	    if (state === 'aim') {
   310	      if (aim.holding && !aim.touched) {
   311	        aim.charge += aim.chargeDir * dt * 1.15;
   312	        if (aim.charge > 1) { aim.charge = 1; aim.chargeDir = -1; }
   313	        if (aim.charge < 0.30) { aim.charge = 0.30; aim.chargeDir = 1; }
   314	        aim.power = aim.charge;
   315	      }
   316	      var ang = 0;
   317	      if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w'] || keys['W']) ang += 1;
   318	      if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s'] || keys['S']) ang -= 1;
   319	      if (ang) aim.angle = Math.max(0.17, Math.min(1.40, aim.angle + ang * dt * 0.9));
   320	    }
   321	
   322	    if (state === 'cast') {
   323	      lure.vy += H * 2.4 * dt;
   324	      lure.x += lure.vx * dt; lure.y += lure.vy * dt;
   325	      if (lure.x > W - 6) { lure.x = W - 6; lure.vx *= -0.25; }
   326	      if (lure.y >= L.waterTop) {
   327	        lure.y = L.waterTop; lure.vy = 0; lure.vx = 0; lure.inWater = true;
   328	        addRipple(lure.x, L.waterTop, 5); addRipple(lure.x, L.waterTop, 14);
   329	        addParts(lure.x, L.waterTop, 12, '#cfeaf6', 140, 120);
   330	        LL.sfx.splash();
   331	        setState('water');
   332	        say('Drag to work the lure');
   333	      }
   334	    }
   335	
   336	    if (state === 'water') {
   337	      if (drag.active) drag.downT += dt;
   338	      // keyboard hold = slow steady drag
   339	      if (hold && !drag.active && (keys[' '] || keys['Enter'])) {
   340	        retrieve(46 * dt);
   341	        drag.speed = drag.speed * 0.85 + 60 * 0.15;
   342	        drag.moveT = 0.3;
   343	      }
   344	      drag.moveT -= dt;
   345	      if (drag.moveT <= 0) drag.speed *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   346	      var target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, drag.speed / 480));
   347	      action += (target - action) * Math.min(1, dt * 7);
   348	      // sink
   349	      if (drag.moveT <= 0) {
   350	        lure.y += 34 * dt;
   351	        var maxd = bottomAt(lure.x) - 4;
   352	        if (lure.y > maxd) lure.y = maxd;
   353	      }
   354	    }
   355	
   356	    // fish behaviour
   357	    var lively = state === 'water' && drag.moveT > 0;
   358	    for (var k = 0; k < fish.length; k++) {
   359	      var f = fish[k];
   360	      f.phase += dt * (3 + f.spd * 0.08);
   361	      if (f.cool > 0) f.cool -= dt;
   362	      if (F && F.f === f) continue;
   363	      if (strikeFish === f) continue;
   364	      var chase = false;
   365	      if (state === 'water' && f.cool <= 0) {
   366	        var d = Math.hypot(f.x - lure.x, f.y - lure.y);
   367	        var match = 1 - Math.abs(action - f.sp.pref);
   368	        if (d < 130 && lively) {
   369	          f.interest += dt * ((match - 0.40) * 2.6 + 0.18);
   370	        } else {
   371	          f.interest -= dt * 0.5;
   372	        }
   373	        f.interest = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.2, f.interest));
   374	        if (f.interest > 0.22) {
   375	          chase = true;
   376	          var ang2 = Math.atan2(lure.y - f.y, lure.x - f.x);
   377	          var cs = 26 + f.interest * 70;
   378	          f.x += Math.cos(ang2) * cs * dt;
   379	          f.y += Math.sin(ang2) * cs * dt;
   380	          f.dir = (lure.x < f.x) ? -1 : 1;
   381	          if (f.interest >= 1 && d < 30 && !strikeFish) {
   382	            strikeFish = f; strikeT = 0; setState('strike');
   383	            shake = 5; flash = 0.28; flashCol = '#ffd76a';
   384	            addRipple(lure.x, lure.y, 6);
   385	            LL.sfx.strike();
   386	          }
   387	        }
   388	      } else if (f.interest > 0) f.interest = Math.max(0, f.interest - dt * 0.8);
   389	
   390	      if (!chase) {
   391	        f.x += f.dir * f.spd * dt;
   392	        f.y += Math.sin(time * 0.6 + f.phase) * 5 * dt;
   393	        if (f.x < f.xlo) { f.x = f.xlo; f.dir = 1; }
   394	        if (f.x > L.xmax) { f.x = L.xmax; f.dir = -1; }
   395	        if (f.y < f.homeLo) f.y += 18 * dt;
   396	        if (f.y > f.homeHi) f.y -= 18 * dt;
   397	      }
   398	    }
   399	
   400	    if (state === 'strike') {
   401	      strikeT += dt;
   402	      if (strikeT > 0.8) {
   403	        strikeFish.interest = 0; strikeFish.cool = 4; strikeFish = null;
   404	        setState('water'); say('Missed the take');
   405	      }
   406	    }
   407	
   408	    if (state === 'fight') updateFight(dt);
   409	  }
   410	
   411	  function updateFight(dt) {
   412	    F.t += dt;
   413	    var run = Math.max(0, Math.sin(F.t * 1.55 + F.ph)) * (0.45 + 0.55 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(F.t * 0.82 + F.ph2)));
   414	    var pull = F.power * (0.32 + 0.68 * F.stamina) * (0.62 + 0.95 * run);
   415	    F.pull = pull;
   416	    if (hold) {
   417	      F.tension += (0.30 + pull * 0.80) * dt;
   418	      F.progress += Math.max(0.03, 0.165 - 0.055 * pull) * dt;
   419	      if (Math.random() < dt * 14) LL.sfx.reel();
   420	    } else {
   421	      F.tension -= (0.88 + 0.22 * (1 - F.stamina)) * dt;
   422	      F.progress -= 0.055 * pull * dt;
   423	    }
   424	    F.tension = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.15, F.tension));
   425	    F.progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, F.progress));
   426	    F.stamina -= dt * (hold ? 0.085 + 0.075 * F.tension : 0.022) / (0.55 + F.f.w * 0.055);
   427	    F.stamina = Math.max(0, F.stamina);
   428	    F.thrash = run;
   429	
   430	    if (F.tension >= 1) { F.snapT += dt; if (F.snapT > 0.80) { endFight('snap'); return; } }
   431	    else F.snapT = Math.max(0, F.snapT - dt * 1.5);
   432	    if (F.tension <= 0.035) { F.slackT += dt; if (F.slackT > 1.7) { endFight('escape'); return; } }
   433	    else F.slackT = Math.max(0, F.slackT - dt * 1.2);
   434	    if (F.progress >= 1) { endFight('land'); return; }
   435	    if (F.tension > 0.86 && Math.random() < dt * 30) addParts(fightFishPos().x, fightFishPos().y, 1, '#ff9a72', 60, 0);
   436	  }
   437	
   438	  function fightFishPos() {
   439	    var p = F.progress;
   440	    var tx = L.rod.x + 26, ty = L.waterTop + 16;
   441	    var x = F.hx + (tx - F.hx) * p;
   442	    var y = F.hy + (ty - F.hy) * p;
   443	    var sw = (1 - p) * 26 * F.thrash;
   444	    x += Math.sin(F.t * 6.1) * sw;
   445	    y += Math.cos(F.t * 4.3) * sw * 0.6;
   446	    return { x: x, y: Math.max(L.waterTop + 8, Math.min(bottomAt(x) - 6, y)) };
   447	  }
   448	
   449	  function bottomAt(x) {
   450	    var t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - W * 0.1) / (W * 0.9)));
   451	    return L.waterTop + L.depth * (0.34 + 0.66 * Math.min(1, t * 2.2));
   452	  }
