   454	  /* ---------------- render ---------------- */
   455	  function drawBg() {
   456	    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, L.waterTop);
   457	    g.addColorStop(0, lake.weather.sky[0]);
   458	    g.addColorStop(1, lake.weather.sky[1]);
   459	    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, L.waterTop + 1);
   460	
   461	    // far hills
   462	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,52,60,0.45)';
   463	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, L.waterTop);
   464	    var hr = LL.rng(lake.seed * 7919 + 3);
   465	    var n = 7, hx = 0;
   466	    ctx.lineTo(0, L.waterTop - 20);
   467	    for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
   468	      hx = (W * i) / n;
   469	      ctx.lineTo(hx, L.waterTop - 18 - hr() * H * 0.075);
   470	    }
   471	    ctx.lineTo(W, L.waterTop); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   472	
   473	    // water
   474	    var wg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, L.waterTop, 0, L.bottom + 10);
   475	    wg.addColorStop(0, lake.weather.water[0]);
   476	    wg.addColorStop(1, lake.weather.water[1]);
   477	    ctx.fillStyle = wg; ctx.fillRect(0, L.waterTop, W, H - L.waterTop);
   478	
   479	    // depth bands
   480	    var labels = ['SHALLOW', 'MID', 'DEEP'];
   481	    for (var b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
   482	      var y0 = L.waterTop + L.depth * (b === 0 ? 0 : b === 1 ? 0.33 : 0.65);
   483	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
   484	      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   485	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y0); ctx.lineTo(W, y0); ctx.stroke();
   486	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
   487	      ctx.font = '600 9px system-ui,sans-serif';
   488	      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   489	      ctx.fillText(labels[b], 5, y0 + 11);
   490	    }
   491	
   492	    // lake bed
   493	    ctx.fillStyle = '#123040';
   494	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, H);
   495	    ctx.lineTo(0, bottomAt(0));
   496	    for (var x = 0; x <= W; x += 12) ctx.lineTo(x, bottomAt(x) + Math.sin(x * 0.05 + lake.seed) * 3);
   497	    ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   498	
   499	    // weeds
   500	    var wr = LL.rng(lake.seed * 104729 + 11);
   501	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,120,80,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   502	    for (var k = 0; k < 14; k++) {
   503	      var wx = W * 0.2 + wr() * W * 0.78;
   504	      var by = bottomAt(wx);
   505	      var hgt = 14 + wr() * 42;
   506	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(wx, by);
   507	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(wx + Math.sin(time * 0.8 + k) * 7, by - hgt * 0.6, wx + Math.sin(time * 0.8 + k) * 11, by - hgt);
   508	      ctx.stroke();
   509	    }
   510	
   511	    // surface line + ripples
   512	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   513	    ctx.beginPath();
   514	    for (var sx = 0; sx <= W; sx += 8) {
   515	      var sy = L.waterTop + Math.sin(sx * 0.06 + time * 1.6) * 1.8;
   516	      if (sx === 0) ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); else ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
   517	    }
   518	    ctx.stroke();
   519	    ripples.forEach(function (r) {
   520	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - r.t / r.life) * 0.6;
   521	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#dff4ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
   522	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(r.x, r.y, r.r, r.r * 0.3, 0, 0, 6.283); ctx.stroke();
   523	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   524	    });
   525	  }

   527	  function drawAngler() {
   528	    var ax = L.anglerX, base = L.waterTop;
   529	    // dock
   530	    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3a2c';
   531	    ctx.fillRect(0, base - 10, W * 0.16, 12);
   532	    ctx.fillStyle = '#33261c';
   533	    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.10, base + 2, 6, 26);
   534	    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.03, base + 2, 6, 22);
   535	    // angler

   537	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax, base - 62, 9, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   538	    ctx.fillRect(ax - 8, base - 54, 16, 30);
   539	    ctx.fillRect(ax - 7, base - 26, 6, 18);
   540	    ctx.fillRect(ax + 1, base - 26, 6, 18);
   541	    // rod

   544	    else if (state === 'cast' || state === 'water') bend = 5;

   549	    ctx.stroke();
   550	    L.tipY = L.rod.y + bend;

   553	  function drawLine(tx, ty, tension) {
   554	    var sag = (1 - Math.min(1, tension)) * 26 + 4;
   555	    ctx.strokeStyle = tension > 0.86 ? 'rgba(255,150,120,0.95)' : 'rgba(240,250,255,0.75)';
   556	    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
   557	    ctx.beginPath();
   558	    ctx.moveTo(L.rod.x, L.tipY);
   559	    ctx.quadraticCurveTo((L.rod.x + tx) * 0.5, (L.tipY + ty) * 0.5 + sag, tx, ty);
   560	    ctx.stroke();

   564	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';

   566	    ctx.fillStyle = '#c94b2a';

   570	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,' + glow.toFixed(2) + ')';
   571	      ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
   572	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lure.x, lure.y, 9 + Math.sin(time * 9) * 2 * action, 0, 6.283); ctx.stroke();
   573	    }

   576	  function drawPreview() {
   577	    var v = aim.power * Math.sqrt(W * H * 2.4);
   578	    var x = L.rod.x, y = L.tipY || L.rod.y;
   579	    var vx = Math.cos(aim.angle) * v, vy = -Math.sin(aim.angle) * v;
   580	    var dt = 0.028;
   581	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
   582	    for (var i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
   583	      vy += H * 2.4 * dt; x += vx * dt; y += vy * dt;
   584	      if (y >= L.waterTop) {
   585	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,225,120,0.95)';
   586	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, L.waterTop, 5, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   587	        break;
   588	      }
   589	      if (x > W) break;
   590	      if (i % 3 === 0) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 2.1, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill(); }
   591	    }
   592	    // power meter
   593	    var pw = 120, px = W * 0.5 - pw / 2, py = H - 92;
   594	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; roundRect(px - 2, py - 2, pw + 4, 12, 5); ctx.fill();
   595	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a'; roundRect(px, py, pw * aim.power, 8, 4); ctx.fill();
   596	  }

   598	  function drawFishes() {
   599	    for (var i = 0; i < fish.length; i++) {
   600	      var f = fish[i];
   601	      if (F && F.f === f) continue;
   602	      var dep = (f.y - L.waterTop) / L.depth;
   603	      var alpha = 0.95 - dep * 0.30;
   604	      LL.drawFish(ctx, f.sp, f.x, f.y, f.len, f.dir, f.phase, alpha, false);
   605	      if (f.interest > 0.3 && state === 'water') {
   606	        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, f.interest);
   607	        ctx.fillStyle = f.interest > 0.8 ? '#ffdc5e' : '#ffffff';
   608	        ctx.font = 'bold 15px system-ui,sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   609	        ctx.fillText(f.interest > 0.8 ? '!' : '?', f.x, f.y - f.len * 0.45 - 6);
   610	        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   611	      }
   612	    }
   613	  }

   615	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
   616	    ctx.beginPath();
   617	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   618	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   619	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   620	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   620	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   621	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   622	    ctx.closePath();
   623	  }

   625	  function drawBtn(b, on) {
   626	    ctx.fillStyle = on ? 'rgba(255,210,74,0.92)' : 'rgba(10,26,36,0.72)';

   664	  function hintFor() {
   665	    if (state === 'aim') return 'Flick UP to cast (hold to aim)';
   666	    if (state === 'cast') return '...';
   667	    if (state === 'water') return action > 0.55 ? 'FAST TWITCH' : (drag.moveT > 0 ? 'SLOW DRAG' : 'Drag to work the lure');
   668	    if (state === 'strike') return 'TAP NOW - set the hook!';
   669	    if (state === 'fight') return 'HOLD to reel  /  RELEASE to give line';
   670	    if (state === 'result') return 'Tap to continue';
   671	    return '';

   756	  function render() {
   757	    ctx.setTransform(S, 0, 0, S, 0, 0);
   758	    ctx.fillStyle = '#08121a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   759	    ctx.save();
   760	    if (shake > 0.2) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
   761	
   762	    drawBg();
   763	    drawFishes();
   764	    drawAngler();
   765	
   766	    if (state === 'aim') {
   767	      drawPreview();
   768	    } else if (state === 'cast') {
   769	      drawLine(lure.x, lure.y, 0.9); drawLure();
   770	    } else if (state === 'water' || state === 'strike') {
   771	      drawLine(lure.x, lure.y, 0.35 + action * 0.4); drawLure();
   772	      if (state === 'strike') {
   773	        var a = 1 - strikeT / 0.8;
   774	        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, a);
   775	        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a'; ctx.font = '900 30px system-ui,sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   776	        ctx.fillText('STRIKE!', W * 0.5, L.waterTop - 26);
   777	        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd24a'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   778	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lure.x, lure.y, 12 + (1 - a) * 26, 0, 6.283); ctx.stroke();
   779	        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   780	      }
   781	    } else if (state === 'fight') {
   782	      var fp = fightFishPos();
   783	      LL.drawFish(ctx, F.f.sp, fp.x, fp.y, F.f.len, -1, F.t * 12, 1, F.tension > 0.86);
   784	      drawLine(fp.x + F.f.len * 0.4, fp.y, F.tension);
   785	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
   786	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fp.x + F.f.len * 0.45, fp.y, 3, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   787	    }
   788	
   789	    // particles
   790	    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
   791	      var p = parts[i];
   792	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - p.t / p.life);
   793	      ctx.fillStyle = p.col;
   794	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   795	    }
   796	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   797	    ctx.restore();
   798	
   799	    if (state === 'fight') drawTension();
   800	    drawHud();
   801	    if (state === 'result') drawResult();
   802	    if (showLog) drawLog();
   803	
   804	    if (flash > 0) {
   805	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.5, flash);
   806	      ctx.fillStyle = flashCol; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   807	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   808	    }
   809	  }
   810	
   811	  /* ---------------- loop ---------------- */
   812	  var prev = 0;
   813	  function frame(ts) {
   814	    if (!prev) prev = ts;
   815	    var dt = (ts - prev) / 1000;
   816	    prev = ts;
   817	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   818	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   819	    lastDt = Math.max(0.008, dt);
   820	    update(dt);
   821	    render();
   822	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   823	  }
   824	
   825	  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { resize(); relocate(); });
   826	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { setTimeout(function () { resize(); relocate(); }, 120); });
   827	  function relocate() {
   828	    fish.forEach(function (f) {
   829	      var b = L.bands[f.sp.band];
   830	      f.homeLo = b[0]; f.homeHi = b[1]; f.xlo = L.bandXmin[f.sp.band];
   831	      f.x = Math.max(f.xlo, Math.min(L.xmax, f.x));
   832	      f.y = Math.max(b[0], Math.min(b[1], f.y));
   833	    });
   834	  }

   836	  window.__ll = function () {
   837	    return { state: state, action: action, fish: fish.length, score: score, lure: lure, F: F, msg: msg, lake: lake, result: result };
   838	  };
   839	
   840	  resize();
   841	  newLake(lakeSeed, true);
   842	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);

     1	/* Lunker Lake - data, species, lake generation, audio, fish rendering */
     2	(function () {
     3	  var LL = (window.LL = {});
     4	
     5	  /* ---------------- seeded RNG (xorshift32) ---------------- */
     6	  LL.rng = function (seed) {
     7	    var s = seed >>> 0;
     8	    if (s === 0) s = 0x9e3779b9;
     9	    return function () {
    10	      s ^= s << 13; s >>>= 0;
    11	      s ^= s >>> 17;
    12	      s ^= s << 5; s >>>= 0;
    13	      return s / 4294967296;
    14	    };
    15	  };
    16	
    17	  /* ---------------- species ----------------
    18	     band: 0 shallow, 1 mid, 2 deep
    19	     pref: preferred lure action 0 = slow drag ... 1 = fast twitch      */
    20	  LL.SPECIES = [
    21	    { id: 'sunhook',     name: 'Bronze Sunhook',   band: 0, pref: 0.22, wmin: 0.4,  wmax: 2.6,  skew: 2.0, col: '#d09338', dark: '#8a5c17', body: { d: 0.60, snout: 0.22, fork: 0.50, dorsal: 'spiny' } },
    22	    { id: 'shiner',      name: 'Glass Shiner',     band: 0, pref: 0.88, wmin: 0.15, wmax: 0.9,  skew: 1.6, col: '#b9d9e8', dark: '#6c93a6', body: { d: 0.26, snout: 0.38, fork: 0.70, dorsal: 'soft' } },
    23	    { id: 'reedspear',   name: 'Reedspear',        band: 1, pref: 0.92, wmin: 1.8,  wmax: 9.5,  skew: 2.4, col: '#6fa04e', dark: '#3d6128', body: { d: 0.22, snout: 0.78, fork: 0.34, dorsal: 'back' } },
    24	    { id: 'drumfin',     name: 'Marbled Drumfin',  band: 1, pref: 0.18, wmin: 1.2,  wmax: 6.5,  skew: 2.1, col: '#9b8bab', dark: '#5d5170', body: { d: 0.56, snout: 0.18, fork: 0.44, dorsal: 'long' } },
    25	    { id: 'coppergill',  name: 'Coppergill',       band: 1, pref: 0.52, wmin: 0.8,  wmax: 4.0,  skew: 2.0, col: '#c2703a', dark: '#7a4018', body: { d: 0.50, snout: 0.24, fork: 0.42, dorsal: 'soft' } },
    26	    { id: 'whiskerling', name: 'Slate Whiskerling',band: 2, pref: 0.10, wmin: 3.0,  wmax: 16.0, skew: 2.6, col: '#79808b', dark: '#454b55', body: { d: 0.38, snout: 0.14, fork: 0.16, dorsal: 'soft', barbels: true } },
    27	    { id: 'nightperch',  name: 'Nightperch',       band: 2, pref: 0.80, wmin: 1.0,  wmax: 5.5,  skew: 2.0, col: '#4b6f99', dark: '#25415e', body: { d: 0.42, snout: 0.30, fork: 0.56, dorsal: 'spiny' } },

    29	  ];
    30	  LL.byId = {};
    31	  LL.SPECIES.forEach(function (s) { LL.byId[s.id] = s; });
    32	
    33	  /* ---------------- lake naming ---------------- */
    34	  var ADJ = ['Hollow', 'Ember', 'Quiet', 'Split', 'Amber', 'Thorn', 'Slate', 'Willow', 'Copper', 'Frost', 'Hush', 'Lantern', 'Rusted', 'Pale', 'Crooked', 'Moss'];
    35	  var NOUN = ['Basin', 'Tarn', 'Pool', 'Flats', 'Hollow', 'Mere', 'Cove', 'Bend', 'Sink', 'Reach', 'Shallows', 'Kettle'];
    36	  var WEATHER = [
    37	    { name: 'CLEAR',  sky: ['#63a6d6', '#bfe0ef'], water: ['#2e7fa8', '#0a2e46'] },
    38	    { name: 'OVERCAST', sky: ['#7d8a95', '#c3ccd2'], water: ['#3a7188', '#0b2733'] },
    39	    { name: 'DUSK',   sky: ['#3a4a78', '#e08a52'], water: ['#2a5f80', '#08202f'] },
    40	    { name: 'MIST',   sky: ['#9fb2b8', '#dfe9ea'], water: ['#4a8a99', '#0d2c36'] }
    41	  ];
    42	
    43	  /* ---------------- lake generation ---------------- */
    44	  LL.makeLake = function (seed) {
    45	    var r = LL.rng(seed * 2654435761 + 12345);
    46	    var name = ADJ[(r() * ADJ.length) | 0] + ' ' + NOUN[(r() * NOUN.length) | 0];
    47	    var weather = WEATHER[(r() * WEATHER.length) | 0];
    48	
    49	    // stock: every species has a chance; guarantee coverage of each band
    50	    var pool = [];
    51	    var counts = {};
    52	    LL.SPECIES.forEach(function (sp) {
    53	      var n;
    54	      if (sp.id === 'greenmouth') n = (r() * 2.2) | 0;              // 0-2 lunkers
    55	      else if (sp.wmax > 9) n = 1 + ((r() * 2.2) | 0);
    56	      else n = 1 + ((r() * 3.6) | 0);
    57	      counts[sp.id] = n;
    58	    });
    59	    // make sure something lives in each band
    60	    [0, 1, 2].forEach(function (b) {
    61	      var has = LL.SPECIES.some(function (sp) { return sp.band === b && counts[sp.id] > 0; });
    62	      if (!has) {
    63	        var cand = LL.SPECIES.filter(function (sp) { return sp.band === b; });
    64	        counts[cand[(r() * cand.length) | 0].id] = 1 + ((r() * 2) | 0);
    65	      }
    66	    });
    67	
    68	    LL.SPECIES.forEach(function (sp) {
    69	      for (var i = 0; i < counts[sp.id]; i++) {
    70	        var t = Math.pow(r(), sp.skew);
    71	        var w = sp.wmin + t * (sp.wmax - sp.wmin);
    72	        pool.push({ sp: sp, w: Math.round(w * 100) / 100, seedR: r() });
    73	      }
    74	    });
    75	    return { seed: seed, name: name, weather: weather, stock: pool };
    76	  };
    77	
    78	  /* ---------------- storage ---------------- */
    79	  var K = 'lunkerlake.v1';
    80	  LL.load = function () {
    81	    try {
    82	      var o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || '{}');
    83	      if (!o.trophy) o.trophy = {};
    84	      if (typeof o.best !== 'number') o.best = 0;
    85	      return o;
    86	    } catch (e) { return { trophy: {}, best: 0 }; }
    87	  };
    88	  LL.save = function (o) { try { localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (e) {} };
    89	
    90	  /* ---------------- audio (WebAudio only) ---------------- */
    91	  var ac = null;
    92	  LL.audioOn = true;
    93	  LL.initAudio = function () {
    94	    if (ac) { if (ac.state === 'suspended') ac.resume(); return; }
    95	    try {
    96	      var C = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    97	      if (!C) return;
    98	      ac = new C();
    99	    } catch (e) { ac = null; }
   100	  };
   101	  function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo) {
   102	    if (!ac || !LL.audioOn) return;
   103	    var t = ac.currentTime;
   104	    var o = ac.createOscillator(), g = ac.createGain();
   105	    o.type = type || 'sine';
   106	    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
   107	    if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, slideTo), t + dur);
   108	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
   109	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.15, t + 0.012);
   110	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
   111	    o.connect(g); g.connect(ac.destination);
   112	    o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.03);
   113	  }
   114	  function noise(dur, vol, hp) {
   115	    if (!ac || !LL.audioOn) return;
   116	    var n = (ac.sampleRate * dur) | 0;
   117	    var buf = ac.createBuffer(1, n, ac.sampleRate);
   118	    var d = buf.getChannelData(0);
   119	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / n);
   120	    var src = ac.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
   121	    var f = ac.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = hp ? 'highpass' : 'lowpass'; f.frequency.value = hp || 900;
   122	    var g = ac.createGain(); g.gain.value = vol || 0.12;
   123	    src.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(ac.destination);
   124	    src.start();
   125	  }
   126	  LL.sfx = {

    14	const Engine = (() => {
    15	  const canvas = document.getElementById('screen');
    16	  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    17	  canvas.width = SCREEN_W;

    20	
    21	  // Scale the canvas to fill the screen. The old build integer-floored the scale,
    22	  // which on a phone (≈1.5x) floored to 1x — a tiny 256x240 box. Now we fill:
    23	  // fractional scaling on touch devices (maximize size) and crisp integer scaling
    24	  // on desktop. In portrait we reserve the lower part of the screen for the
    25	  // on-screen controller so gameplay never hides behind the player's thumbs.
    26	  function isCoarse() {
    27	    return !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches);
    28	  }
    29	  function el(id) {
    30	    return (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.getElementById)
    31	      ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
    32	  }
    33	  function visRect(e) {
    34	    if (!e || !e.getBoundingClientRect) return null;
    35	    const r = e.getBoundingClientRect();
    36	    return (r.width > 0 && r.height > 0) ? r : null;
    37	  }
    38	  // The on-screen controller is the source of truth for how much room the
    39	  // playfield may take. We MEASURE the real control rects instead of guessing a
    40	  // percentage, so the canvas can never grow underneath a thumb button and can
    41	  // never shrink more than it has to on a short or narrow phone.
    42	  function resize() {
    43	    const vv = window.visualViewport;
    44	    const vw = Math.round((vv && vv.width) || window.innerWidth);
    45	    const vh = Math.round((vv && vv.height) || window.innerHeight);
    46	    const coarse = isCoarse();
    47	    const portrait = vh >= vw;
    48	    const body = document.body;
    49	    if (body && body.classList) {
    50	      body.classList.toggle('touch', coarse || vw < 900);
    51	      body.classList.toggle('portrait-touch', coarse && portrait);
    52	      body.classList.toggle('landscape-touch', coarse && !portrait);
    53	    }
    54	
    55	    // Controls OVERLAY the canvas, so the playfield may use the whole viewport.
    56	    // In portrait we lift it out of the bottom thumb band so the hero is never
    57	    // hidden under a thumb; the band is a fraction of the height, never fixed.
    58	    const band = portrait ? Math.min(Math.round(vh * 0.30), 260) : 0;
    59	    const availW = vw - 4;
    60	    const availH = Math.max(vh - band, Math.round(vh * 0.5)) - 4;
    61	
    62	    let scale = Math.min(availW / SCREEN_W, availH / SCREEN_H);
    63	    if (!coarse && scale >= 2) scale = Math.floor(scale);   // crisp pixels on desktop
    64	    scale = Math.max(scale, 0.5);
    65	    const wrap = el('wrap');
    66	    if (wrap && wrap.style) {
    67	      // Centre the playfield in the space above the thumb band.
    68	      wrap.style.paddingBottom = portrait
    69	        ? Math.max(0, Math.round(vh - Math.round(SCREEN_H * scale)) - 8) + 'px' : '';
    70	    }
    71	    canvas.style.width = Math.round(SCREEN_W * scale) + 'px';
    72	    canvas.style.height = Math.round(SCREEN_H * scale) + 'px';
    73	  }
    74	  // resize() reads control rects that themselves depend on the body class it
    75	  // sets, so run it twice: pass 1 lays the controls out, pass 2 measures them.
    76	  function relayout() { resize(); resize(); }
    77	  window.addEventListener('resize', relayout);
    78	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () {
    79	    // iOS reports stale innerWidth/innerHeight during orientationchange.
    80	    relayout(); setTimeout(relayout, 120); setTimeout(relayout, 400);
    81	  });
    82	  if (window.visualViewport) {
    83	    // The mobile URL bar collapsing/expanding resizes the visual viewport only.
    84	    window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', relayout);
    85	  }

    88	  // ---- input ----
    89	  const keys = {};        // held
    90	  const pressed = {};      // edge: true for one frame
    91	  function clearInput() {
    92	    for (const k in keys) keys[k] = false;
    93	    for (const k in pressed) pressed[k] = false;
    94	  }
    95	  const KEYMAP = {
    96	    ArrowUp:'up', ArrowDown:'down', ArrowLeft:'left', ArrowRight:'right',
    97	    KeyW:'up', KeyS:'down', KeyA:'left', KeyD:'right',
    98	    KeyZ:'a', KeyJ:'a', Space:'a',
    99	    KeyX:'b', KeyK:'b',
   100	    Enter:'start', ShiftLeft:'select', ShiftRight:'select',
   101	    KeyM:'mute', KeyC:'cont'
   102	  };
   103	  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
   104	    const k = KEYMAP[e.code];
   105	    if (k) {
   106	      if (!keys[k]) pressed[k] = true;
   107	      keys[k] = true;
   108	      e.preventDefault();
   109	    }
   110	  });
   111	  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
   112	    const k = KEYMAP[e.code];
   113	    if (k) { keys[k] = false; e.preventDefault(); }
   114	  });
   115	  window.addEventListener('blur', clearInput);
   116	  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) clearInput(); });
   117	
   118	  // touch: the on-screen controller. Hit-testing is done against the ACTUAL
   119	  // control DOM elements (#dpad, #btn-a/b/start/select) so the touch zones can
   120	  // never drift away from what the player sees. Multi-touch: move + fire at once.
   121	  // WebAudio on mobile only starts from inside a real user-gesture handler, and
   122	  // the game's first Sound call happens later inside requestAnimationFrame. Unlock
   123	  // synchronously on the very first input of any kind, or the game plays silent.
   124	  let audioUnlocked = false;
   125	  function unlockAudio() {
   126	    if (audioUnlocked) return;
   127	    audioUnlocked = true;
   128	    try { if (typeof Sound !== 'undefined' && Sound.unlock) Sound.unlock(); } catch (e) {}
   129	  }
   130	  window.addEventListener('keydown', unlockAudio, true);
   131	  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlockAudio, true);
   132	  window.addEventListener('mousedown', unlockAudio, true);
   133	
   134	  // Touch controller: a LEFT-THUMB FLOATING STICK plus right-side action
   135	  // buttons. The stick materialises wherever the thumb lands inside #stick-zone
   136	  // and steers from that origin, so there is nothing to aim at. Pointer Events
   137	  // give multi-touch (steer + fire together) and mouse support for free: each
   138	  // pointerId owns one control from press to release and never steals another.
   139	  const TOUCH_BUTTONS = ['a', 'b', 'start', 'select', 'cont', 'mute'];
   140	  function setupTouch() {
   141	    const zoneEl = el('stick-zone'), stickEl = el('stick'), knobEl = el('knob');
   142	    const btnEl = {
   143	      a: el('btn-a'), b: el('btn-b'), start: el('btn-start'),
   144	      select: el('btn-select'), cont: el('btn-c'), mute: el('btn-m')
   145	    };
   146	    const owners = {};              // pointerId -> {own, x, y, ox, oy}
   147	    const RADIUS = 54;              // px from origin for a full deflection
   148	    const DEAD = 14;                // px dead zone
   149	
   150	    const opts = { passive: false };
   151	    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', down, opts);
   152	    window.addEventListener('pointermove', moved, opts);
   153	    window.addEventListener('pointerup', up, opts);
   154	    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', up, opts);
   155	    // Belt and braces: some in-app browsers still emit only touch events.
   156	    window.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
   157	      if (Object.keys(owners).length) e.preventDefault();
   158	    }, opts);
   159	
   160	    function visible(e) { return !!visRect(e); }
   161	    function inEl(p, e) {
   162	      const r = visRect(e); if (!r) return false;
   163	      return p.x >= r.left && p.x <= r.right && p.y >= r.top && p.y <= r.bottom;
   164	    }
   165	    function ownerAt(p) {
   166	      for (const name of TOUCH_BUTTONS) if (inEl(p, btnEl[name])) return name;
   167	      if (inEl(p, zoneEl)) return 'stick';
   168	      return null;
   169	    }
   170	    function down(e) {
   171	      unlockAudio();
   172	      const p = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
   173	      const own = ownerAt(p);
   174	      if (!own) return;
   175	      owners[e.pointerId] = { own: own, x: p.x, y: p.y, ox: p.x, oy: p.y };
   176	      if (own === 'stick' && stickEl) {
   177	        stickEl.style.left = p.x + 'px';
   178	        stickEl.style.top = p.y + 'px';
   179	        setActive2(stickEl, true); setActive2(knobEl, true);
   180	      }
   181	      if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
   182	      apply();
   183	    }
   184	    function moved(e) {
   185	      const o = owners[e.pointerId];
   186	      if (!o) return;
   187	      o.x = e.clientX; o.y = e.clientY;
   188	      if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
   189	      apply();
   190	    }
   191	    function up(e) {
   192	      const o = owners[e.pointerId];
   193	      if (!o) return;
   194	      delete owners[e.pointerId];
   195	      if (o.own === 'stick') { setActive2(stickEl, false); setActive2(knobEl, false); }
   196	      apply();
   197	    }
   198	    function setActive(e, on) { if (e && e.classList) e.classList.toggle('active', !!on); }
   199	    function setActive2(e, on) { if (e && e.classList) e.classList.toggle('on', !!on); }
   200	
   201	    const last = {};
   202	    const lastDir = { up:false, down:false, left:false, right:false };
   203	    function apply() {
   204	      let up_ = false, dn = false, lt = false, rt = false;
   205	      const held = {};
   206	      for (const id in owners) {
   207	        const o = owners[id];
   208	        if (o.own === 'stick') {
   209	          let dx = o.x - o.ox, dy = o.y - o.oy;
   210	          const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   211	          if (len > DEAD) {
   212	            // 4-way: the dominant axis wins, matching the hero's movement model.
   213	            if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) { if (dx < 0) lt = true; else rt = true; }
   214	            else { if (dy < 0) up_ = true; else dn = true; }
   215	          }
   216	          if (knobEl && knobEl.style) {
   217	            const k = len > RADIUS ? RADIUS / len : 1;
   218	            const half = (stickEl && stickEl.offsetWidth) ? stickEl.offsetWidth / 2 : 66;
   219	            knobEl.style.left = (half + dx * k) + 'px';
   220	            knobEl.style.top = (half + dy * k) + 'px';
   221	          }
   222	        } else held[o.own] = true;
   223	      }
   224	      const dirs = { up: up_, down: dn, left: lt, right: rt };
   225	      for (const d in dirs) {
   226	        // Edge presses too: menus (the pack screen) read pressed, not held.
   227	        if (dirs[d] && !lastDir[d]) pressed[d] = true;
   228	        lastDir[d] = dirs[d];
   229	        keys[d] = dirs[d];
   230	      }
   231	      for (const name of TOUCH_BUTTONS) {
   232	        const on = !!held[name];
   233	        if (on && !last[name]) pressed[name] = true;   // edge press for one frame
   234	        last[name] = on;
   235	        keys[name] = on;
   236	        setActive(btnEl[name], on);
   237	      }
   238	      if (up_ || dn || lt || rt) hideTip();
   239	    }
   240	  }
   241	  let tipHidden = false;
   242	  function hideTip() {
   243	    if (tipHidden) return;
   244	    tipHidden = true;
   245	    const t = el('tip');
   246	    if (t && t.classList) setTimeout(() => t.classList.add('gone'), 1500);
   247	  }
   248	  window.addEventListener('keydown', hideTip);
   249	  setupTouch();
   250	
   251	  function clearPressed() { for (const k in pressed) pressed[k] = false; }
   252	
   253	  // ---- loop (fixed 60Hz logic) ----
   254	  // nowMs(): high-res clock when available, else Date.now(). Some headless/test
   255	  // environments don't expose `performance`, and depending on it hard-crashed boot.
   256	  const nowMs = (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now)
   257	    ? () => performance.now() : () => Date.now();
   258	  let updateFn = () => {}, renderFn = () => {};
   259	  let acc = 0, last = 0;
   260	  const STEP = 1000 / 60;
   261	  let _useRAF = true;
   262	  function tick() { frame(nowMs()); }
   263	  function frame(now) {
   264	    try {
   265	      if (!last) last = now;
   266	      acc += now - last;
   267	      last = now;
   268	      if (acc > 250) acc = 250;     // avoid spiral after tab-out
   269	      let steps = 0;
   270	      while (acc >= STEP && steps < 5) {
   271	        updateFn();
   272	        clearPressed();
   273	        acc -= STEP; steps++;
   274	      }
   275	      renderFn(ctx);
   276	    } catch(e) {
   277	      var _d = (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.getElementById) ? document.getElementById('dbg') : null;
   278	      if (_d) { _d.style.display='block'; _d.textContent='frame-err:' + (e&&e.message?e.message:String(e)); }
   279	      ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
   280	      ctx.fillStyle = '#f44'; ctx.font = '8px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
   281	      ctx.fillText('ERR:', 4, 4);
   282	      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   283	      var msg = (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) + ' L' + (e && e.stack ? e.stack.split('\n')[1] : '');
   284	      var words = msg.split(' '), line = '', y = 16;
   285	      for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
   286	        if ((line + ' ' + words[i]).length > 28) { ctx.fillText(line.trim(), 4, y); y += 10; line = words[i]; }
   287	        else line += ' ' + words[i];
   288	      }
   289	      if (line.trim()) ctx.fillText(line.trim(), 4, y);
   290	      return; // stop the loop
   291	    }
   292	    if (_useRAF) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else setTimeout(tick, 16);
   293	  }
   294	  function run(update, render) {
   295	    updateFn = update; renderFn = render;
   296	    // Draw gold immediately to test if ctx works at all (sync, no rAF needed)
   297	    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8d030';
   298	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
   299	    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
   300	    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
   301	    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
   302	    ctx.fillText('STARTING...', 4, 4);
   303	    // Also run one frame synchronously
   304	    frame(nowMs());
   305	    // frame() owns the single recurring scheduler chain.
   306	  }
   307	
   308	  // ---- tiny deterministic-ish RNG ----
   309	  let seed = 0x2545f491;
   310	  function rand() {
   311	    seed ^= seed << 13; seed ^= seed >>> 17; seed ^= seed << 5;
   312	    return ((seed >>> 0) / 4294967296);
   313	  }
   314	  const randInt = (a, b) => a + Math.floor(rand() * (b - a + 1));
   315	  const choice = arr => arr[Math.floor(rand() * arr.length)];
   316	
   317	  // ---- draw helpers ----
   318	  function rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, col) { ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(x|0, y|0, w|0, h|0); }
   319	  function text(ctx, str, x, y, col='#fff', scale=1) {
   320	    Font.draw(ctx, str, x, y, col, scale);
   321	  }
   322	
   323	  return { canvas, ctx, keys, pressed, run, rand, randInt, choice, rect, text,
   324	           clearPressed,
   325	           TILE, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H, HUD_H, PLAY_W, PLAY_H, COLS, ROWS };
   326	})();

   258	  let updateFn = () => {}, renderFn = () => {};
   259	  let acc = 0, last = 0;

   261	  let _useRAF = true;
   262	  function tick() { frame(nowMs()); }
   263	  function frame(now) {
   264	    try {
   265	      if (!last) last = now;
   266	      acc += now - last;
   267	      last = now;
   268	      if (acc > 250) acc = 250;     // avoid spiral after tab-out
   269	      let steps = 0;
   270	      while (acc >= STEP && steps < 5) {

   272	        clearPressed();

   319	  function text(ctx, str, x, y, col='#fff', scale=1) {

   321	  }
   322	
   323	  return { canvas, ctx, keys, pressed, run, rand, randInt, choice, rect, text,
   324	           clearPressed,
   325	           TILE, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H, HUD_H, PLAY_W, PLAY_H, COLS, ROWS };
   326	})();
--- game top/lifecycle ---
     1	/* game.js — state machine, screen/room management, HUD, caves, combat glue. */

     3	const Game = (() => {
     4	  const E = Entities;
     5	  const TRIFORCE_PIECES = 8;
     6	  // `dbg` is an optional on-screen debug logger defined by index.html. Fall back
     7	  // to a no-op so the game boots in any host (tests, embeds) that lacks it.
     8	  const dbg = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.dbg) ? window.dbg : function(){};
     9	
    10	  const state = {
    11	    mode: 'title',        // title | overworld | dungeon | cave | scroll | gameover | win | ending
    12	    prevMode: 'overworld',
    13	    col: 0, row: 0,
    14	    level: null,
    15	    grid: null, theme: 'over',
    16	    screenImg: null,
    17	    entities: [],
    18	    link: null,
    19	    swordSwung: 0,
    20	    swordSwingId: 0,
    21	    swordHitSet: new Set(),
    22	    keys: Engine.keys, pressed: Engine.pressed,
    23	    rand: Engine.rand, randInt: Engine.randInt, choice: Engine.choice,
    24	    cleared: new Set(),       // dungeon rooms cleared THIS visit (resets on exit)
    25	    taken: new Set(),         // unique items collected (bow, boomerang, triforce...)
    26	    revealed: new Set(),      // overworld screens whose secret was uncovered (persists)
    27	    worldEdges: {},           // persistent unlocked dungeon edges
    28	    edgeState: {},            // current dungeon visit: locked/open/shut
    29	    pushed: new Set(),        // dungeon rooms whose block was pushed this visit
    30	    lit: new Set(),           // dark rooms lit this visit
    31	    dark: false,              // current room is dark
    32	    cave: null,
    33	    scroll: null,
    34	    msg: null, msgT: 0,
    35	    dialogue: null,
    36	    flashWin: 0,
    37	    flashEnding: 0,
    38	    triforces: 0,
    39	    TRIFORCE_PIECES,
    40	    quest: { phase: 'collecting', triforces: 0 },
    41	    visitedScreens: new Set(),
    42	    visitedRooms: new Set(),
    43	    stock: {},
    44	    counters: {},
    45	    lowHealthT: 0,
    46	    banner: null, bannerT: 0,
    47	    rupeePopups: [],
    48	    pauseSel: 0,              // cursor index on the pause/inventory screen
    49	    pauseIcons: null,
    50	    _raftGateTile: null,
    51	    _raftRide: null,
    52	    raftRide: null,
    53	  };
    54	
    55	  // expose mutable input each frame
    56	  Object.defineProperty(state, 'keys', { get: () => Engine.keys });
    57	  Object.defineProperty(state, 'pressed', { get: () => Engine.pressed });
    58	
    59	  // ---------- helpers ----------
    60	  function key3(prefix, c, r) { return prefix + ':' + c + ',' + r; }
    61	
    62	  const screenPool = [];
    63	  const DUNGEON_SCREEN_LEVELS = {};
    64	  for (const k in World.CFG) if (World.CFG[k].dungeon) DUNGEON_SCREEN_LEVELS[k] = World.CFG[k].dungeon.level;
    65	  function bakeScreen(grid, theme) {
    66	    let c = state.screenImg;
    67	    if (!c || state._bakeNext) {
    68	      let index = c ? screenPool.indexOf(c) : -1;
    69	      if (index < 0) index = screenPool.length;
    70	      if (state._bakeNext) index = (index + 1) % 3;
    71	      c = screenPool[index] || (screenPool[index] = document.createElement('canvas'));
    72	    }
    73	    c.width = PLAY_W; c.height = PLAY_H;
    74	    const x = c.getContext('2d');
    75	    x.fillStyle = '#000'; x.fillRect(0, 0, PLAY_W, PLAY_H);
    76	    const tileTheme = Tiles.levelTheme(theme, state.mode === 'dungeon' && state.level ? state.level.id : 0);
    77	    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    78	      for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
    79	        const ch = grid[r][col];
    80	        Tiles.blit(x, tileTheme, ch, col * 16, r * 16);
    81	      }
    82	    }
    83	    return c;
    84	  }
    85	
    86	  function solidFor(entity, px, py) {
    87	    const c = Math.floor(px / 16), r = Math.floor(py / 16);
    88	    if (c < 0 || c > 15 || r < 0 || r > 10) return false;   // off-edge = walk-through (triggers transition)
    89	    const ch = state.grid[r][c];
    90	    if (entity && entity.kind === 'enemy' && ['keese', 'tektite', 'peahat'].includes(entity.etype)) return false;
    91	    if (entity && entity.kind === 'link' && ch === 'W' && entity.hasStepladder) {
    92	      const d = E.DIRS[entity.dir] || [0, 0];
    93	      const bc = c + d[0], br = r + d[1];
    94	      // The ladder is a one-tile bridge: the tile immediately beyond the
    95	      // water must be ordinary walkable ground, never a second W.
    96	      if (bc >= 0 && bc < COLS && br >= 0 && br < ROWS) {
    97	        const beyond = state.grid[br][bc];
    98	        if (beyond !== 'W' && !Tiles.isSolid(beyond)) return false;
    99	      }
   100	    }
   101	    return Tiles.isSolid(ch);
   102	  }
   103	  function solidAt(px, py, entity) { return solidFor(entity || state.link, px, py); }
   104	
   105	  function tileAtPx(px, py) {
   106	    const c = Math.floor(px / 16), r = Math.floor(py / 16);
   107	    if (c < 0 || c > 15 || r < 0 || r > 10) return null;
   108	    return { c, r, ch: state.grid[r][c] };
   109	  }
   110	
   111	  // ---------- loading screens ----------
   112	  function loadOverworld(col, row, entryPos) {
   113	    const sc = World.get(col, row);
   114	    if (!sc) return false;
   115	    clearHoist();
   116	    state.mode = 'overworld';
   117	    state.col = col; state.row = row;
   118	    state.visitedScreens.add(col + ',' + row);
   119	    state.theme = sc.theme;
   120	    // grid as char arrays (mutable — secrets/doors rewrite tiles in place)
   121	    state.grid = sc.rows.map(s => s.split('').slice(0, 16));
   122	    // previously revealed secrets stay revealed (bombed wall -> cave, burned tree -> stairs)
   123	    if (state.revealed.has('sec:' + col + ',' + row)) {
   124	      const secret = sc.secret, pos = secret && secret.tile;
   125	      for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   126	        if (!pos || c !== pos.c || r !== pos.r) continue;
   127	        if (state.grid[r][c] === 'H') state.grid[r][c] = 'C';
   128	        if (state.grid[r][c] === 'U') state.grid[r][c] = 'S';
   129	        if (state.grid[r][c] === 'G' || state.grid[r][c] === 'A') state.grid[r][c] = 'S';
   130	      }
   131	    }
   132	    // Level 7's entrance is deliberately a tune-awakened landmark.
   133	    if (sc.hiddenDungeon && state.revealed.has('sec:' + col + ',' + row) &&
   134	        (!sc.dungeon || sc.dungeon.level !== 9 || ['level9Open','ganonDefeated','rescued'].includes(state.quest.phase))) state.grid[5][7] = 'D';
   135	    if (col === 5 && row === 5 && state.revealed.has('sec:5,5')) {
   136	      for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) if (state.grid[r][c] === 'W') state.grid[r][c] = '.';
   137	      state.grid[5][7] = 'S';
   138	    }
   139	    state.screenImg = bakeScreen(state.grid, state.theme);
   140	    state.entities = [];
   141	    // enemies respawn on every screen entry (authentic Zelda 1 behavior —
   142	    // the world never goes permanently quiet)
   143	    if (sc.enemies) for (const [t, v, tx, ty] of sc.enemies) spawnEnemy(t, v, tx, ty);
   144	    if (entryPos) { state.link.x = entryPos[0]; state.link.y = entryPos[1]; }
   145	    Sound.playTrack('overworld');
   146	    return true;
   147	  }
   148	
   149	  function loadDungeonRoom(col, row, entryPos) {
   150	    const lvl = state.level;
   151	    const rd = Dungeon.getRoom(lvl, col, row);
   152	    if (!rd) return false;
   153	    clearHoist();
   154	    state.mode = 'dungeon';
   155	    state.col = col; state.row = row;
   156	    state.visitedRooms.add(lvl.id + ':' + col + ',' + row);
   157	    state.theme = rd.room.theme;
   158	    state.grid = rd.room.rows.map(s => s.split(''));
   159	    applyDoorState(lvl, col, row);
   160	    const roomKey = key3('d' + lvl.id, col, row);
   161	    if (state.pushed.has(roomKey) && rd.room.push) {
   162	      const p = rd.room.push;
   163	      if (state.grid[p.r] && state.grid[p.r][p.c] === 'p') state.grid[p.r][p.c] = 'F';
   164	    }
   165	    // dark rooms: pitch black until lit with a flame this visit
   166	    state.dark = !!rd.room.dark && !state.lit.has(roomKey);
   167	    state.screenImg = bakeScreen(state.grid, state.theme);
   168	    state.entities = [];
   169	    const cleared = state.cleared.has(roomKey);
   170	    if (!cleared && rd.enemies) for (const [t, v, tx, ty] of rd.enemies) spawnEnemy(t, v, tx, ty);
   171	    if (rd.room.traps) {
   172	      for (const corner of ['tl','tr','bl','br']) state.entities.push(E.makeBladeTrap(corner));
   173	    }
   174	    if (rd.boss && !state.taken.has(key3('boss' + lvl.id, col, row))) {
   175	      const b = rd.boss, o = b.bossOpts || {};
   176	      if (b.variant === 'gleeok')        state.entities.push(E.makeGleeok(b.x, b.y, o));
   177	      else if (b.variant === 'dodongo')  state.entities.push(E.makeDodongo(b.x, b.y, o));
   178	      else if (b.variant === 'manhandla')state.entities.push(E.makeManhandla(b.x, b.y, o));
   179	      else if (b.variant === 'gohma')    state.entities.push(E.makeGohma(b.x, b.y, o));
   180	      else if (b.variant === 'digdogger')state.entities.push(E.makeDigdogger(b.x, b.y, o));
   285	  }
   286	
   287	  function clearHoist() {
   288	    if (!state.link) return;
   289	    state.link.hoist = 0;
   290	    state.link.hoistItem = null;
   291	  }
   292	
   293	  // ---------- transitions ----------
   294	  function startScroll(dir, ncol, nrow, loader) {
   295	    clearHoist();
   296	    const fromImg = state.screenImg;
   297	    // pre-load target into a temp by swapping grid; bake; then restore for animation
   298	    const savedGrid = state.grid, savedImg = state.screenImg, savedTheme = state.theme,
   299	          savedCol = state.col, savedRow = state.row, savedEnts = state.entities;
   300	    state._bakeNext = true;
   301	    loader();   // mutates state to new screen (entities for new screen created but we hold them)
   302	    state._bakeNext = false;
   303	    const toImg = state.screenImg;
   304	    const newEnts = state.entities;
   305	    const newCol = state.col, newRow = state.row, newGrid = state.grid, newTheme = state.theme;
   306	    // restore old for animation
   307	    state.grid = savedGrid; state.screenImg = savedImg; state.theme = savedTheme;
   308	    state.col = savedCol; state.row = savedRow;
   309	
   310	    const link = state.link;
   311	    const linkFrom = { x: link.x, y: link.y };
   312	    const linkTo = { x: link.x, y: link.y };
   313	    if (dir === 'left')  { linkTo.x = PLAY_W - 18; }
   314	    if (dir === 'right') { linkTo.x = 2; }
   315	    if (dir === 'up')    { linkTo.y = PLAY_H - 18; }
   316	    if (dir === 'down')  { linkTo.y = 2; }
   317	
   318	    state.scroll = {
   319	      dir, t: 0, max: 28, fromImg, toImg, linkFrom, linkTo,
   320	      finalize() {
   321	        state.col = newCol; state.row = newRow; state.grid = newGrid;
   322	        state.theme = newTheme; state.screenImg = toImg; state.entities = newEnts;
   323	        state.mode = (World.get(newCol, newRow) && state.level == null) ? 'overworld' : state.mode;
   324	        link.x = linkTo.x; link.y = linkTo.y; link.knock = null;
   325	      }
   326	    };
   327	    state.prevMode = state.mode;
   328	    state.mode = 'scroll';
   329	  }
   330	
   331	  const RAFT_ROUTES = Object.freeze({
   332	    '5,5:right': { col:6, row:5, x:7*16, y:5*16 },
   333	    '6,5:left':  { col:5, row:5, x:7*16, y:5*16 },
   334	    '7,5:right': { col:8, row:5, x:7*16, y:5*16 },
   335	    '8,5:left':  { col:7, row:5, x:7*16, y:5*16 },
   336	  });
   337	  function startRaftRide(dir, ncol, nrow, targetPos) {
   338	    const fromImg = state.screenImg;
   339	    const linkFrom = { x:state.link.x, y:state.link.y };
   340	    const savedGrid = state.grid, savedImg = state.screenImg, savedTheme = state.theme,
   341	      savedCol = state.col, savedRow = state.row, savedEnts = state.entities;
   342	    state._bakeNext = true;
   343	    loadOverworld(ncol, nrow, targetPos);
   344	    state._bakeNext = false;
   345	    const toImg = state.screenImg, newEnts = state.entities, newGrid = state.grid,
   346	      newCol = state.col, newRow = state.row, newTheme = state.theme;
   347	    state.grid = savedGrid; state.screenImg = savedImg; state.theme = savedTheme;
   348	    state.col = savedCol; state.row = savedRow; state.entities = savedEnts;
   349	    state.scroll = {
   350	      dir, t:0, max:44, raft:true, fromImg, toImg,
   351	      linkFrom, linkTo:{x:targetPos[0], y:targetPos[1]},
   352	      finalize() {
   353	        state.col = newCol; state.row = newRow; state.grid = newGrid; state.theme = newTheme;
   354	        state.screenImg = toImg; state.entities = newEnts; state.mode = 'overworld';
   355	        state.link.x = targetPos[0]; state.link.y = targetPos[1]; state.link.knock = null; state._raftRide = null; state.raftRide = null;
   356	      }
   357	    };
   358	    state.prevMode = 'overworld'; state.mode = 'scroll';
   359	    state._raftRide = state.raftRide = { dir, from: savedCol + ',' + savedRow, to:ncol + ',' + nrow };
   360	  }
   361	  function tryStartRaftRide() {
   362	    if (state.mode !== 'overworld' || !state.link || !state.link.hasRaft) return false;
   363	    const t = tileAtPx(state.link.x + 8, state.link.y + 8);
   364	    if (!t || t.ch !== 'K') return false;
   365	    for (const dir of ['left','right','up','down']) {
   366	      if (!state.keys[dir]) continue;
   367	      const route = RAFT_ROUTES[state.col + ',' + state.row + ':' + dir];
   368	      if (!route || !World.edgeOpen(state.col,state.row,route.col,route.row)) continue;
   369	      startRaftRide(dir, route.col, route.row, [route.x, route.y]); return true;
   370	    }
   371	    return false;
   372	  }
   373	
   374	  function checkEdge() {
   375	    const link = state.link;
   376	    let dir = null;
   377	    if (link.x < -2) dir = 'left';
   378	    else if (link.x > PLAY_W - 14) dir = 'right';
   379	    else if (link.y < -2) dir = 'up';
   380	    else if (link.y > PLAY_H - 14) dir = 'down';
   381	    if (!dir) return;
   382	
   383	    if (state.mode === 'overworld') {
   384	      const d = E.DIRS[dir];
   385	      const nc = state.col + d[0], nr = state.row + d[1];
   386	      if (World.get(nc, nr) && World.edgeOpen(state.col, state.row, nc, nr)) startScroll(dir, nc, nr, () => loadOverworld(nc, nr));
   387	      else clampLink();
   388	    } else if (state.mode === 'dungeon') {
   389	      const rd = Dungeon.getRoom(state.level, state.col, state.row);
   390	      // bottom door of entrance room -> exit to overworld
   391	      if (dir === 'down' && rd && rd.exit && rd.exit.down) { exitDungeon(); return; }
   392	      const d = E.DIRS[dir];
   393	      const nc = state.col + d[0], nr = state.row + d[1];
   394	      if (Dungeon.getRoom(state.level, nc, nr)) startScroll(dir, nc, nr, () => loadDungeonRoom(nc, nr));
   395	      else clampLink();
   396	    } else if (state.mode === 'cave') {
   397	      if (dir === 'down') exitCave();
   398	      else clampLink();
   399	    }
   400	  }
   401	  function clampLink() {
   402	    const l = state.link;
   403	    l.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(PLAY_W - 16, l.x));
   404	    l.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(PLAY_H - 16, l.y));
   405	  }
   406	
   407	  // find an open (non-solid) tile at-or-below a column, return pixel pos
   408	  function freeBelow(col, row) {
   409	    for (let r = row; r <= 9; r++) {
   410	      if (!Tiles.isSolid(state.grid[r][col])) return [col * 16, r * 16];
   411	    }
   412	    // fall back: scan whole interior
   413	    for (let r = 9; r >= 1; r--)
   414	      for (let c = 1; c <= 14; c++)
   415	        if (!Tiles.isSolid(state.grid[r][c])) return [c * 16, r * 16];
   416	    return [7 * 16, 8 * 16];
   417	  }

   466	  function caveScreenKey() {
   467	    const ret = state.cave && state.cave.ret;
   468	    return ret ? ret.col + ',' + ret.row : state.col + ',' + state.row;

   470	  function caveStockKey(item) { return caveScreenKey() + ':' + item; }
   471	  function caveUnique(item) { return 'cave-' + caveScreenKey() + '-' + item; }
   472	  function spawnCaveItem(id, x, opts={}) {
   473	    const it = E.makeItem(id, x * 16, opts.y === undefined ? 4 * 16 : opts.y * 16, {permanent:true});
   474	    if (opts.unique) it._unique = opts.unique;
   475	    if (opts.price !== undefined) it.price = opts.price;

   572	  function caveKindAt(sc, tile) {

   579	  function enterDungeon(level, tile) {
   580	    if (level === 9 && !['level9Open','ganonDefeated','rescued'].includes(state.quest.phase)) return;
   581	    if (level === 6 && !state.link.hasRaft) {
   582	      const gate = state.col + ',' + state.row + ':' + (tile ? tile.c + ',' + tile.r : 'dungeon');
   583	      if (state._raftGateTile !== gate) {
   584	        state._raftGateTile = gate;
   585	        showMsg('YOU NEED THE RAFT TO CROSS.', 180);
   586	      }
   587	      return;
   588	    }
   589	    state.level = Dungeon.level(level);
   590	    state.prevReturn = { col: state.col, row: state.row, tile: tile ? { c: tile.c, r: tile.r } : null };
   591	    state.visitedScreens.add('dungeon:L' + level);
   592	    state.counters.dungeonEntrances = state.counters.dungeonEntrances || {};
   593	    state.counters.dungeonEntrances[level] = { col:state.col, row:state.row, tile: tile ? {c:tile.c,r:tile.r} : null };
   594	    state.banner = 'VAULT-' + level + '  ' + (DUNGEON_NAMES[level] || 'DUNGEON'); state.bannerT = 120;
   595	    // every dungeon visit is fresh: rooms repopulate, shutters close, darkness returns
   596	    resetDungeonVisit(state.level.id);
   597	    Sound.playTrack(level === 9 ? 'level9' : 'dungeon');
   598	    Sound.SFX.stairs();
   599	    const en = state.level.entry;
   600	    loadDungeonRoom(en.col, en.row, [en.pos[0] * 16, en.pos[1] * 16]);

   602	  function resetDungeonVisit(lvlId) {
   603	    const pre = 'd' + lvlId + ':';
   604	    for (const k of [...state.cleared]) if (k.startsWith(pre)) state.cleared.delete(k);
   605	    for (const k of [...state.pushed]) if (k.startsWith(pre)) state.pushed.delete(k);
   606	    for (const k of [...state.lit]) if (k.startsWith(pre)) state.lit.delete(k);
   607	    state.edgeState = {};
   608	  }
   609	  function exitDungeon() {

   638	  // ---------- save / continue (localStorage) ----------
   639	  const SAVE_KEY = 'wanderlight_save_v1';
   640	  const BEST_KEY = 'wanderlight_best_v1';
   641	  function bestShards() {
   642	    try { return Math.max(0, parseInt(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY) || '0', 10) || 0); }
   643	    catch (e) { return 0; }

   645	  function noteBest() {
   646	    try {
   647	      localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(Math.max(state.triforces | 0, bestShards())));
   648	    } catch (e) {}
   649	  }
   650	  const LINK_SAVE_KEYS = [
   651	    'maxHealth','health','bombs','maxBombs','rupees','keys','swordDmg','bItem','triforce','potion','potionCharges',
   652	    ...Object.values(ITEMS).map(it => it.flag).filter(Boolean),
   653	    ...Object.values(ITEMS).flatMap(it => it.saveFields || []),
   654	  ];
   655	  const UNIQUE_LINK_SAVE_KEYS = [...new Set(LINK_SAVE_KEYS)];
   656	  function saveGame() {
   657	    noteBest();
   658	    try {
   659	      const l = state.link;
   660	      // anchor: current overworld screen, or the overworld return point if inside
   661	      let col = state.col, row = state.row, x = l.x, y = l.y;
   662	      if (state.level && state.prevReturn) {
   663	        col = state.prevReturn.col; row = state.prevReturn.row;
   664	        x = 7 * 16; y = 8 * 16;
   665	      } else if (state.cave && state.cave.ret) {
   666	        col = state.cave.ret.col; row = state.cave.ret.row;
   667	        x = state.cave.ret.pos[0]; y = state.cave.ret.pos[1];
   668	      }
   669	      const link = {};
   670	      for (const k of UNIQUE_LINK_SAVE_KEYS) link[k] = l[k];
   671	      localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
   672	        v: 2,
   673	        quest: { phase: state.quest.phase, triforces: state.triforces },
   674	        link,
   675	        world: {
   676	          position: { col, row, x, y },
   677	          taken: [...state.taken],
   678	          revealed: [...new Set([...state.revealed].map(s => s.startsWith('sec:') ? s : 'sec:' + s))],
   679	          edges: Object.assign({}, state.worldEdges),
   680	          visitedScreens: [...state.visitedScreens],
   681	          visitedRooms: [...state.visitedRooms],
   682	          stock: Object.assign({}, state.stock),
   683	          counters: Object.assign({}, state.counters),
   684	        },
   685	      }));
   686	    } catch (e) { /* storage unavailable (private mode etc.) — play on */ }
   687	  }
   688	  function hasSave() {
   689	    try { return !!localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY); } catch (e) { return false; }
   690	  }
   691	  function isRecord(v) { return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v); }
   692	  function finite(v) { return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v); }
   693	  function int(v) { return finite(v) && Number.isInteger(v); }
   694	  function stringArray(v, optional = true) {
   695	    if (v === undefined && optional) return [];
   696	    return Array.isArray(v) && v.every(s => typeof s === 'string');
   697	  }
   698	  function numberOrDefault(v, fallback) { return finite(v) ? v : fallback; }
   699	  function clampLink(l) {
   700	    l.maxHealth = Math.max(6, Math.min(80, Math.round(numberOrDefault(l.maxHealth, 6))));
   701	    l.health = Math.max(0, Math.min(l.maxHealth, Math.round(numberOrDefault(l.health, l.maxHealth))));
   702	    l.maxBombs = Math.max(8, Math.min(16, Math.round(numberOrDefault(l.maxBombs, 8))));
   703	    l.bombs = Math.max(0, Math.min(l.maxBombs, Math.round(numberOrDefault(l.bombs, 0))));
   704	    l.rupees = Math.max(0, Math.min(ITEMS.caps.rupees, Math.round(numberOrDefault(l.rupees, 0))));
   705	    l.keys = Math.max(0, Math.min(ITEMS.caps.keys, Math.round(numberOrDefault(l.keys, 0))));
   706	    l.swordDmg = Math.max(1, Math.min(9, Math.round(numberOrDefault(l.swordDmg, 1))));
   707	    l.health = Math.max(6, l.health);   // continue with ≥3 hearts, as in v1
   708	  }
   709	  function validateLinkSave(saved) {
   710	    if (saved !== undefined && !isRecord(saved)) return false;
   711	    if (!saved) return true;
   712	    for (const k of UNIQUE_LINK_SAVE_KEYS) {
   713	      if (!(k in saved)) continue;
   714	      const value = saved[k];
   715	      if (['maxHealth','health','bombs','maxBombs','potionCharges','rupees','keys','swordDmg'].includes(k)) {
   716	        if (!finite(value)) return false;
   717	      } else if (k === 'potion') {
   718	        if (value !== null && typeof value !== 'string') return false;
   719	      } else if (k === 'bItem') {
   720	        if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
   721	      } else if (typeof value !== 'boolean') return false;
   722	    }
   723	    return true;
   724	  }
   725	  function validPosition(pos) {
   726	    return isRecord(pos) && int(pos.col) && int(pos.row) && finite(pos.x) && finite(pos.y) &&
   727	      pos.x >= 0 && pos.x <= PLAY_W && pos.y >= 0 && pos.y <= PLAY_H &&
   728	      !!World.get(pos.col, pos.row);
   729	  }
   730	  function normalizeSecretIds(values) {
   731	    return values.map(s => (s.startsWith('sec:') || s.startsWith('reveal:')) ? s : 'sec:' + s);
   732	  }
   733	  function migrateV1Unlocked(values) {
   734	    if (typeof Dungeon !== 'undefined' && Dungeon.edgeForDoorTile) {
   735	      return values.map(s => Dungeon.edgeForDoorTile(s)).filter(Boolean);
   736	    }
   737	    return values.slice();
   738	  }
   739	  function readSave() {
   740	    let data;
   741	    try { data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)); } catch (e) { return null; }
   742	    if (!isRecord(data) || !int(data.v)) return null;
   743	    if (data.v === 1) {
   744	      if (!int(data.col) || !int(data.row) || !World.get(data.col, data.row) ||
   745	          !validateLinkSave(data.link) || !stringArray(data.taken) ||
   746	          !stringArray(data.revealed) || !stringArray(data.unlocked)) return null;
   747	      if (data.x !== undefined && (!finite(data.x) || data.x < 0 || data.x > PLAY_W)) return null;
   748	      if (data.y !== undefined && (!finite(data.y) || data.y < 0 || data.y > PLAY_H)) return null;
   749	      return {
   750	        version: 1,
   751	        link: data.link || {},
   752	        position: { col: data.col, row: data.row, x: numberOrDefault(data.x, 7 * 16), y: numberOrDefault(data.y, 8 * 16) },
   753	        taken: data.taken || [],
   754	        revealed: normalizeSecretIds(data.revealed || []),
   755	        edges: migrateV1Unlocked(data.unlocked || []),
   756	        triforces: Math.max(0, Math.min(TRIFORCE_PIECES, Math.round(numberOrDefault(data.triforces, 0)))),
   757	        visitedScreens: [], visitedRooms: [], stock: {}, counters: {},
   758	      };
   759	    }
   760	    const position = data.world && data.world.position ? data.world.position :
   761	      (data.position || { col: World.findStart().col, row: World.findStart().row, x: 7 * 16, y: 8 * 16 });
   762	    if (data.v !== 2 || !isRecord(data.quest) ||
   763	        !['collecting','level9Open','ganonDefeated','rescued'].includes(data.quest.phase) ||
   764	        !finite(data.quest.triforces) || !isRecord(data.world) || !isRecord(data.link) ||
   765	        !validateLinkSave(data.link) || !validPosition(position) ||
   766	        !stringArray(data.world.taken, false) || !stringArray(data.world.revealed, false) ||
   767	        !stringArray(data.world.visitedScreens, false) || !stringArray(data.world.visitedRooms, false) ||
   768	        !isRecord(data.world.edges) || !isRecord(data.world.stock) || !isRecord(data.world.counters)) return null;
   769	    for (const k in data.world.edges) if (!['open','locked','shut','shutter'].includes(data.world.edges[k])) return null;
   770	    return {
   771	      version: 2,
   772	      phase: data.quest.phase,
   773	      link: data.link,
   774	      position,
   775	      taken: data.world.taken,
   776	      revealed: normalizeSecretIds(data.world.revealed),
   777	      edges: Object.keys(data.world.edges).filter(k => data.world.edges[k] === 'open'),
   778	      visitedScreens: data.world.visitedScreens,
   779	      visitedRooms: data.world.visitedRooms,
   780	      stock: data.world.stock,
   781	      counters: data.world.counters,
   782	      triforces: Math.max(0, Math.min(TRIFORCE_PIECES, Math.round(data.quest.triforces))),
   783	    };
   784	  }
   785	  function loadGame() {
   786	    const save = readSave();
   787	    if (!save) { startGame(); return false; }
   788	    startGame();   // fresh baseline, then overlay the save
   789	    const l = state.link;
   790	    for (const k of UNIQUE_LINK_SAVE_KEYS) if (k in save.link) l[k] = save.link[k];
   791	    clampLink(l);
   792	    state.cleared = new Set();                        // per-visit only
   793	    state.taken = new Set(save.taken);
   794	    state.revealed = new Set(save.revealed);
   795	    state.worldEdges = {};
   796	    save.edges.forEach(u => { state.worldEdges[u] = 'open'; });
   797	    state.edgeState = {};
   798	    state.visitedScreens = new Set(save.visitedScreens);
   799	    state.visitedRooms = new Set(save.visitedRooms);
   800	    state.stock = Object.assign({}, save.stock);
   801	    state.counters = Object.assign({}, save.counters);
   802	    state.triforces = save.triforces;
   803	    state.quest = { phase: save.phase || 'collecting', triforces: state.triforces };
   804	    const p = save.position;
   805	    loadOverworld(p.col, p.row, [p.x, p.y]);
   806	    return true;
   807	  }

   885	  function resolveItemTouch(gameState, it) {
   886	    if (it.item === 'gamble') {
   887	      if (gameState.link.rupees < 10) {
   888	        if (!it._refusedTouch) { it._refusedTouch = true; showMsg("COIN FIRST, TRAVELLER.", 150); }
   889	        return 'refused';
   890	      }
   891	      const n = gameState.counters.gambleN || 0;
   892	      gameState.counters.gambleN = n + 1;
   893	      const outcomes = [-10, 20, 50];
   894	      const amount = outcomes[(n + (it._gambleIndex || 0)) % 3];
   895	      gameState.link.rupees = Math.max(0, Math.min(ITEMS.caps.rupees, gameState.link.rupees + amount));
   896	      gameState.taken.add(caveUnique('gamble'));
   897	      for (const e of gameState.entities) if (e._gambleIndex !== undefined) e.alive = false;
   898	      showMsg(amount < 0 ? 'YOU LOST 10 GLIMS.' : '+' + amount + ' GLIMS!', 180);
   899	      saveGame();
   900	      return 'taken';
   901	    }
   902	    if (it._unique && gameState.taken.has(it._unique)) { it.alive = false; return 'kept'; }
   903	    const def = ITEMS[it.item];
   904	    if (!def) return 'kept';
   905	    if (it.oneTime && it._stockKey && gameState.stock[it._stockKey]) return 'kept';
   906	    if (it.price && gameState.link.rupees < it.price) {
   907	      if (!it._refusedTouch) { it._refusedTouch = true; showMsg("COIN FIRST, TRAVELLER.", 150); }
   908	      return 'refused';
   909	    }
   910	    it._refusedTouch = false;
   911	    const result = def.onCollect ? def.onCollect(gameState.link, gameState, it) : undefined;
   912	    if (result === 'refused') return 'refused';
   913	    if (result === 'kept') return 'kept';
   914	    if (it.price) { gameState.link.rupees -= it.price; Sound.SFX.rupee(); }
   915	    if (it.oneTime && it._stockKey) gameState.stock[it._stockKey] = true;
   916	    if (it._unique) { gameState.taken.add(it._unique); saveGame(); }
   917	    else if (it.price || it.oneTime) saveGame();
   918	    const major = (def.slot === 'gear' || (def.slot === 'b' && it.item !== 'bomb') ||
   919	      it.item === 'heartcontainer' || it.item === 'triforce');
   920	    if (major && gameState.link.health > 0) {
   921	      gameState.link.hoist = 32;
   922	      gameState.link.hoistItem = it.item;
   923	    }
   924	    return 'taken';
   925	  }

   979	  function swordRect() {
   980	    const l = state.link;
   981	    switch (l.dir) {
   982	      case 'right': return { x: l.x + 11, y: l.y + 5, w: 15, h: 7 };
   983	      case 'left':  return { x: l.x - 10, y: l.y + 5, w: 15, h: 7 };
   984	      case 'up':    return { x: l.x + 5, y: l.y - 10, w: 7, h: 15 };
   985	      case 'down':  return { x: l.x + 5, y: l.y + 11, w: 7, h: 15 };

   988	  function doSwordHits() {
   989	    if (state.swordSwung <= 0) return;
   990	    const sword = swordRect(), lx = state.link.x + 8, ly = state.link.y + 8;
   991	    for (const en of state.entities) {
   992	      if (en.kind !== 'enemy' || en.alive === false ||
   993	          ((en.hidden || en.invulnerable) && en.etype !== 'ganon')) continue;
   994	      if (state.swordHitSet.has(en)) continue;
   995	      let hit = null;
   996	      if (en.segments) {
   997	        for (const s of en.segments) {
   998	          if (s.hp > 0 && E.overlap(sword, { x:s.x, y:s.y, w:14, h:14 })) {
   999	            hit = { x:s.x + 7, y:s.y + 7 }; break;
  1000	          }
  1001	        }
  1002	      } else if (E.overlap(sword, E.hitbox(en))) hit = { x:lx, y:ly };
  1003	      if (hit) {
  1004	        state.swordHitSet.add(en);
  1005	        en.hurt(state, state.link.swordDmg || 1, hit.x, hit.y);
  1006	      }
  1007	    }
  1008	  }

  1011	  function tryUnlock() {
  1012	    const l = state.link;
  1013	    if (l.keys <= 0 && !l.hasMagicKey) return;
  1014	    const cx = l.x + 8, cy = l.y + 8;
  1015	    let fx = cx, fy = cy;
  1016	    if (l.dir === 'left') fx = l.x - 2; if (l.dir === 'right') fx = l.x + 18;
  1017	    if (l.dir === 'up') fy = l.y - 2; if (l.dir === 'down') fy = l.y + 18;
  1018	    const t = tileAtPx(fx, fy);

  1020	      const edge = edgeForRoomTile(state.level, state.col, state.row, t.c, t.r);
  1021	      if (!edge) return;

  1024	      applyDoorState(state.level, state.col, state.row);
  1025	      if (!l.hasMagicKey) l.keys--;
  1026	      Sound.SFX.secret();
  1027	    }

  1030	  // ---------- update ----------
  1031	  function update() {
  1032	    if (state.bannerT > 0) state.bannerT--;
  1033	    for (const p of state.rupeePopups) { p.t--; p.y--; }
  1034	    state.rupeePopups = state.rupeePopups.filter(p => p.t > 0);
  1035	    const P = Engine.pressed;
  1036	    if (P.mute) { Sound.toggleMute(); state.muteFlash = 60; }
  1037	
  1038	    if (state.link && state.link.health > 0 && state.link.health <= 2 &&
  1039	        (state.mode === 'overworld' || state.mode === 'dungeon' || state.mode === 'cave')) {
  1040	      state.lowHealthT++;
  1041	      if (state.lowHealthT >= 45) { state.lowHealthT = 0; Sound.SFX.lowbeat(); }
  1042	    } else state.lowHealthT = 0;
  1043	
  1044	    if (state.mode === 'title') {
  1045	      if (P.start || P.a) { Sound.ensure(); startGame(); }
  1046	      else if (P.cont && hasSave()) { Sound.ensure(); loadGame(); }
  1047	      return;
  1048	    }
  1049	    if (state.mode === 'gameover') {
  1050	      if (P.start || P.a) { if (!hasSave() || !loadGame()) startGame(); }   // continue from last save
  1051	      if (state.msgT > 0) state.msgT--;
  1052	      return;
  1053	    }
  1054	    if (state.mode === 'ending') {
  1055	      state.flashEnding++;
  1056	      if ((P.start || P.a) && state.flashEnding > 120) { state.flashEnding = 0; startGame(); }
  1057	      return;
  1058	    }
  1059	    if (state.mode === 'win') {
  1060	      state.flashWin++;
  1061	      if ((P.start || P.a) && state.flashWin > 120) startGame();
  1062	      return;
  1063	    }
  1064	    if (state.mode === 'scroll') {
  1065	      const s = state.scroll;
  1066	      s.t++;
  1067	      if (s.t >= s.max) { s.finalize(); state.mode = state.prevMode === 'dungeon' ? 'dungeon' : (state.level ? 'dungeon' : 'overworld'); state.scroll = null; saveGame(); }
  1068	      return;
  1069	    }
  1070	    if (state.dialogue) {
  1071	      const d = state.dialogue, page = d.pages[d.index] || {};
  1072	      const choices = page && page.choices;
  1073	      if (choices && choices.length) {
  1074	        if (P.left) d.choice = (d.choice + choices.length - 1) % choices.length;
  1075	        if (P.right) d.choice = (d.choice + 1) % choices.length;
  1076	        if (P.a) {
  1077	          if (d.onChoose) d.onChoose(choices[d.choice].value);
  1078	          const done = d.onDone; state.dialogue = null; state.msg = null; state.msgT = 0;
  1079	          if (done) done();
  1080	        }
  1081	      } else if (P.a) {
  1082	        if (d.index + 1 < d.pages.length) { d.index++; d.choice = 0; setDialogPage(); }
  1083	        else {
  1084	          const done = d.onDone; state.dialogue = null; state.msg = null; state.msgT = 0;
  1085	          if (done) done();
  1086	        }
  1087	      }
  1088	      return;
  1089	    }
  1090	    if (state.mode === 'pause') {
  1091	      updatePause();
  1092	      return;
  1093	    }
  1094	
  1095	    // playing modes: overworld / dungeon / cave
  1096	    if (P.start) {   // pause / inventory
  1097	      state.prevMode = state.mode;
  1098	      state.mode = 'pause';
  1099	      state.pauseIcons = buildPauseIcons();
  1100	      state.pauseSel = Math.max(0, state.pauseIcons.bIds.indexOf(state.link.bItem));
  1101	      Sound.SFX.select();
  1102	      return;
  1103	    }
  1104	    // B-item quick cycle
  1105	    if (P.select) cycleItem();
  1106	
  1107	    if (tryStartRaftRide()) return;
  1108	    state.link.update(state);
  1109	    state.swordSwung = Math.max(0, state.swordSwung - 1);
  1110	    doSwordHits();
  1111	    if (state.mode === 'dungeon') {
  1112	      tryUnlock(); tryPush();
  1113	      // a flame lights a dark room for the rest of the visit
  1114	      if (state.dark && state.entities.some(e => e.kind === 'proj' && (e.ptype === 'flame' || e.ptype === 'fireblast'))) {
  1115	        state.dark = false;
  1116	        state.lit.add(key3('d' + state.level.id, state.col, state.row));
  1117	        Sound.SFX.secret();
  1118	      }
  1119	    } else if (state.mode === 'overworld') tryPush();
  1120	
  1121	    // update entities (freshly spawned enemies materialize behind a puff)
  1122	    for (const e of state.entities) {
  1123	      if (e.alive === false) continue;
  1124	      if (e._spawnDelay > 0) { e._spawnDelay--; continue; }
  1125	      if (e.update) e.update(state);
  1126	    }
  1127	
  1128	    // secrets: flames burn marked trees; (bomb reveals hook via onBombBlast)
  1129	    if (state.mode === 'overworld') checkBurnSecrets();
  1130	
  1131	    // deferred dungeon exit after collecting a non-final Triforce piece
  1132	    if (state._warpOut) { state._warpOut = false; exitDungeon(); return; }
  1133	
  1134	    // remove dead
  1135	    state.entities = state.entities.filter(e => e.alive !== false);
  1136	
  1137	    // room-clear bookkeeping (dungeon rooms stay cleared for THIS visit;
  1138	    // overworld enemies always respawn on re-entry). NOTE: uses a had-enemies
  1139	    // flag — comparing counts before/after the filter never fired because dead
  1140	    // enemies were already excluded from both counts.
  1141	    if (state.mode === 'dungeon' && state._hadEnemies && countEnemies() === 0) {
  1142	      state._hadEnemies = false;
  1143	      const roomKey = key3('d' + state.level.id, state.col, state.row);
  1144	      state.cleared.add(roomKey);
  1145	      const rd = Dungeon.getRoom(state.level, state.col, state.row);
  1146	      if (rd && rd.room.shutter === 'clear') openCondition('clear');
  1147	      if (rd && rd.item && rd.item.guarded && spawnRoomItem(rd, state.level.id, state.col, state.row)) {
  1148	        Sound.SFX.secret(); saveGame();
  1149	      }
  1150	    }
  1151	
  1152	    // triggers (cave/dungeon entrances)
  1153	    if (state.mode === 'overworld') {
  1154	      revealL9Entrance();
  1155	      const t = tileAtPx(state.link.x + 8, state.link.y + 10);
  1156	      if (!t || t.ch !== 'D') state._raftGateTile = null;
  1157	      if (t) {
  1158	        const sc = World.get(state.col, state.row);
  1159	        const caveKind = caveKindAt(sc, t);
  1160	        if (t.ch === 'C' && caveKind) enterCave(caveKind, t);
  1161	        else if (t.ch === 'S' && caveKind) enterCave(caveKind || 'shop', t);
  1162	        else if (t.ch === 'D' && sc.dungeon) enterDungeon(sc.dungeon.level, t);
  1163	      }
  1164	    }
  1165	
  1166	    checkEdge();
  1167	    if (state.msgT > 0 && state.msgT < 99999) state.msgT--;
  1168	  }

  1170	  // ---------- push blocks ----------
  1171	  function tryPush() {
  1172	    const l = state.link;
  1173	    if (!l.moving) { state._pushT = 0; return; }
  1174	    const [dx, dy] = E.DIRS[l.dir];
  1175	    const t = tileAtPx(l.x + 8 + dx * 12, l.y + 8 + dy * 12);
  1176	    if (!t) { state._pushT = 0; return; }
  1177	    if (state.mode === 'overworld') {
  1178	      if (t.ch !== 'G' && t.ch !== 'A') { state._pushT = 0; return; }
  1179	      const sc = World.get(state.col, state.row), secret = sc && sc.secret, pos = secret && secret.tile;
  1180	      if (!secret || secret.interaction !== 'push' || !pos || pos.c !== t.c || pos.r !== t.r) { state._pushT = 0; return; }
  1181	      if (secret.requires === 'powerbracelet' && !l.hasPowerBracelet) {
  1182	        state._pushT = 0;
  1183	        if (state.msgT <= 0) showMsg('THE BOULDER WILL NOT BUDGE.', 90);
  1184	        return;
  1185	      }
  1186	      if (++state._pushT < 18) return;
  1187	      state._pushT = 0;
  1188	      revealSecret(t, 'S');
  1189	      return;
  1190	    }
  1191	    if (t.ch !== 'p') { state._pushT = 0; return; }
  1192	    if (++state._pushT < 18) return;                    // shove for ~1/3 second
  1193	    state._pushT = 0;
  1194	    const nc = t.c + dx, nr = t.r + dy;
  1195	    const dest = (nr >= 0 && nr <= 10 && nc >= 0 && nc <= 15) ? state.grid[nr][nc] : null;
  1196	    if (dest !== 'F') return;                           // nowhere to slide

   164	    function fitViewport() {
   165	      const vw = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
   166	      const vh = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   167	      const aspect = 256 / 224;
   168	      let width = vw;
   169	      let height = width / aspect;
   170	      if (height > vh) {
   171	        height = vh;
   172	        width = height * aspect;
   173	      }
   174	      canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(width)}px`;
   175	      canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(height)}px`;
   176	      document.body.classList.toggle('portrait', vw < vh);
   177	    }
   178	
   179	    fitViewport();
   180	    window.addEventListener('resize', fitViewport, { passive: true });
   181	    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', fitViewport, { passive: true });
   182	    container.addEventListener('touchmove', (event) => event.preventDefault(), { passive: false });
   183	    container.addEventListener('gesturestart', (event) => event.preventDefault(), { passive: false });
   184	
   185	    const game = new Game(canvas);
