     1	// Keyboard and pointer input. Pointer events cover both touch and mouse,
     2	// while each control keeps its own pointer so multi-touch remains independent.
     3	
     4	export class Input {
     5	  constructor() {
     6	    this.keys = {};
     7	    this.prev = {};
     8	    this._pressedPulses = new Set();
     9	    this._cleanups = [];
    10	    this._stickPointer = null;
    11	    this._onDown = this._onDown.bind(this);
    12	    this._onUp = this._onUp.bind(this);
    13	    window.addEventListener('keydown', this._onDown);
    14	    window.addEventListener('keyup', this._onUp);
    15	  }
    16	
    17	  _onDown(e) {
    18	    this.keys[e.code] = true;
    19	    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Space'].includes(e.code)) {
    20	      e.preventDefault();
    21	    }
    22	  }
    23	
    24	  _onUp(e) {
    25	    this.keys[e.code] = false;
    26	  }
    27	
    28	  // Called after the first simulation step that can consume a press edge.
    29	  consumePressed() {
    30	    this._pressedPulses.clear();
    31	  }
    32	
    33	  // Is key currently held?
    34	  held(code) { return !!this.keys[code]; }
    35	
    36	  // Just pressed this frame, including a very quick pointer tap.
    37	  pressed(code) {
    38	    return (!!this.keys[code] && !this.prev[code]) || this._pressedPulses.has(code);
    39	  }
    40	
    41	  released(code) { return !this.keys[code] && !!this.prev[code]; }
    42	
    43	  // D-pad / virtual stick
    44	  get left()  { return this.held('ArrowLeft') || this.held('KeyA') || this.held('TouchLeft'); }
    45	  get right() { return this.held('ArrowRight') || this.held('KeyD') || this.held('TouchRight'); }
    46	  get up()    { return this.held('ArrowUp') || this.held('KeyW') || this.held('TouchUp'); }
    47	  get down()  { return this.held('ArrowDown') || this.held('KeyS') || this.held('TouchDown'); }
    48	
    49	  // A button = jump (Z / Space / left virtual button)
    50	  get A()      { return this.held('KeyZ') || this.held('Space') || this.held('TouchJump'); }
    51	  get pressA() { return this.pressed('KeyZ') || this.pressed('Space') || this.pressed('TouchJump'); }
    52	
    53	  // B button = attack (X / Enter / right virtual button)
    54	  get B()      { return this.held('KeyX') || this.held('Enter') || this.held('TouchAttack'); }
    55	  get pressB() { return this.pressed('KeyX') || this.pressed('Enter') || this.pressed('TouchAttack'); }
    56	
    57	  // Start = pause/rune select
    58	  get start() { return this.pressed('Escape') || this.pressed('KeyP') || this.pressed('TouchMenu'); }
    59	  get select() { return this.pressed('Tab') || this.pressed('KeyQ'); }
    60	
    61	  attachTouchControls({ stick, knob, jump, attack, menu }) {
    62	    if (!stick) return;
    63	
    64	    const button = (element, code) => {
    65	      if (!element) return;
    66	      const pointers = new Set();
    67	      const down = (e) => {
    68	        e.preventDefault();
    69	        pointers.add(e.pointerId);
    70	        this.keys[code] = true;
    71	        this._pressedPulses.add(code);
    72	        element.classList.add('active');
    73	        if (element.setPointerCapture) element.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    74	      };
    75	      const up = (e) => {
    76	        e.preventDefault();
    77	        pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
    78	        if (pointers.size === 0) {
    79	          this.keys[code] = false;
    80	          element.classList.remove('active');
    81	        }
    82	      };
    83	      element.addEventListener('pointerdown', down, { passive: false });
    84	      element.addEventListener('pointerup', up, { passive: false });
    85	      element.addEventListener('pointercancel', up, { passive: false });
    86	      element.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', up, { passive: false });
    87	      this._cleanups.push(() => {
    88	        element.removeEventListener('pointerdown', down);
    89	        element.removeEventListener('pointerup', up);
    90	        element.removeEventListener('pointercancel', up);
    91	        element.removeEventListener('lostpointercapture', up);
    92	      });
    93	    };
    94	
    95	    const stickMove = (e) => {
    96	      if (this._stickPointer !== e.pointerId) return;
    97	      e.preventDefault();
    98	      const rect = stick.getBoundingClientRect();
    99	      const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
   100	      const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
   101	      const max = rect.width * 0.34;
   102	      const dx = e.clientX - cx;
   103	      const dy = e.clientY - cy;
   104	      const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   105	      const scale = Math.min(1, max / distance);
   106	      const knobX = dx * scale;
   107	      const knobY = dy * scale;
   108	      if (knob) knob.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${knobX}px), calc(-50% + ${knobY}px))`;
   109	      const dead = Math.max(8, rect.width * 0.12);
   110	      this.keys.TouchLeft = dx < -dead;
   111	      this.keys.TouchRight = dx > dead;
   112	      this.keys.TouchUp = dy < -dead;
   113	      this.keys.TouchDown = dy > dead;
   114	    };
   115	    const stickDown = (e) => {
   116	      e.preventDefault();
   117	      if (this._stickPointer !== null) return;
   118	      this._stickPointer = e.pointerId;
   119	      if (stick.setPointerCapture) stick.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   120	      stickMove(e);
   121	    };
   122	    const stickUp = (e) => {
   123	      if (this._stickPointer !== e.pointerId) return;
   124	      e.preventDefault();
   125	      this._stickPointer = null;
   126	      this.keys.TouchLeft = false;
   127	      this.keys.TouchRight = false;
   128	      this.keys.TouchUp = false;
   129	      this.keys.TouchDown = false;
   130	      if (knob) knob.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%)';
   131	    };
   132	
   133	    stick.addEventListener('pointerdown', stickDown, { passive: false });
   134	    stick.addEventListener('pointermove', stickMove, { passive: false });
   135	    stick.addEventListener('pointerup', stickUp, { passive: false });
   136	    stick.addEventListener('pointercancel', stickUp, { passive: false });
   137	    stick.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', stickUp, { passive: false });
   138	    this._cleanups.push(() => {
   139	      stick.removeEventListener('pointerdown', stickDown);
   140	      stick.removeEventListener('pointermove', stickMove);
   141	      stick.removeEventListener('pointerup', stickUp);
   142	      stick.removeEventListener('pointercancel', stickUp);
   143	      stick.removeEventListener('lostpointercapture', stickUp);
   144	    });
   145	
   146	    button(jump, 'TouchJump');
   147	    button(attack, 'TouchAttack');
   148	    button(menu, 'TouchMenu');
   149	  }
   150	
   151	  destroy() {
   152	    window.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onDown);
   153	    window.removeEventListener('keyup', this._onUp);
   154	    for (const cleanup of this._cleanups) cleanup();
   155	    this._cleanups = [];
   156	  }
   157	}

   134	  }
   135	  var beepAcc = 0;
   136	  function vario(dt, w) {
   137	    if (!AC) return;
   138	    if (w > 0.4 && state === 'fly') {
   139	      var rate = 1.2 + Math.min(4.5, w) * 1.5;
   140	      varioOsc.frequency.value = 620 + Math.min(5, w) * 150;
   141	      beepAcc += dt * rate;
   142	      var ph = beepAcc % 1;
   143	      varioGain.gain.value = ph < 0.45 ? 0.25 : 0;
   144	    } else {
   145	      varioGain.gain.value = 0; beepAcc = 0;
   146	    }
   147	  }
   148	  function thud(freq, dur, type, vol) {
   149	    if (!AC) return;
   150	    try {
   151	      var o = AC.createOscillator(), gn = AC.createGain();
   152	      o.type = type || 'sawtooth'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, AC.currentTime);
   153	      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40, freq * 0.25), AC.currentTime + dur);
   154	      gn.gain.setValueAtTime(vol || 0.5, AC.currentTime);
   155	      gn.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, AC.currentTime + dur);
   156	      o.connect(gn); gn.connect(master); o.start(); o.stop(AC.currentTime + dur + 0.02);
   157	    } catch (e) { }
   158	  }
   159	
   160	  // ---------------- simulation ----------------
   161	  function step(dt) {
   162	    g.t += dt;
   163	    readInput(dt);
   164	
   165	    // weight-shift lag
   166	    var aCmd = A_TRIM + (g.input < 0 ? g.input * A_NEG : g.input * A_POS);
   167	    g.alpha += (aCmd - g.alpha) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.2);
   168	
   169	    var a = g.alpha;
   170	    var CL = CL0 + CLA * a;
   171	    var extraD = 0;
   172	    if (a > A_STALL) {
   173	      var ex = a - A_STALL;
   174	      CL = CL0 + CLA * A_STALL - 3.4 * ex;
   175	      extraD = 0.9 * ex;
   176	      g.stalled = Math.min(1, g.stalled + dt * 4);
   177	    } else {
   178	      g.stalled = Math.max(0, g.stalled - dt * 2.5);
   179	    }
   180	    if (CL < 0.10) CL = 0.10;
   181	
   182	    var V = g.V; if (V < 3) V = 3;
   183	    var q = 0.5 * RHO * V * V * S;
   184	    var CD = CD0 + KIND * CL * CL + extraD;
   185	    if (V > 32) { var o = (V - 32) / 10; CD += 0.022 * o * o; }
   186	
   187	    var L = q * CL, D = q * CD;
   188	    var sg = Math.sin(g.gam), cg = Math.cos(g.gam);
   189	
   190	    var dV = (-D - MASS * G * sg) / MASS;
   191	    var Vd = Math.max(6, g.V);
   192	    var dgam = (L - MASS * G * cg) / (MASS * Vd);
   193	    if (dgam > 2.8) dgam = 2.8; if (dgam < -2.8) dgam = -2.8;
   194	
   195	    g.V += dV * dt;
   196	    if (g.V < 4.5) g.V = 4.5;
   197	    if (g.V > 44) g.V = 44;
   198	    g.gam += dgam * dt;
   199	    if (g.gam > 1.35) g.gam = 1.35;
   200	    if (g.gam < -1.45) g.gam = -1.45;
   201	
   202	    var w = world.lift(g.x, g.y);
   203	    g.air = w;
   204	    g.vx = g.V * Math.cos(g.gam) + world.wind;
   205	    g.vy = g.V * Math.sin(g.gam) + w;
   206	
   207	    g.x += g.vx * dt;
   208	    g.y += g.vy * dt;
   209	
   210	    g.roll += ((g.input * 0.22) - g.roll) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
   211	
   212	    // trail
   213	    if (g.trail.length === 0 || g.x - g.trail[g.trail.length - 1].x > 6) {
   214	      g.trail.push({ x: g.x, y: g.y });
   215	      if (g.trail.length > 120) g.trail.shift();
   216	    }
   217	
   218	    // wingtip vortices when fast, sparkles when climbing
   219	    if (g.V > 23 && Math.random() < dt * 30) {
   220	      particles.push({ x: g.x, y: g.y, vx: -rnd(2, 6), vy: rnd(-2, 2), l: 0.7, m: 0.7, k: 0 });
   221	    }
   222	    if (w > 1.0 && Math.random() < dt * (8 + w * 6)) {
   223	      particles.push({ x: g.x + rnd(-40, 40), y: g.y + rnd(-25, 25), vx: rnd(-1, 1), vy: w * rnd(0.5, 1.1), l: 1.4, m: 1.4, k: 1 });
   224	    }
   225	    if (g.stalled > 0.4) shake = Math.max(shake, 2 + g.stalled * 3);
   226	
   227	    for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   228	      var p = particles[i];
   229	      p.l -= dt; if (p.l <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   230	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   231	    }
   232	
   233	    // ground contact
   234	    var gh = world.h(g.x);
   235	    if (g.y <= gh) {
   236	      g.y = gh;
   237	      land(gh);
   238	    }
   239	    vario(dt, w);
   240	  }
   241	
   242	  function land(gh) {
   243	    var lz = world.lzAt(g.x);
   244	    var slope = Math.abs(world.slope(g.x));
   245	    var gentle = (g.vy > -3.4) && (g.V < 15.5) && (slope < 0.28) && (g.stalled < 0.5);
   246	    var dist = Math.max(0, Math.round(g.x));
   247	    var bonus = 0, msg, sub;
   248	
   249	    if (gentle && lz) {
   250	      var acc = 1 - Math.abs(lz.dx) / lz.half;
   251	      var soft = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (3.4 + g.vy) / 3.4));
   252	      bonus = Math.round(400 + 400 * acc + 300 * soft);
   253	      msg = 'SPOT LANDING';
   254	      sub = 'zone bonus +' + bonus;
   255	      flashCol = '#7dffb0'; flash = 0.6;
   256	      thud(520, 0.35, 'triangle', 0.4);
   257	    } else if (gentle) {
   258	      msg = 'LANDED OUT';
   259	      sub = 'no zone bonus';
   260	      flashCol = '#ffe08a'; flash = 0.4;
   261	      thud(260, 0.3, 'triangle', 0.35);
   262	    } else {
   263	      msg = g.stalled > 0.5 ? 'STALLED IN' : 'CRASHED';
   264	      sub = 'flew it into the hill';
   265	      flashCol = '#ff6b6b'; flash = 0.8; shake = 22;
   266	      thud(150, 0.55, 'sawtooth', 0.7);
   267	      for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
   268	        particles.push({ x: g.x, y: gh + 4, vx: rnd(-30, 25), vy: rnd(2, 26), l: rnd(0.5, 1.3), m: 1.3, k: 2 });
   269	      }
   270	    }
   271	    var score = dist + bonus;
   272	    var isBest = score > best;
   273	    if (isBest) {
   274	      best = score;
   275	      try { localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(best)); } catch (e) { }
   276	    }
   277	    overInfo = { msg: msg, sub: sub, dist: dist, bonus: bonus, score: score, isBest: isBest };
   278	    state = 'over'; overT = 0;
   279	    if (varioGain) varioGain.gain.value = 0;
   280	  }
   281	
   282	  // ---------------- camera ----------------
   283	  function updateCam(dt) {
   284	    var gh = world.h(g.x);
   285	    var agl = g.y - gh;
   286	    var t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (agl - 70) / 430));
   287	    var want = 2.9 - 1.75 * t;             // px per metre (in backing-store px)
   288	    want *= (W / 960);
   289	    if (want < 0.6) want = 0.6;
   290	    cam.scale += (want - cam.scale) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.6);
   291	
   292	    var s = cam.scale;
   293	    var wantX = g.x - (W * 0.32) / s;
   294	    var wantY = g.y + (H * 0.40) / s;
   295	    // keep some ground visible
   296	    var lowest = gh;
   297	    for (var i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
   298	      var hh = world.h(g.x + i * (W / s) / 6);
   299	      if (hh > lowest) lowest = hh;
   300	    }
   301	    var maxTop = lowest + H / s * 0.98;
   302	    if (wantY > maxTop && agl < 200) wantY = Math.max(g.y + 30 / s, maxTop);
   303	
   304	    var k = Math.min(1, dt * 6);
   305	    cam.x += (wantX - cam.x) * k;
   306	    cam.y = 0;
   307	    cam.yTop += (wantY - cam.yTop) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
   308	  }
   309	
   310	  function sx(wx) { return (wx - cam.x) * cam.scale; }
   311	  function sy(wy) { return (cam.yTop - wy) * cam.scale; }

   313	  // ---------------- rendering ----------------
   314	  var skyGrad = null, skyKey = '', terrGrad = null, terrGradH = -1;
   315	  function drawSky() {
   316	    var key = W + 'x' + H;
   317	    if (skyKey !== key) {
   318	      skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   319	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a3f6b');
   320	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#2f76a8');
   321	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0.8, '#7fb6cf');
   322	      skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c9dbe0');
   323	      skyKey = key;
   324	    }
   325	    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
   326	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   327	  }

   329	  function drawClouds() {
   330	    // simple cumulus row near cloudbase, parallax
   331	    var base = 1150;
   332	    var pf = 0.35;
   333	    var step = 520;
   334	    var x0 = cam.x * pf;
   335	    var i0 = Math.floor(x0 / step) - 1;
   336	    ctx.save();
   337	    for (var i = i0; i < i0 + Math.ceil(W / cam.scale / step) + 3; i++) {
   338	      var r = ((Math.sin(i * 12.9898 + world.seed * 0.001) * 43758.5453) % 1 + 1) % 1;
   339	      if (r > 0.75) continue;
   340	      var cx = (i * step + r * 300 - x0) * cam.scale;
   340	      var cx = (i * step + r * 300 - x0) * cam.scale;
   341	      var cy = sy(base + r * 130) * pf + H * 0.10;
   342	      var rad = (34 + r * 26) * cam.scale;
   343	      if (cx < -rad * 3 || cx > W + rad * 3) continue;
   344	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
   345	      ctx.beginPath();
   346	      ctx.arc(cx, cy, rad, 0, 6.283);
   347	      ctx.arc(cx + rad * 0.9, cy + rad * 0.15, rad * 0.75, 0, 6.283);
   348	      ctx.arc(cx - rad * 0.85, cy + rad * 0.2, rad * 0.65, 0, 6.283);
   349	      ctx.fill();
   350	    }
   351	    ctx.restore();
   352	  }

   354	  function drawBgRidge(pf, amp, off, col) {
   355	    var s = cam.scale;
   356	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   357	    ctx.beginPath();
   358	    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
   359	    var stepPx = 10;
   360	    for (var px = 0; px <= W + stepPx; px += stepPx) {
   361	      var wx = cam.x * pf + px / s;
   362	      var hb = 120 + amp * world.n(wx / 900 + off, 5) + amp * 0.45 * world.n(wx / 320 + off * 2, 6);
   363	      var y = (cam.yTop - hb) * s * pf + H * (1 - pf) * 0.42;
   364	      ctx.lineTo(px, y);
   365	    }
   366	    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
   367	    ctx.closePath();
   368	    ctx.fill();
   369	  }

   371	  function drawTerrain() {
   372	    var s = cam.scale;
   373	    var stepPx = 4;
   374	    var pts = [];
   375	    for (var px = -stepPx; px <= W + stepPx; px += stepPx) {
   376	      var wx = cam.x + px / s;
   377	      pts.push([px, sy(world.h(wx)), wx]);
   378	    }
   379	    // body
   380	    if (!terrGrad || terrGradH !== H) {
   381	      terrGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   382	      terrGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3c6b4a');
   383	      terrGrad.addColorStop(1, '#16261f');
   384	      terrGradH = H;
   385	    }
   386	    ctx.fillStyle = terrGrad;
   387	    ctx.beginPath();
   388	    ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], H);
   389	    for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
   390	    ctx.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 1][0], H);
   391	    ctx.closePath();
   392	    ctx.fill();
   393	    // crest line
   394	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8fd6a0';
   395	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 2 * (W / 960));
   396	    ctx.beginPath();
   397	    for (i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) { if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); else ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); }
   398	    ctx.stroke();
   399	
   400	    // windward lift band shading (banded fills - cheap, no per-column gradients)
   401	    ctx.fillStyle = '#96e1ff';
   402	    for (i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i += 2) {
   403	      var wx2 = pts[i][2];
   404	      var sl = world.slope(wx2);
   405	      if (sl <= 0.09) continue;
   406	      var band = 70 + 190 * Math.min(1, sl);
   407	      var ghc = world.h(wx2);
   408	      var alpha = Math.min(0.26, (sl - 0.08) * 0.45);
   409	      var wpx = stepPx * 2 + 1;
   410	      for (var bq = 0; bq < 4; bq++) {
   411	        var f0 = bq / 4, f1 = (bq + 1) / 4;
   412	        var yA = sy(ghc + band * f1), yB = sy(ghc + band * f0);
   413	        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * (1 - (f0 + f1) / 2);
   414	        ctx.fillRect(pts[i][0], yA, wpx, yB - yA + 1);
   415	      }
   416	    }
   417	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   418	
   419	    // rising streaks over windward faces
   420	    ctx.save();
   421	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(190,240,255,0.45)';
   422	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.4 * (W / 960));
   423	    var t = tNow;
   424	    for (var px2 = 0; px2 < W; px2 += 46) {
   425	      var wx3 = cam.x + px2 / s;
   426	      var sl2 = world.slope(wx3);
   427	      if (sl2 <= 0.12) continue;
   428	      var bd = 70 + 190 * Math.min(1, sl2);
   429	      var gh = world.h(wx3);
   430	      var ph = ((t * (0.28 + sl2 * 0.3) + px2 * 0.013) % 1);
   431	      var yy = gh + ph * bd;
   432	      var y1 = sy(yy), y2 = sy(yy + bd * 0.16);
   433	      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55 * (1 - ph);
   434	      ctx.beginPath();
   435	      ctx.moveTo(px2, y1); ctx.lineTo(px2 + 2, y2);
   436	      ctx.stroke();
   437	    }
   438	    ctx.restore();
   439	  }

   441	  function drawLZ() {
   442	    var s = cam.scale;
   443	    var SP = window.RG.LZ_SPACING, HALF = window.RG.LZ_HALF;
   444	    var k0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cam.x / SP));
   445	    var k1 = Math.floor((cam.x + W / s) / SP) + 1;
   446	    for (var k = k0; k <= k1; k++) {
   447	      var cx = k * SP, gy = world.h(cx);
   448	      var x1 = sx(cx - HALF), x2 = sx(cx + HALF), y = sy(gy);
   449	      if (x2 < -20 || x1 > W + 20) continue;
   450	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,90,0.30)';
   451	      ctx.fillRect(x1, y - 3, x2 - x1, Math.max(3, 5 * s * 0.5 + 3));
   452	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffdc5a';
   453	      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 2 * (W / 960));
   454	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y); ctx.lineTo(x2, y); ctx.stroke();
   455	      // poles + flags
   456	      var ph = Math.max(14, 26 * s * 0.6);
   457	      [x1, x2].forEach(function (px) {
   458	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, y); ctx.lineTo(px, y - ph); ctx.stroke();
   459	        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdc5a';
   460	        ctx.beginPath();
   461	        ctx.moveTo(px, y - ph);
   462	        ctx.lineTo(px + ph * 0.55, y - ph + ph * 0.16);
   463	        ctx.lineTo(px, y - ph + ph * 0.32);
   464	        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   465	      });
   466	      // centre chevron
   467	      var mid = sx(cx);
   468	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,90,0.85)';
   469	      ctx.beginPath();
   470	      ctx.moveTo(mid, y - 4);
   471	      ctx.lineTo(mid - ph * 0.3, y - ph * 0.55);
   472	      ctx.lineTo(mid + ph * 0.3, y - ph * 0.55);
   473	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   474	      // label
   475	      if (x2 - x1 > 60) {
   476	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,190,0.9)';
   477	        ctx.font = Math.round(Math.max(10, 12 * (W / 960))) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   478	        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   479	        ctx.fillText('LZ ' + k, mid, y - ph - 6);
   480	        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   481	      }
   482	    }
   483	  }

   485	  function drawThermals() {
   486	    var s = cam.scale;
   487	    world.thermalsNear(cam.x - 200, cam.x + W / s + 200, tmpTherm);
   488	    for (var i = 0; i < tmpTherm.length; i++) {
   489	      var c = tmpTherm[i];
   490	      var cx = sx(c.x);
   491	      var rp = c.r * s;
   492	      if (cx + rp < -30 || cx - rp > W + 30) continue;
   493	      var yb = sy(c.base), yt = sy(c.top);
   494	      var alpha = 0.05 + Math.min(0.10, c.s * 0.022);
   495	      var grd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, yb, 0, yt);
   496	      grd.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,238,190,' + (alpha * 1.6).toFixed(3) + ')');
   497	      grd.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(255,238,190,' + alpha.toFixed(3) + ')');
   498	      grd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,238,190,0)');
   499	      ctx.fillStyle = grd;
   500	      // wavy column
   501	      ctx.beginPath();
   502	      var segs = 10;
   503	      for (var q = 0; q <= segs; q++) {
   504	        var f = q / segs;
   505	        var yy = yb + (yt - yb) * f;
   506	        var wob = Math.sin(tNow * 1.6 + c.ph + f * 5.0) * rp * 0.13;
   507	        ctx.lineTo(cx - rp * (1 - f * 0.12) + wob, yy);
   508	      }
   509	      for (q = segs; q >= 0; q--) {
   510	        var f2 = q / segs;
   511	        var yy2 = yb + (yt - yb) * f2;
   512	        var wob2 = Math.sin(tNow * 1.6 + c.ph + f2 * 5.0 + 1.7) * rp * 0.13;
   513	        ctx.lineTo(cx + rp * (1 - f2 * 0.12) + wob2, yy2);
   514	      }
   515	      ctx.closePath();
   516	      ctx.fill();
   517	
   518	      // circling birds
   519	      if (rp > 12) {
   520	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(25,30,40,0.75)';
   521	        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.6 * (W / 960));
   522	        for (var b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
   523	          var ang = tNow * 0.9 + c.ph + b * 2.09;
   524	          var bx = cx + Math.cos(ang) * rp * 0.62;
   525	          var alt = c.base + 90 + ((tNow * 22 + b * 130 + c.ph * 60) % Math.max(120, (c.top - c.base - 160)));
   526	          var by = sy(alt);
   527	          if (by < -20 || by > H + 20) continue;
   528	          var sz = Math.max(3, 5 * (W / 960)) * (0.75 + 0.35 * Math.sin(ang));
   529	          ctx.beginPath();
   530	          ctx.moveTo(bx - sz, by);
   531	          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx - sz * 0.5, by - sz * 0.7, bx, by);
   532	          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx + sz * 0.5, by - sz * 0.7, bx + sz, by);
   533	          ctx.stroke();
   534	        }
   535	      }
   536	    }
   537	  }

   539	  function drawParticles() {
   540	    for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
   541	      var p = particles[i];
   542	      var a = p.l / p.m;
   543	      var X = sx(p.x), Y = sy(p.y);
   544	      if (X < -20 || X > W + 20) continue;
   545	      if (p.k === 0) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (a * 0.5).toFixed(3) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(X, Y, 3, 2); }
   546	      else if (p.k === 1) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,170,' + (a * 0.8).toFixed(3) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(X, Y, 3, 3); }
   547	      else { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(210,120,70,' + (a * 0.9).toFixed(3) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(X - 2, Y - 2, 4, 4); }
   548	    }
   549	  }

   551	  function drawGlider() {
   552	    var s = cam.scale;
   553	    var X = sx(g.x), Y = sy(g.y);
   554	    // trail
   555	    if (g.trail.length > 1) {
   556	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
   557	      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.6 * (W / 960));

   771	  function frame(ts) {
   772	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   773	    if (!last) last = ts;
   774	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
   775	    last = ts;
   776	    if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
   777	    if (dt <= 0) dt = 0.0001;
   778	    tNow += dt;
   779	    if (hintT > 0) hintT -= dt;
   780	    shake *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   781	    flash *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);

   785	      while (rem > 0 && state === 'fly') {
   786	        var h = Math.min(0.016, rem);
   787	        step(h);
   788	        rem -= h;
   789	      }
   790	      updateCam(dt);
   791	    } else {
   792	      overT += dt;
   793	      for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   794	        var p = particles[i];
   795	        p.l -= dt; if (p.l <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }

     1	/* Ridge Glider - world: terrain, thermals, ridge lift, landing zones */
     2	(function (root) {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	
     5	  var LZ_SPACING = 2000;   // metres between landing zones
     6	  var LZ_HALF = 160;       // half-width of the scoring pad
     7	  var CELL = 300;          // thermal generator cell size (m)
     8	  var WIND = 5.5;          // tailwind, +x, m/s
     9	  var AMBIENT = -0.6;      // ambient sink, m/s
    10	  var CEILING = 1450;      // no lift above this altitude
    11	
    12	  function hash1(i, seed) {
    13	    var h = (i | 0) * 374761393 + (seed | 0) * 668265263;
    14	    h = (h ^ (h >>> 13)) * 1274126177;
    15	    return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    16	  }
    17	
    18	  function World(seed) {
    19	    this.seed = seed | 0;
    20	    this.wind = WIND;
    21	    this.cells = {};
    22	  }
    23	
    24	  World.prototype.n = function (x, o) {
    25	    var s = this.seed + (o | 0) * 7919;
    26	    var i = Math.floor(x), f = x - i;
    27	    var u = f * f * (3 - 2 * f);
    28	    var a = hash1(i, s), b = hash1(i + 1, s);
    29	    return a + (b - a) * u;
    30	  };
    31	
    32	  // raw ridgeline (metres above sea level)
    33	  World.prototype.raw = function (x) {
    34	    var n = this;
    35	    return 40
    36	      + 215 * n.n(x / 1100 + 1.3, 1)
    37	      + 128 * n.n(x / 430 + 9.7, 2)
    38	      + 46 * n.n(x / 165 + 21.1, 3)
    39	      + 15 * n.n(x / 62 + 37.5, 4);
    40	  };
    41	
    42	  // terrain height with landing zones flattened in
    43	  World.prototype.h = function (x) {
    44	    var hr = this.raw(x);
    45	    var k = Math.round(x / LZ_SPACING);
    46	    if (k < 1) return hr;
    47	    var cx = k * LZ_SPACING;
    48	    var d = x - cx;                       // signed: extra flat run-in on the approach side
    49	    if (d < -430 || d > 250) return hr;
    50	    var t;
    51	    if (d < -250) t = (d + 430) / 180;
    52	    else if (d > 160) t = (250 - d) / 90;
    53	    else t = 1;
    54	    t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
    55	    return hr + (this.raw(cx) - hr) * t;
    56	  };
    57	
    58	  World.prototype.slope = function (x) {
    59	    return (this.h(x + 3) - this.h(x - 3)) / 6;
    60	  };
    61	
    62	  World.prototype.nextLZ = function (x) {
    63	    var k = Math.floor(x / LZ_SPACING) + 1;
    64	    if (k < 1) k = 1;
    65	    return k * LZ_SPACING;
    66	  };
    67	
    68	  World.prototype.lzAt = function (x) {
    69	    var k = Math.round(x / LZ_SPACING);
    70	    if (k < 1) return null;
    71	    var cx = k * LZ_SPACING;
    72	    if (Math.abs(x - cx) > LZ_HALF) return null;
    73	    return { x: cx, dx: x - cx, half: LZ_HALF, y: this.raw(cx) };
    74	  };
    75	
    76	  // ---- thermals -------------------------------------------------------
    77	  World.prototype.cell = function (ci) {
    78	    var c = this.cells[ci];
    79	    if (c !== undefined) return c;
    80	    var r1 = hash1(ci * 3 + 11, this.seed + 555);
    81	    if (r1 > 0.58) { c = null; }
    82	    else {
    83	      var r2 = hash1(ci * 3 + 12, this.seed + 555);
    84	      var r3 = hash1(ci * 3 + 13, this.seed + 555);
    85	      var r4 = hash1(ci * 3 + 17, this.seed + 555);
    86	      var x = ci * CELL + 40 + r2 * (CELL - 80);
    87	      c = {
    88	        x: x,
    89	        r: 85 + r3 * 130,
    90	        s: 3.2 + r4 * 3.8,
    91	        base: this.h(x) + 15,
    92	        top: 620 + r2 * 560,
    93	        ph: r3 * 6.283
    94	      };
    95	      if (c.top < c.base + 220) c.top = c.base + 220;
    96	    }
    97	    this.cells[ci] = c;
    98	    return c;
    99	  };
   100	
   101	  World.prototype.thermalsNear = function (x0, x1, out) {
   102	    out.length = 0;
   103	    var a = Math.floor(x0 / CELL) - 1, b = Math.floor(x1 / CELL) + 1;
   104	    for (var i = a; i <= b; i++) {
   105	      var c = this.cell(i);
   106	      if (c) out.push(c);
   107	    }
   108	    return out;
   109	  };
   110	
   111	  World.prototype.thermalLift = function (x, y) {
   112	    var w = 0;
   113	    var a = Math.floor((x - 500) / CELL), b = Math.floor((x + 500) / CELL);
   114	    for (var i = a; i <= b; i++) {
   115	      var c = this.cell(i);
   116	      if (!c) continue;
   117	      if (y < c.base || y > c.top) continue;
   118	      var d = Math.abs(x - c.x);
   119	      if (d > c.r * 1.9) continue;
   120	      // vertical taper: ramp in at base, fade out under the top
   121	      var vt = Math.min(1, (y - c.base) / 60);
   122	      var tt = Math.min(1, (c.top - y) / 170);
   123	      var env = vt * tt * tt;
   124	      if (d <= c.r) {
   125	        var f = 1 - (d / c.r) * (d / c.r);
   126	        w += c.s * f * env;
   127	      } else {
   128	        var g = (d - c.r) / (c.r * 0.9);
   129	        w -= c.s * 0.34 * (1 - g) * (1 - g) * env;
   130	      }
   131	    }
   132	    return w;
   133	  };
   134	
   135	  // ---- ridge lift -----------------------------------------------------
   136	  // Wind blows downrange (+x). Windward faces are the rising slopes the
   137	  // glider approaches; lift sits in a band above them.
   138	  World.prototype.ridgeLift = function (x, y) {
   139	    var s = this.slope(x);
   140	    if (s <= 0.08) return 0;
   141	    var g = this.h(x);
   142	    var agl = y - g;
   143	    if (agl < 0) return 0;
   144	    var band = 70 + 190 * Math.min(1, s);
   145	    if (agl > band) return 0;
   146	    var f = 1 - agl / band;
   147	    f = f * f;
   148	    var str = this.wind * Math.min(0.70, (s - 0.08) * 1.35);
   149	    return str * f * 1.35;
   150	  };
   151	
   152	  World.prototype.lift = function (x, y) {
   153	    if (y > CEILING) return -1.2;
   154	    return AMBIENT + this.thermalLift(x, y) + this.ridgeLift(x, y);
   155	  };
   156	
   157	  root.RG = root.RG || {};
   158	  root.RG.World = World;
   159	  root.RG.LZ_SPACING = LZ_SPACING;
   160	  root.RG.LZ_HALF = LZ_HALF;
   161	  root.RG.CEILING = CEILING;
   162	})(window);

    27	  function angleDiff(a, b) { return Math.atan2(Math.sin(a - b), Math.cos(a - b)); }
    28	  function announce(text, time = 1.6) { game.message = text; game.messageTime = time; }
    29	
    30	  function resize() {
    31	    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    32	    view.w = Math.max(320, r.width);
    33	    view.h = Math.max(240, r.height);
    34	    view.dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 960 / Math.max(view.w, view.h));
    35	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(view.w * view.dpr));
    36	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(view.h * view.dpr));
    37	    ctx.setTransform(view.dpr, 0, 0, view.dpr, 0, 0);
    38	    if (!game.player.y) game.player.y = view.h * .52;
    39	    game.player.x = view.w * .32;
    40	  }
    41	  window.addEventListener('resize', resize, { passive: true });
    42	  resize();
    43	
    44	  function pointerPosition(e) {
    45	    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    46	    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
    47	  }
    48	  function controlZones() {
    49	    const s = Math.min(88, view.w * .13);
    50	    return { stick: { x: s + 20, y: view.h - s - 20, r: s }, fire: { x: view.w - s - 18, y: view.h - s - 20, r: s * .74 }, flare: { x: view.w - s * 2.15 - 24, y: view.h - s - 20, r: s * .54 }, wing: { x: view.w - 54, y: 74, r: 33 } };
    51	  }
    52	  function setStick(p, z) {
    53	    const dx = p.x - z.x, dy = p.y - z.y, m = Math.min(z.r, Math.hypot(dx, dy));
    54	    const a = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    55	    input.stick = { x: Math.cos(a) * m / z.r, y: Math.sin(a) * m / z.r };
    56	  }
    57	  function requestFlare() { input.flareRequest = true; }
    58	  function pointerDown(e) {
    59	    e.preventDefault();
    60	    if (game.screen !== 'play') { reset(); return; }
    61	    const p = pointerPosition(e), z = controlZones();
    62	    let kind = 'other';
    63	    if (dist(p.x, p.y, z.stick.x, z.stick.y) < z.stick.r * 1.45) { kind = 'stick'; setStick(p, z.stick); }
    64	    else if (dist(p.x, p.y, z.fire.x, z.fire.y) < z.fire.r * 1.35) { kind = 'fire'; input.fire = true; }
    65	    else if (dist(p.x, p.y, z.flare.x, z.flare.y) < z.flare.r * 1.5) { kind = 'flare'; requestFlare(); }
    66	    else if (dist(p.x, p.y, z.wing.x, z.wing.y) < z.wing.r * 1.35) { kind = 'wing'; orderWingman(); }
    67	    pointers.set(e.pointerId, kind);
    68	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    69	  }
    70	  function pointerMove(e) {
    71	    e.preventDefault();
    72	    if (pointers.get(e.pointerId) === 'stick') setStick(pointerPosition(e), controlZones().stick);
    73	  }
    74	  function pointerUp(e) {
    75	    e.preventDefault();
    76	    const kind = pointers.get(e.pointerId);
    77	    if (kind === 'stick') input.stick = null;
    78	    if (kind === 'fire') input.fire = false;
    79	    pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
    80	  }
    81	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', pointerDown, { passive: false });
    82	  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', pointerMove, { passive: false });
    83	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', pointerUp, { passive: false });
    84	  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', pointerUp, { passive: false });
    85	  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
    86	  window.addEventListener('touchmove', e => e.preventDefault(), { passive: false });
    87	  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    88	    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    89	    if (['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright','w','a','s','d',' ','f','shift','enter'].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    90	    if (game.screen !== 'play' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { reset(); return; }
    91	    input.keys.add(k);
    92	    if (k === 'f' || k === 'shift') requestFlare();
    93	  }, { passive: false });
    94	  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => input.keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()));
    95	
    96	  function steer() {
    97	    let x = 0, y = 0;
    98	    if (input.keys.has('arrowleft') || input.keys.has('a')) x -= 1;
    99	    if (input.keys.has('arrowright') || input.keys.has('d')) x += 1;
   100	    if (input.keys.has('arrowup') || input.keys.has('w')) y -= 1;
   101	    if (input.keys.has('arrowdown') || input.keys.has('s')) y += 1;
   102	    if (input.stick) { x = input.stick.x; y = input.stick.y; }
   103	    return { x, y };
   104	  }
   105	  function isFiring() { return input.fire || input.keys.has(' ') || input.keys.has('enter'); }
   106	
   107	  function reset() {
   108	    saveBest();
   109	    game.screen = 'play'; game.wave = 1; game.score = 0; game.kills = 0; game.style = 0; game.health = 3;
   110	    game.t = 0; game.distance = 0; game.waveBanner = 2.8; game.waveClear = 0; game.message = ''; game.messageTime = 0;
   111	    game.fireTimer = 0; game.flareCooldown = 0; game.flareGlow = 0; game.target = null; game.seed = 0xace2026; game.rng = null;
   112	    game.player.x = view.w * .32; game.player.y = view.h * .52; game.player.bank = 0; game.player.loop = 0; game.player.hit = 0; game.player.invuln = 0;
   113	    game.wingman.x = game.player.x - 68; game.wingman.y = game.player.y + 72; game.wingman.order = 0; game.wingman.shot = .5; game.wingman.call = 0;
   114	    game.enemies.length = 0; game.bullets.length = 0; game.foeBullets.length = 0; game.missiles.length = 0; game.particles.length = 0; game.rings.length = 0;
   115	    spawnWave();
   116	  }
   117	
   118	  function spawnWave() {
   119	    const count = Math.min(6, 2 + Math.floor((game.wave - 1) * .58));
   120	    game.waveBanner = 2.5; game.waveClear = 0;
   121	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   122	      const roll = rand(), type = game.wave >= 6 && roll > .55 ? 'ace' : (roll > .47 ? 'boomer' : 'turner');
   123	      const color = colors[(game.wave + i + Math.floor(rand() * colors.length)) % colors.length];
   124	      game.enemies.push({ id: game.nextId++, type, x: view.w + 60 + i * 92 + rand() * 90, y: 78 + rand() * Math.max(100, view.h - 190), vx: -72 - rand() * 38, vy: 0, hp: type === 'ace' ? 2 : 1, maxHp: type === 'ace' ? 2 : 1, phase: rand() * TAU, age: 0, shot: 1.5 + rand() * 2, missile: 4 + rand() * 3, angle: Math.PI, color, color2: colors[(i + 2) % colors.length], hit: 0, dead: false, boomered: false });
   125	    }
   126	    announce(`SORTIE ${game.wave}  •  ${count} BANDITS`, 1.8);
   127	  }
   128	  function nearestEnemy() {
   129	    let chosen = null, best = Infinity;
   130	    for (const e of game.enemies) if (!e.dead) {
   131	      const d = dist(e.x, e.y, game.player.x, game.player.y);
   132	      if (d < best) { best = d; chosen = e; }
   133	    }
   134	    return chosen;
   135	  }
   136	  function orderWingman() {
   137	    const target = nearestEnemy();
   138	    if (!target) return;
   139	    game.target = target; game.wingman.order = 2.5; announce('WINGMAN: ATTACK RUN', 1.4);
   140	  }
   141	  function addParticle(x, y, color, amount = 1, speed = 90) {
   142	    for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
   143	      const a = rand() * TAU, s = speed * (.35 + rand());
   144	      game.particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: .35 + rand() * .55, max: .9, size: 1.5 + rand() * 3.5, color });
   145	    }
   146	  }
   147	  function addRing(x, y, color) { game.rings.push({ x, y, r: 8, life: .5, color }); }
   148	  function shootPlayer() {
   149	    if (game.fireTimer > 0) return;
   150	    const s = steer(), t = game.target && !game.target.dead ? game.target : nearestEnemy();
   151	    const aimY = t ? leadPoint(t).y : game.player.y + s.y * 80;
   152	    const angle = Math.atan2(aimY - game.player.y, view.w * .48 + s.x * 70);
   153	    const speed = 560;
   154	    game.bullets.push({ x: game.player.x + 25, y: game.player.y - 2, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, life: 1.8, color: '#e7fbff' });
   155	    game.fireTimer = .12;
   156	    addParticle(game.player.x + 22, game.player.y, '#fff3b0', 1, 40);
   157	  }
   158	  function shootWingman(target) {
   159	    if (!target) return;
   160	    const angle = Math.atan2(target.y - game.wingman.y, target.x - game.wingman.x);
   161	    game.bullets.push({ x: game.wingman.x + 20, y: game.wingman.y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * 430, vy: Math.sin(angle) * 430, life: 1.6, color: '#7fe9ff', wing: true });
   162	  }
   163	  function enemyShoot(e) {
   164	    const dx = game.player.x - e.x;
   165	    const speed = e.type === 'ace' ? 260 : 215;
   166	    const lead = clamp(Math.abs(dx) / speed, .15, 1.2);
   167	    const angle = Math.atan2(game.player.y + steer().y * 20 + e.vy * lead - e.y, dx);
   168	    game.foeBullets.push({ x: e.x - 18, y: e.y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, life: 3, color: e.color });
   169	  }
   170	  function launchMissile(e) {
   171	    game.missiles.push({ x: e.x - 22, y: e.y, vx: -150, vy: 0, age: 0, life: 8, turn: 0, color: '#ff5c81' });
   172	    announce('MISSILE LOCK  •  FLARE', 1.25); game.wingman.call = 1.7; announce('BANDIT ON YOU', 1.7);
   173	  }
   174	  function triggerFlare() {
   175	    if (game.flareCooldown > 0) return;
   176	    game.flareCooldown = 5; game.flareGlow = 1.15; game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, 4);
   177	    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) addParticle(game.player.x - 14, game.player.y + 10, i % 2 ? '#ffbd5b' : '#fff2b0', 1, 150);
   178	    for (const m of game.missiles) if (dist(m.x, m.y, game.player.x, game.player.y) < 190) { m.life = 0; game.score += 18; game.style += 1; addRing(m.x, m.y, '#ffc857'); }
   179	    announce('FLARE OUT', 1.1);
   180	  }
   181	  function damagePlayer(amount = 1) {
   182	    if (game.player.invuln > 0 || game.screen !== 'play') return;
   183	    game.health -= amount; game.player.invuln = 1.1; game.player.hit = .28; game.shake = 12;
   184	    addParticle(game.player.x, game.player.y, '#ff6b5f', 14, 180); addRing(game.player.x, game.player.y, '#ff6b5f');
   185	    game.wingman.call = 1.5; announce('BANDIT ON YOU', 1.5);
   186	    if (game.health <= 0) endGame(false);
   187	  }
   188	  function hitEnemy(e, bullet) {
   189	    if (e.dead) return;
   190	    e.hp--; e.hit = .18; addParticle(e.x, e.y, bullet.color, 5, 120); addRing(e.x, e.y, bullet.color);
   191	    const shotAngle = Math.atan2(bullet.vy, bullet.vx);
   192	    const deflection = Math.abs(angleDiff(shotAngle, e.angle)) > 1.25;
   193	    if (deflection) { game.style += 1; game.score += 12; announce('DEFLECTION +12', .8); }
   194	    if (e.hp <= 0) {
   195	      e.dead = true; game.kills++; game.score += e.type === 'ace' ? 90 : e.type === 'boomer' ? 55 : 40;
   196	      if (e.type === 'ace') { game.score += 20; announce('ACE BROKEN +110', 1.2); } else announce('BANDIT DOWN', .8);
   197	      addParticle(e.x, e.y, e.color, 24, 220); addRing(e.x, e.y, '#fff3b0'); game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, 7);
   198	    }
   199	  }
   200	  function leadPoint(e) {
   201	    const speed = 560, d = Math.max(40, e.x - game.player.x), lead = clamp(d / speed, .1, 1.4);
   202	    return { x: e.x + e.vx * lead, y: e.y + e.vy * lead };
   203	  }
   204	  function updatePlayer(dt) {
   205	    const s = steer();
   206	    game.player.x = lerp(game.player.x, view.w * .32 + s.x * 36, 1 - Math.pow(.001, dt));
   207	    game.player.y = clamp(game.player.y + s.y * 220 * dt, 70, view.h - 116);
   208	    game.player.bank = lerp(game.player.bank, s.x * .55, 1 - Math.pow(.002, dt));
   209	    game.player.loop += Math.abs(s.y) * dt * 3.4;
   210	    game.player.hit = Math.max(0, game.player.hit - dt); game.player.invuln = Math.max(0, game.player.invuln - dt);
   211	    game.fireTimer = Math.max(0, game.fireTimer - dt); game.flareCooldown = Math.max(0, game.flareCooldown - dt); game.flareGlow = Math.max(0, game.flareGlow - dt);
   212	    if (input.flareRequest) { input.flareRequest = false; triggerFlare(); }
   213	    if (isFiring()) shootPlayer();
   214	  }
   215	  function updateWingman(dt) {
   216	    const target = game.wingman.order > 0 && game.target && !game.target.dead ? game.target : null;
   217	    game.wingman.order = Math.max(0, game.wingman.order - dt); game.wingman.call = Math.max(0, game.wingman.call - dt);
   218	    const desiredX = target ? target.x - 100 : game.player.x - 74;
   219	    const desiredY = target ? target.y + Math.sin(game.t * 5) * 20 : game.player.y + 72;
   220	    game.wingman.x = lerp(game.wingman.x, desiredX, 1 - Math.pow(.0008, dt)); game.wingman.y = lerp(game.wingman.y, clamp(desiredY, 70, view.h - 120), 1 - Math.pow(.001, dt));
   221	    game.wingman.shot -= dt;
   222	    if (target && game.wingman.shot <= 0) { shootWingman(target); game.wingman.shot = .72; }
   223	  }
   224	  function updateEnemies(dt) {
   225	    game.target = nearestEnemy();
   226	    for (const e of game.enemies) {
   227	      if (e.dead) continue;
   228	      e.age += dt; e.hit = Math.max(0, e.hit - dt);
   229	      if (e.type === 'turner') {
   230	        const desired = game.player.y + Math.sin(e.age * 1.9 + e.phase) * 85;
   231	        e.vy = lerp(e.vy, clamp((desired - e.y) * 1.3, -135, 135), 1 - Math.pow(.03, dt));
   232	      } else if (e.type === 'boomer') {
   233	        if (!e.boomered && e.x < view.w * .62) { e.boomered = true; e.vx = Math.abs(e.vx) + 120; announce('BOOMER BREAK', .8); }
   234	        e.vy = Math.sin(e.age * 2 + e.phase) * 60;
   235	      } else {
   236	        e.vy = lerp(e.vy, (game.player.y - e.y) * .55, 1 - Math.pow(.08, dt));
   237	      }
   238	      e.x += e.vx * dt; e.y = clamp(e.y + e.vy * dt, 60, view.h - 118); e.angle = Math.atan2(e.vy, e.vx);
   239	      e.shot -= dt;
   240	      if (e.shot <= 0 && e.x < view.w + 80 && e.x > 40) { enemyShoot(e); e.shot = e.type === 'ace' ? 1.8 : 2.5 + rand() * 1.5; }
   241	      if (e.type === 'ace') { e.missile -= dt; if (e.missile <= 0 && e.x < view.w + 40 && e.x > view.w * .3) { launchMissile(e); e.missile = 5.5 + rand() * 3; } }
   242	      if (e.x < -110 || e.x > view.w + 180) { e.x = view.w + 110; e.y = 70 + rand() * Math.max(80, view.h - 180); if (e.type === 'boomer') e.boomered = false; }
   243	    }
   244	    const alive = game.enemies.some(e => !e.dead);
   245	    if (!alive) {
   246	      game.waveClear += dt;
   247	      if (game.waveClear > 1.25) { if (game.wave >= 8) endGame(true); else { game.wave++; game.enemies.length = 0; spawnWave(); } }
   248	    }
   249	  }
   250	  function updateCombat(dt) {
   251	    for (const b of game.bullets) { b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.life -= dt; for (const e of game.enemies) if (!e.dead && dist(b.x, b.y, e.x, e.y) < 23) { hitEnemy(e, b); b.life = 0; break; } }
   252	    for (const b of game.foeBullets) { b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.life -= dt; if (dist(b.x, b.y, game.player.x, game.player.y) < 18) { b.life = 0; damagePlayer(); } }
   253	    for (const m of game.missiles) {
   254	      m.age += dt; m.life -= dt;
   255	      const desired = Math.atan2(game.player.y - m.y, game.player.x - m.x), current = Math.atan2(m.vy, m.vx), a = current + clamp(angleDiff(desired, current), -.95 * dt, .95 * dt);
   256	      const speed = 170 + Math.min(100, m.age * 14); m.vx = Math.cos(a) * speed; m.vy = Math.sin(a) * speed; m.x += m.vx * dt; m.y += m.vy * dt;
   257	      if (dist(m.x, m.y, game.player.x, game.player.y) < 25) { m.life = 0; damagePlayer(2); }
   258	      if (rand() < dt * 12) addParticle(m.x, m.y, m.color, 1, 22);
   259	    }
   260	    game.bullets = game.bullets.filter(b => b.life > 0 && b.x > -80 && b.x < view.w + 80 && b.y > -80 && b.y < view.h + 80);
   261	    game.foeBullets = game.foeBullets.filter(b => b.life > 0 && b.x > -100 && b.x < view.w + 100 && b.y > -100 && b.y < view.h + 100);
   262	    game.missiles = game.missiles.filter(m => m.life > 0 && m.x > -120 && m.x < view.w + 120 && m.y > -120 && m.y < view.h + 120);
   263	  }
   264	  function updateFx(dt) {
   265	    game.distance += dt * 180; game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt * 22); game.waveBanner = Math.max(0, game.waveBanner - dt); game.messageTime = Math.max(0, game.messageTime - dt);
   266	    for (const p of game.particles) { p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vx *= Math.pow(.02, dt); p.vy *= Math.pow(.02, dt); p.life -= dt; }
   267	    for (const r of game.rings) { r.r += dt * 90; r.life -= dt; }
   268	    game.particles = game.particles.filter(p => p.life > 0); game.rings = game.rings.filter(r => r.life > 0);
   269	  }
   270	  function endGame(win) { game.screen = win ? 'win' : 'fail'; saveBest(); game.shake = win ? 5 : 14; addParticle(game.player.x, game.player.y, win ? '#85f29a' : '#ff6b5f', 30, 240); }
   271	  function update(dt) {
   272	    if (game.screen !== 'play') { updateFx(dt); return; }
   273	    game.t += dt; updatePlayer(dt); updateWingman(dt); updateEnemies(dt); updateCombat(dt); updateFx(dt);
   274	  }
   275	
   276	  function drawSky() {
   277	    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, view.h); g.addColorStop(0, '#08142f'); g.addColorStop(.52, '#174c78'); g.addColorStop(1, '#f09373'); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.w, view.h);
   278	    ctx.globalAlpha = .12; ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe7ad'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(view.w * .77, view.h * .22, Math.min(view.w, view.h) * .16, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   279	    drawParallax(0.22, '#b9eaff', 24, 1); drawParallax(0.48, '#73b8d0', 34, 1); drawParallax(0.9, '#164166', 45, 2); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   280	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(175,230,255,.13)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   281	    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const y = view.h * .35 + i * 34; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(view.w, y - 65); ctx.stroke(); }
   282	  }
   283	  function drawParallax(speed, color, y, size) {
   284	    const off = -(game.distance * speed) % (view.w + 140); ctx.fillStyle = color;
   285	    for (let x = off - 140; x < view.w + 160; x += 160 + size * 28) {
   286	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y + size * 20); ctx.lineTo(x + 34, y - size * 12); ctx.lineTo(x + 72, y + size * 14); ctx.lineTo(x + 126, y - size * 20); ctx.lineTo(x + 160, y + size * 22); ctx.lineTo(x + 160, y + size * 34); ctx.lineTo(x, y + size * 34); ctx.fill();
   287	    }
   288	  }
   289	  function drawPlane(x, y, scale, rot, main, accent, player = false) {
   290	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(rot); ctx.scale(scale, scale);
   291	    ctx.globalAlpha = .25; ctx.fillStyle = '#061020'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-3, 16, 28, 7, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   292	    ctx.fillStyle = main; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(30, 0); ctx.lineTo(7, -7); ctx.lineTo(-20, -5); ctx.lineTo(-30, -17); ctx.lineTo(-26, -3); ctx.lineTo(-43, -9); ctx.lineTo(-26, 3); ctx.lineTo(-30, 17); ctx.lineTo(-18, 6); ctx.lineTo(8, 7); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   293	    ctx.fillStyle = accent; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(4, -3); ctx.lineTo(-18, -28); ctx.lineTo(-7, -4); ctx.lineTo(-18, 28); ctx.lineTo(5, 3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   294	    ctx.fillStyle = player ? '#e8fcff' : '#fff1c1'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(7, -2, 8, 4, -.2, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   295	    ctx.fillStyle = '#071126'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(9, -3, 5, 2.4, -.2, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   296	    if (player) { ctx.fillStyle = '#fff3a5'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(30, 0); ctx.lineTo(39, -3); ctx.lineTo(39, 3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
   297	    ctx.restore();

   299	  function drawEnemy(e) {

   164	    function fitViewport() {
   165	      const vw = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
   166	      const vh = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   167	      const aspect = 256 / 224;
   168	      let width = vw;
   169	      let height = width / aspect;
   170	      if (height > vh) {
   171	        height = vh;
   172	        width = height * aspect;
   173	      }
   174	      canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(width)}px`;
   175	      canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(height)}px`;
   176	      document.body.classList.toggle('portrait', vw < vh);
   177	    }

    82	  // Runs zero or more fixed 1/60s sim steps for the elapsed real time,
    83	  // then draws once. See module header for the accumulator contract.
    84	  _loop(ts) {
    85	    if (this._lastTs === null) this._lastTs = ts;
    86	    let dtMs = ts - this._lastTs;
    87	    this._lastTs = ts;
    88	    if (dtMs > FRAME_CLAMP_MS) dtMs = FRAME_CLAMP_MS; // clamp a big stall
    89	    if (dtMs < 0) dtMs = 0; // guard against a non-monotonic ts source
    90	
    91	    this._accumulatorMs += dtMs;
    92	
    93	    let steps = 0;
    94	    while (this._accumulatorMs >= STEP_MS && steps < MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME) {
    95	      this._update();
    96	      this._traceStep();
    97	      // Input edges (pressed()) are consumed by the FIRST sim step that
    98	      // runs after the frame's input was latched. Snapshotting `prev`
    99	      // here, after that first step, means any further sim steps this
   100	      // same frame see those edges as already consumed (pressed() is
   101	      // false), while held state (left/right/up/down/A/B — read straight
   102	      // off `keys`) is unaffected and persists across all of them.
   103	      if (steps === 0) {
   104	        this.input.prev = { ...this.input.keys };
   105	        this.input.consumePressed();
   106	      }
   107	      this._accumulatorMs -= STEP_MS;
   108	      steps++;
   109	    }
   110	    // Remainder time (including any left over after hitting the 5-step
   111	    // cap during a catch-up spiral) intentionally carries into next frame
   112	    // rather than being discarded — no time is invented or dropped.
   113	
   114	    this._draw();
   115	    this.frame++;
   116	    requestAnimationFrame(this._loop);
   117	  }

   253	  // ---- loop (fixed 60Hz logic) ----
   254	  // nowMs(): high-res clock when available, else Date.now(). Some headless/test
   255	  // environments don't expose `performance`, and depending on it hard-crashed boot.
   256	  const nowMs = (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now)
   257	    ? () => performance.now() : () => Date.now();
   258	  let updateFn = () => {}, renderFn = () => {};
   259	  let acc = 0, last = 0;
   260	  const STEP = 1000 / 60;
   261	  let _useRAF = true;
   262	  function tick() { frame(nowMs()); }
   263	  function frame(now) {
   264	    try {
   265	      if (!last) last = now;
   266	      acc += now - last;
   267	      last = now;
   268	      if (acc > 250) acc = 250;     // avoid spiral after tab-out
   269	      let steps = 0;
   270	      while (acc >= STEP && steps < 5) {
   271	        updateFn();
   272	        clearPressed();
   273	        acc -= STEP; steps++;
   274	      }
   275	      renderFn(ctx);
   276	    } catch(e) {
   277	      var _d = (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.getElementById) ? document.getElementById('dbg') : null;
   278	      if (_d) { _d.style.display='block'; _d.textContent='frame-err:' + (e&&e.message?e.message:String(e)); }
   279	      ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
   280	      ctx.fillStyle = '#f44'; ctx.font = '8px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
   281	      ctx.fillText('ERR:', 4, 4);
   282	      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   283	      var msg = (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) + ' L' + (e && e.stack ? e.stack.split('\n')[1] : '');
   284	      var words = msg.split(' '), line = '', y = 16;
   285	      for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
   286	        if ((line + ' ' + words[i]).length > 28) { ctx.fillText(line.trim(), 4, y); y += 10; line = words[i]; }
   287	        else line += ' ' + words[i];
   288	      }
   289	      if (line.trim()) ctx.fillText(line.trim(), 4, y);
   290	      return; // stop the loop
   291	    }
   292	    if (_useRAF) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else setTimeout(tick, 16);
   293	  }

   134	function gapAhead(tr){
   135	  var net = G.net, e = net.edges[tr.edge];
   136	  var kids = childrenIdx(net, tr.edge), best = Infinity;
   137	  for (var i = 0; i < G.trains.length; i++){

   145	function deliver(tr, seg){
   146	  var st = G.net.stations[seg];
   147	  if (st.color === tr.color){
   148	    var onTime = tr.patience > 0;

   231	  /* trains */

   234	    if (!e){ G.trains.splice(ti, 1); continue; }

   241	        deliver(tr, e.seg);
   242	      }
   243	    } else {
   244	      var base = tr.done ? BASE_SPEED * 1.35 : BASE_SPEED;
   245	      var cap = base;
   246	      var lim = function(d){ var a = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 2 * DECEL * d)); if (a < cap) cap = a; };
   247	
   248	      if (e.stationS !== null && !tr.stationDone && tr.s <= e.stationS) lim(e.stationS - tr.s);
   249	      if (tr.hold){

   251	        else {
   252	          var ni = nextEdgeIdx(net, tr.edge);
   253	          if (ni >= 0 && net.edges[ni] && net.edges[ni].signalS !== null)
   254	            lim((e.len - tr.s) + net.edges[ni].signalS);
   255	        }
   256	      }
   257	      var g = gapAhead(tr);
   258	      if (g < Infinity) lim(Math.max(0, g - FOLLOW_GAP));
   259	
   260	      if (cap > tr.v) tr.v = Math.min(cap, tr.v + ACCEL * dt);
   261	      else tr.v = Math.max(cap, tr.v - DECEL * 1.6 * dt);
   262	      if (tr.v < 0) tr.v = 0;
   263	
   264	      tr.s += tr.v * dt;
   265	
   266	      /* station arrival */
   267	      if (e.stationS !== null && !tr.stationDone && tr.s >= e.stationS - 0.8){

   269	      }
   270	      /* signal hold */
   271	      if (tr.hold && e.signalS !== null && tr.s >= e.signalS - 0.8 && tr.s <= e.signalS + 2){
   272	        tr.s = e.signalS; tr.v = 0;
   273	      }
   274	      /* edge transition */
   275	      if (tr.s >= e.len){
   276	        var over = tr.s - e.len;
   277	        var nx = nextEdgeIdx(net, tr.edge);
   278	        if (nx < 0){
   279	          if (!tr.done){ G.missed++; G.combo = 0; flash('rgba(239,68,68,.12)');
   280	            popup(tr.x, tr.y, 'MISSED', '#f87171'); beep(120, 0.2, 'sawtooth', 0.06, 70); }
   281	          G.trains.splice(ti, 1); continue;
   282	        }
   283	        tr.edge = nx; tr.s = over; tr.stationDone = false;
   284	      }
   285	    }
   286	    var pt = polyAt(G.net.edges[tr.edge].poly, tr.s);

   295	      if (Math.hypot(A.x - B.x, A.y - B.y) < COLLIDE_DIST){ gameOver(A, B); return; }
   296	    }
   297	  }
   298	}

   563	function tap(pos){
   564	  var now = performance.now();

   566	  if (lastTapPos && now - lastTap < 320 && Math.hypot(pos.x - lastTapPos.x, pos.y - lastTapPos.y) < 40){

   572	    return;

   574	  lastTap = now; lastTapPos = pos;
   575	
   576	  /* trains first (generous hit area) */
   577	  var hitR = Math.max(26, 17 * G.cam.s), bestD = 1e9, bestI = -1, i, p, d;
   578	  for (i = 0; i < G.trains.length; i++){
   579	    p = w2s(G.trains[i].x, G.trains[i].y);

   597	}

     4	function mulberry32(a){
     5	  return function(){
     6	    a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
     7	    var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
     8	    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
     9	    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    10	  };
    11	}
    12	
    13	function smoothstep(a, b, x){
    14	  x = (x - a) / (b - a);
    15	  if (x < 0) x = 0; else if (x > 1) x = 1;
    16	  return x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
    17	}
    18	
    19	function polyBuild(pts){
    20	  var cum = [0], L = 0;
    21	  for (var i = 1; i < pts.length; i++){
    22	    L += Math.hypot(pts[i].x - pts[i-1].x, pts[i].y - pts[i-1].y);
    23	    cum.push(L);
    24	  }
    25	  return { pts: pts, cum: cum, len: L };
    26	}
    27	
    28	function polyAt(p, s){
    29	  if (s < 0) s = 0; else if (s > p.len) s = p.len;
    30	  var lo = 0, hi = p.cum.length - 1, m;
    31	  while (lo < hi - 1){ m = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (p.cum[m] <= s) lo = m; else hi = m; }
    32	  var a = p.pts[lo], b = p.pts[lo+1] || p.pts[lo];
    33	  var seg = (p.cum[lo+1] - p.cum[lo]) || 1;
    34	  var t = (s - p.cum[lo]) / seg;
    35	  var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y, dl = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    36	  return { x: a.x + dx * t, y: a.y + dy * t, tx: dx / dl, ty: dy / dl };
    37	}
    38	
    39	/* Serpentine main line: down the left column, round the bottom, up the right column. */
    40	var SPINE_CX = 100, SPINE_TOP = -80, SPINE_HB = 300, SPINE_R = 100;
    41	function buildSpine(){
    42	  var pts = [], y, k, th;
    43	  for (y = SPINE_TOP; y <= SPINE_HB; y += 10) pts.push({ x: -SPINE_CX, y: y });
    44	  for (k = 1; k <= 44; k++){
    45	    th = Math.PI - Math.PI * k / 44;
    46	    pts.push({ x: Math.cos(th) * SPINE_R, y: SPINE_HB + Math.sin(th) * SPINE_R });
    47	  }
    48	  for (y = SPINE_HB - 10; y >= SPINE_TOP; y -= 10) pts.push({ x: SPINE_CX, y: y });
    49	  return polyBuild(pts);
    50	}
    51	
    52	/* Sample a stretch of spine, optionally bowed outward by D (a station siding). */
    53	function sampleEdge(spine, s0, s1, D){
    54	  var L = s1 - s0, N = Math.max(8, Math.round(L / 6)), pts = [], k, u, s, p, w;
    55	  for (k = 0; k <= N; k++){
    56	    u = k / N; s = s0 + L * u;
    57	    p = polyAt(spine, s);
    58	    w = D > 0 ? D * smoothstep(0, 0.36, u) * (1 - smoothstep(0.64, 1, u)) : 0;
    59	    pts.push({ x: p.x - p.ty * w, y: p.y + p.tx * w });
    60	  }
    61	  return { pts: pts, midIdx: Math.round(N / 2) };
    62	}
    63	
    64	var NET_S0 = 70, NET_SEG = 150, NET_D = 95, NET_EXIT = 92, NET_MAX = 6;
    65	
    66	function makeEdge(kind, seg, pts){
    67	  var p = polyBuild(pts);
    68	  var path = new Path2D();
    69	  path.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    70	  for (var i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) path.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
    71	  /* first ~78 units, used to show which way a switch is set */
    72	  var head = new Path2D();
    73	  head.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    74	  for (i = 1; i < pts.length && p.cum[i] < 78; i++) head.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
    75	  return { kind: kind, seg: seg, poly: p, len: p.len, path: path, headPath: head,
    76	           stationS: null, stationPt: null, signalS: p.len > 62 ? p.len - 24 : null,
    77	           signalPt: null, dirPt: polyAt(p, Math.min(26, p.len)) };
    78	}
    79	
    80	/* n = station count. Edge index layout: 0 entry, 1+2i main_i, 2+2i side_i, 1+2n exit. */
    81	function buildNet(spine, n, colors){
    82	  var jS = [], i;
    83	  for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) jS.push(NET_S0 + NET_SEG * i);
    84	  var edges = [];
    85	  edges.push(makeEdge('entry', -1, sampleEdge(spine, 0, jS[0], 0).pts));
    86	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++){
    87	    edges.push(makeEdge('main', i, sampleEdge(spine, jS[i], jS[i+1], 0).pts));
    88	    var sd = sampleEdge(spine, jS[i], jS[i+1], NET_D);
    89	    var e = makeEdge('side', i, sd.pts);
    90	    e.stationS = e.poly.cum[sd.midIdx];
    91	    e.stationPt = polyAt(e.poly, e.stationS);
    92	    edges.push(e);
    93	  }
    94	  var endS = Math.min(spine.len, jS[n] + NET_EXIT);
    95	  var ex = makeEdge('exit', -1, sampleEdge(spine, jS[n], endS, 0).pts);
    96	  ex.signalS = null;
    97	  edges.push(ex);
    98	
    99	  var all = new Path2D();
   100	  for (i = 0; i < edges.length; i++){
   101	    all.addPath(edges[i].path);
   102	    if (edges[i].signalS !== null) edges[i].signalPt = polyAt(edges[i].poly, edges[i].signalS);
   103	  }
   104	
   105	  var nodes = [], stations = [];
   106	  for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) nodes.push(polyAt(spine, jS[i]));
   107	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++){
   108	    var sp = edges[2 + 2*i].stationPt;
   109	    stations.push({ x: sp.x, y: sp.y, tx: sp.tx, ty: sp.ty, color: colors[i % colors.length], i: i });
   110	  }
   111	  return { n: n, jS: jS, edges: edges, nodes: nodes, stations: stations, allPath: all,
   112	           entryPt: polyAt(edges[0].poly, 0), exitPt: polyAt(ex.poly, ex.len),
   113	           exitIdx: 1 + 2*n, sw: new Array(n).fill(false) };
   114	}
   115	
   116	function childIdx(net, seg){ return net.sw[seg] ? 2 + 2*seg : 1 + 2*seg; }
   117	
   118	function nextEdgeIdx(net, ei){
   119	  var e = net.edges[ei];
   120	  if (e.kind === 'exit') return -1;
   121	  var j = (e.kind === 'entry' ? -1 : e.seg) + 1;
   122	  return j < net.n ? childIdx(net, j) : net.exitIdx;
   123	}
   124	
   125	/* Both possible successors - used for safe following across a junction. */
   126	function childrenIdx(net, ei){
   127	  var e = net.edges[ei];
   128	  if (e.kind === 'exit') return [];
   129	  var j = (e.kind === 'entry' ? -1 : e.seg) + 1;
   130	  return j < net.n ? [1 + 2*j, 2 + 2*j] : [net.exitIdx];
   131	}
   132	
   133	function netBounds(net){
   134	  var b = { x0: 1e9, y0: 1e9, x1: -1e9, y1: -1e9 };
   135	  for (var i = 0; i < net.edges.length; i++){
   136	    var pts = net.edges[i].poly.pts;
   137	    for (var k = 0; k < pts.length; k++){
   138	      if (pts[k].x < b.x0) b.x0 = pts[k].x;
   139	      if (pts[k].x > b.x1) b.x1 = pts[k].x;
   140	      if (pts[k].y < b.y0) b.y0 = pts[k].y;
   141	      if (pts[k].y > b.y1) b.y1 = pts[k].y;
   142	    }
   143	  }
   144	  b.x0 -= 34; b.x1 += 34; b.y0 -= 30; b.y1 += 30;
   145	  return b;

    15	    { id: 'park',  t: T.PARK,  name: 'Park',  cost: 40,  col: '#8fd44f' },
    16	    { id: 'raze',  t: -1,      name: 'Raze',  cost: 6,   col: '#c8ccd0' }
    17	  ];
    18	
    19	  var GOALS = [500, 2000, 5000];
    20	  var TICK_MS = 6000;
    21	
    22	  var HOME_POP  = [10, 34, 90];
    23	  var SHOP_CAP  = [220, 700, 1800]; // people each shop tier can serve
    24	  var PLANT_CAP = 46;               // building tiles a plant powers
    25	  var ROAD_CAP  = 26;               // traffic load before congestion
    26	
    27	  // ---------- rng ----------
    28	  function mulberry(a) {
    29	    return function () {
    30	      a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    31	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
    32	      t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    33	      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    34	    };
    35	  }
    36	
    37	  // ---------- state ----------
    38	  function blank(seed) {
    39	    var s = {
    40	      seed: seed >>> 0,
    41	      t: new Uint8Array(N),
    42	      d: new Uint8Array(N),      // density tier 0..2
    43	      g: new Float32Array(N),    // growth accumulator
    44	      pow: new Uint8Array(N),    // powered flag
    45	      acc: new Uint8Array(N),    // road access flag
    46	      svc: new Uint8Array(N),    // shop service flag (homes) / customers (shops)
    47	      des: new Float32Array(N),  // desirability
    48	      load: new Float32Array(N), // road traffic load
    49	      pop: 0, funds: 2200, month: 1, income: 0, upkeep: 0,
    50	      goal: 0, best: 0, broke: false, tickAcc: 0
    51	    };
    52	    terrain(s);
    53	    return s;
    54	  }
    55	
    56	  function terrain(s) {
    57	    var r = mulberry(s.seed), i, x, y;
    58	    // low-frequency value noise via random control points
    59	    var cw = 6, ch = 8, cp = [];
    60	    for (i = 0; i < cw * ch; i++) cp.push(r());
    61	    function samp(fx, fy) {
    62	      var gx = fx * (cw - 1), gy = fy * (ch - 1);
    63	      var x0 = Math.floor(gx), y0 = Math.floor(gy);
    64	      var x1 = Math.min(cw - 1, x0 + 1), y1 = Math.min(ch - 1, y0 + 1);
    65	      var tx = gx - x0, ty = gy - y0;
    66	      tx = tx * tx * (3 - 2 * tx); ty = ty * ty * (3 - 2 * ty);
    67	      var a = cp[y0 * cw + x0], b = cp[y0 * cw + x1], c = cp[y1 * cw + x0], d = cp[y1 * cw + x1];
    68	      return (a + (b - a) * tx) * (1 - ty) + (c + (d - c) * tx) * ty;
    69	    }
    70	    var wv = 0.30 + r() * 0.06, hv = 0.74 - r() * 0.04, open = 0, pass;
    71	    for (pass = 0; pass < 14; pass++) {
    72	      open = 0;
    73	      for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
    74	        var v = samp(x / (W - 1), y / (H - 1));
    75	        var k = y * W + x;
    76	        s.t[k] = v < wv ? T.WATER : (v > hv ? T.HILL : T.GRASS);
    77	        if (s.t[k] === T.GRASS) open++;
    78	      }
    79	      if (open >= 245) break;      // keep enough buildable land for a 5k city
    80	      wv -= 0.022; hv += 0.022;
    81	    }
    82	    // guarantee a decent buildable core near centre
    83	    for (y = 8; y < 14; y++) for (x = 5; x < 11; x++) s.t[y * W + x] = T.GRASS;
    84	    // seed a starter road so the first tap is obvious
    85	    for (x = 5; x < 11; x++) s.t[10 * W + x] = T.ROAD;
    86	  }
    87	
    88	  // ---------- helpers ----------
    89	  function inb(x, y) { return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < W && y < H; }
    90	  function isBuilding(t) { return t === T.HOME || t === T.SHOP || t === T.POWER; }
    91	  function buildable(t) { return t !== T.WATER && t !== T.HILL; }
    92	
    93	  function place(s, x, y, tool) {
    94	    if (!inb(x, y)) return 0;
    95	    var k = y * W + x, cur = s.t[k];
    96	    if (cur === T.WATER || cur === T.HILL) return 0;
    97	    if (tool.t === -1) {                       // raze
    98	      if (cur === T.GRASS) return 0;
    99	      if (s.funds < tool.cost) { s.broke = true; return 0; }
   100	      s.t[k] = T.GRASS; s.d[k] = 0; s.g[k] = 0; s.funds -= tool.cost;
   101	      return 1;
   102	    }
   103	    if (cur === tool.t) return 0;
   104	    if (s.funds < tool.cost) { s.broke = true; return 0; }
   105	    s.t[k] = tool.t; s.d[k] = 0; s.g[k] = 0;
   106	    s.funds -= tool.cost;
   107	    return 1;
   108	  }
   109	
   110	  // ---------- state analysis (road access / power / desirability / traffic / shops) ----------
   111	  function analyze(s) {
   112	    var i, x, y, k, nx, ny;
   113	
   114	    // --- road access: adjacent to any road
   115	    s.acc.fill(0);
   116	    for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   117	      k = y * W + x;
   118	      if (!isBuilding(s.t[k])) continue;
   119	      if ((inb(x - 1, y) && s.t[k - 1] === T.ROAD) || (inb(x + 1, y) && s.t[k + 1] === T.ROAD) ||
   120	          (inb(x, y - 1) && s.t[k - W] === T.ROAD) || (inb(x, y + 1) && s.t[k + W] === T.ROAD)) s.acc[k] = 1;
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    // --- power: BFS over roads + plants, then fill buildings by distance, up to capacity
   124	    s.pow.fill(0);
   125	    var dist = new Int16Array(N).fill(-1), q = [], plants = 0;
   126	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) if (s.t[k] === T.POWER) { dist[k] = 0; q.push(k); plants++; }
   127	    var qi = 0;
   128	    while (qi < q.length) {
   129	      k = q[qi++]; x = k % W; y = (k / W) | 0;
   130	      if (dist[k] >= 40) continue;
   131	      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   132	        nx = x + (i === 0 ? 1 : i === 1 ? -1 : 0); ny = y + (i === 2 ? 1 : i === 3 ? -1 : 0);
   133	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   134	        var nk = ny * W + nx;
   135	        if (dist[nk] !== -1) continue;
   136	        if (s.t[nk] !== T.ROAD && s.t[nk] !== T.POWER) continue;
   137	        dist[nk] = dist[k] + 1; q.push(nk);
   138	      }
   139	    }
   140	    var cand = [];
   141	    for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   142	      k = y * W + x;
   143	      if (s.t[k] === T.POWER) { s.pow[k] = 1; continue; }
   144	      if (s.t[k] !== T.HOME && s.t[k] !== T.SHOP) continue;
   145	      var best = -1;
   146	      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   147	        nx = x + (i === 0 ? 1 : i === 1 ? -1 : 0); ny = y + (i === 2 ? 1 : i === 3 ? -1 : 0);
   148	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   149	        var d2 = dist[ny * W + nx];
   150	        if (d2 >= 0 && (best < 0 || d2 < best)) best = d2;
   151	      }
   152	      if (best >= 0) cand.push([best, k]);
   153	    }
   154	    cand.sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; });
   155	    var cap = plants * PLANT_CAP;
   156	    for (i = 0; i < cand.length && i < cap; i++) s.pow[cand[i][1]] = 1;
   157	
   158	    // --- desirability field
   159	    s.des.fill(0);
   160	    stamp(s, T.PARK, 4, 3.4);
   161	    stamp(s, T.POWER, 3, -5.0);
   162	    // water is nice, hills are scenic
   163	    for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   164	      k = y * W + x;
   165	      if (s.t[k] !== T.WATER && s.t[k] !== T.HILL) continue;
   166	      var amt = s.t[k] === T.WATER ? 1.2 : 0.6;
   167	      for (ny = y - 2; ny <= y + 2; ny++) for (nx = x - 2; nx <= x + 2; nx++) {
   168	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   169	        s.des[ny * W + nx] += amt / (1 + Math.abs(nx - x) + Math.abs(ny - y));
   170	      }
   171	    }
   172	
   173	    // --- traffic load on roads (from nearby occupied buildings)
   174	    s.load.fill(0);
   175	    for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   220	    for (i = 0; i < shops.length; i++) if (shopDemand[i] > 0) s.svc[shops[i]] = 1;
   221	
   222	    return { homes: homes, shops: shops };
   223	  }
   224	
   225	  // ---------- monthly tick ----------
   226	  function tick(s) {
   227	    var i, k, x, y;
   228	    analyze(s);
   229	
   230	    // --- growth / decay
   231	    var grew = [];
   232	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   233	      var tt = s.t[k];
   234	      if (tt !== T.HOME && tt !== T.SHOP) continue;
   235	      x = k % W; y = (k / W) | 0;
   236	      var ok = s.acc[k] && s.pow[k] && s.svc[k];
   237	      var cong = roadCong(s, x, y);
   238	      if (tt === T.SHOP) ok = s.acc[k] && s.pow[k] && s.svc[k];
   239	      if (ok) {
   240	        var rate = 1;
   241	        rate += Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.8, s.des[k] * 0.16));
   242	        rate *= cong ? 0.35 : 1;
   243	        rate *= (s.d[k] === 0 ? 1 : s.d[k] === 1 ? 0.55 : 0);
   244	        s.g[k] += rate;
   245	        if (s.g[k] >= 3 && s.d[k] < 2) { s.d[k]++; s.g[k] = 0; grew.push(k); }
   246	      } else {
   247	        s.g[k] -= 0.7;
   248	        if (s.g[k] <= -3) { s.g[k] = 0; if (s.d[k] > 0) s.d[k]--; }
   249	      }
   250	    }
   251	
   252	    // --- population & economy
   253	    var pop = 0, jobs = 0;
   254	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   255	      if (s.t[k] === T.HOME) { if (s.acc[k] && s.pow[k]) pop += HOME_POP[s.d[k]]; else pop += Math.round(HOME_POP[s.d[k]] * 0.25); }
   256	      else if (s.t[k] === T.SHOP && s.pow[k]) jobs += (s.d[k] + 1) * 12;
   257	    }
   258	    s.pop = pop;
   259	    if (pop > s.best) s.best = pop;
   260	
   261	    var tax = Math.round(30 + pop * 0.55 + Math.min(jobs, pop) * 0.30);
   262	    var up = 0;
   263	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   264	      if (s.t[k] === T.ROAD) up += 0.4;
   265	      else if (s.t[k] === T.POWER) up += 22;
   266	      else if (s.t[k] === T.PARK) up += 2;
   267	      else if (s.t[k] === T.HOME) up += 0.8 * (s.d[k] + 1);
   268	      else if (s.t[k] === T.SHOP) up += 1.2 * (s.d[k] + 1);
   269	    }
   270	    up = Math.round(up);
   271	    s.income = tax; s.upkeep = up;
   272	    s.funds += tax - up;
   273	    if (s.funds < 0) s.funds = 0;
   274	    // emergency relief so a bankrupt city can always dig itself out
   275	    if (s.funds < 70 && tax - up <= 0) s.funds += 30;
   276	    s.broke = false;
   277	    s.month++;
   278	
   279	    var lvl = -1;
   280	    while (s.goal < GOALS.length && pop >= GOALS[s.goal]) { lvl = s.goal; s.goal++; }
   281	    return { grew: grew, net: tax - up, goalHit: lvl };
   282	  }
   283	
   284	  function stamp(s, type, rad, amt) {
   285	    for (var y = 0; y < H; y++) for (var x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   286	      var k = y * W + x;
   287	      if (s.t[k] !== type) continue;
   288	      var d = s.d[k] || 0;
   289	      for (var ny = y - rad; ny <= y + rad; ny++) for (var nx = x - rad; nx <= x + rad; nx++) {
   290	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   291	        var m = Math.max(Math.abs(nx - x), Math.abs(ny - y));
   292	        s.des[ny * W + nx] += amt * (1 - m / (rad + 1)) * (1 + d * 0.15);
   293	      }
   294	    }
   295	  }
   296	
   297	  function roadCong(s, x, y) {
   298	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   299	      var nx = x + (i === 0 ? 1 : i === 1 ? -1 : 0), ny = y + (i === 2 ? 1 : i === 3 ? -1 : 0);
   300	      if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   301	      var k = ny * W + nx;
   302	      if (s.t[k] === T.ROAD && s.load[k] > ROAD_CAP) return true;
   303	    }
   304	    return false;
   305	  }

   309	  function save(s) {

   312	        seed: s.seed, t: Array.from(s.t), d: Array.from(s.d),

   315	      };
   316	      localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(o));
   317	      localStorage.setItem(BKEY, String(Math.max(s.best, bestScore())));
   318	    } catch (e) {}
   319	  }

    23	  function audio() { if (!ac) { try { ac = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); } catch (e) { ac = false; } } return ac; }
    24	  function beep(freq, dur, type, vol) {
    25	    var a = audio(); if (!a) return;
    26	    try {
    27	      var o = a.createOscillator(), g = a.createGain();
    28	      o.type = type || 'square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, a.currentTime);
    29	      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, a.currentTime);
    30	      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.06, a.currentTime + 0.012);
    31	      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, a.currentTime + dur);
    32	      o.connect(g); g.connect(a.destination); o.start(); o.stop(a.currentTime + dur + 0.02);
    33	    } catch (e) {}
    34	  }
    35	  function chord(base) { [0, 4, 7, 12].forEach(function (n, i) { setTimeout(function () { beep(base * Math.pow(2, n / 12), 0.32, 'triangle', 0.07); }, i * 90); }); }

    93	  function setTip(txt) {

   100	  function hideTip() { firstBuild = true; }

   102	  // one short contextual line, never more than one at a time
   103	  function updateTip() {
   104	    var s = state, needRoad = 0, needPow = 0, needShop = 0, homes = 0, plants = 0, shops = 0;
   105	    for (var k = 0; k < S.W * S.H; k++) {
   106	      var t = s.t[k];
   107	      if (t === T.POWER) { plants++; continue; }
   108	      if (t === T.SHOP) shops++;
   109	      if (t !== T.HOME && t !== T.SHOP) continue;
   110	      if (t === T.HOME) homes++;
   111	      if (!s.acc[k]) needRoad++;
   112	      else if (!s.pow[k]) needPow++;
   113	      else if (!s.svc[k]) needShop++;
   114	    }
   115	    if (!firstBuild) return setTip('Pick a tool below, then drag on the map to build.');
   116	    if (!homes) return setTip('Place Homes next to a road to start growing.');
   117	    if (needRoad) return setTip('Red dot = no road. Build a road beside it.');
   118	    if (needPow) return setTip(plants ? 'Yellow dot = no power. Connect it by road to a plant.' : 'Yellow dot = no power. Build a Plant on the road network.');
   119	    if (needShop) return setTip(shops ? 'Blue dot = no shop within 5 tiles.' : 'Blue dot = build Shops within 5 tiles of homes.');
   120	    setTip('');
   121	  }

   129	  // ---------- city lifecycle ----------
   130	  function prime(s) {
   210	
   211	    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   212	      var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
   213	      if (k >= '1' && k <= '6') { tool = +k - 1; syncTools(); hideTip(); updateTip(); return; }
   214	      if (!cur) cur = { x: 8, y: 11 };
   215	      if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') { cur.x = Math.max(0, cur.x - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   216	      else if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') { cur.x = Math.min(S.W - 1, cur.x + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   217	      else if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'w') { cur.y = Math.max(0, cur.y - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
