     1	// Stomp Circuit - procedural arena
     2	var World = (function () {
     3	  var STEP = 8;
     4	
     5	  function rngFrom(seed) {
     6	    var a = seed >>> 0;
     7	    return function () {
     8	      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
     9	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    10	      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    11	      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    12	    };
    13	  }
    14	
    15	  function make(seed) {
    16	    var R = rngFrom(seed);
    17	    var w = 3600, base = 520;
    18	    var n = Math.ceil(w / STEP) + 1;
    19	    var h = new Float32Array(n); // height above base (positive = up)
    20	    var i, j;
    21	
    22	    function bump(cx, halfw, amp, pow) {
    23	      var i0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((cx - halfw) / STEP));
    24	      var i1 = Math.min(n - 1, Math.ceil((cx + halfw) / STEP));
    25	      for (var k = i0; k <= i1; k++) {
    26	        var t = (k * STEP - cx) / halfw;
    27	        if (t < -1 || t > 1) continue;
    28	        var f = Math.cos(t * Math.PI * 0.5);
    29	        h[k] += amp * Math.pow(f, pow || 1.6);
    30	      }
    31	    }
    32	    // kicker ramp: rise to amp over len, sharp lip, drop back
    33	    function ramp(x0, len, amp, dir) {
    34	      var i0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(x0 / STEP));
    35	      var i1 = Math.min(n - 1, Math.ceil((x0 + len) / STEP));
    36	      for (var k = i0; k <= i1; k++) {
    37	        var t = (k * STEP - x0) / len;
    38	        t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    39	        var u = dir > 0 ? t : 1 - t;
    40	        h[k] += amp * Math.pow(u, 2.0);
    41	      }
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    // rolling base noise
    45	    var p1 = R() * 100, p2 = R() * 100;
    46	    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    47	      var x = i * STEP;
    48	      h[i] = Math.sin(x * 0.0035 + p1) * 9 + Math.sin(x * 0.0091 + p2) * 5;
    49	    }
    50	
    51	    var obs = [];
    52	    function car(x, y, tier) {
    53	      var cw = 50 + Math.floor(R() * 14);
    54	      obs.push({ x: x, w: cw, h: 24, h0: 24, top0: y, type: 'car', tier: tier, hue: Math.floor(R() * 360), dead: false, hit: 0, wob: 0 });
    55	    }
    56	
    57	    // ---- features laid out left to right ----
    58	    var cx = 300;
    59	    var feats = [];
    60	    // guaranteed: at least 2 car stacks, 1 bus, 2 ramps, mounds
    61	    var plan = ['ramp', 'stack', 'mound', 'ramp', 'bus', 'stack', 'mound', 'ramp', 'stack'];
    62	    // shuffle tail lightly but keep bus in the middle-ish
    63	    for (i = plan.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    64	      if (plan[i] === 'bus' || plan[i - 1] === 'bus') continue;
    65	      j = Math.floor(R() * (i + 1));
    66	      if (plan[j] === 'bus') continue;
    67	      var t = plan[i]; plan[i] = plan[j]; plan[j] = t;
    68	    }
    69	
    70	    for (i = 0; i < plan.length; i++) {
    71	      var kind = plan[i];
    72	      var gap = 90 + R() * 70;
    73	      if (kind === 'mound') {
    74	        var hw = 90 + R() * 70, amp = 42 + R() * 46;
    75	        bump(cx + hw, hw, amp, 1.5);
    76	        feats.push({ t: 'mound', x: cx + hw });
    77	        cx += hw * 2 + gap;
    78	      } else if (kind === 'ramp') {
    79	        var rl = 108 + R() * 58, ra = 95 + R() * 52, dir = R() < 0.72 ? 1 : -1;
    80	        ramp(cx, rl, ra, dir);
    81	        feats.push({ t: 'ramp', x: cx + rl * 0.5 });
    82	        cx += rl + gap + 40;
    83	      } else if (kind === 'stack') {
    84	        feats.push({ t: 'stack', x: cx + 40 });
    85	        cx += 130 + gap;
    86	      } else if (kind === 'bus') {
    87	        // launch ramp then the bus then a landing mound
    88	        ramp(cx, 140, 124, 1);
    89	        feats.push({ t: 'ramp', x: cx + 65 });
    90	        cx += 130 + 70;
    91	        feats.push({ t: 'bus', x: cx + 85 });
    92	        cx += 240;
    93	        bump(cx + 100, 120, 52, 1.4);
    94	        cx += 240 + gap;
    95	      }
    96	      if (cx > w - 620) break;
    97	    }
    98	
    99	    // end bowls (quarter-pipe walls so you can turn around)
   100	    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   101	      var xx = i * STEP;
   102	      var d = Math.min(xx, w - xx);
   103	      if (d < 260) {
   104	        var u = 1 - d / 260;
   105	        h[i] += Math.pow(u, 2.4) * 340;
   106	      }
   107	    }
   108	
   109	    // no unclimbable vertical steps in either travel direction (~56 deg cap)
   110	    var MR = 15;
   111	    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) if (h[i] > h[i - 1] + MR) h[i] = h[i - 1] + MR;
   112	    for (i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) if (h[i] > h[i + 1] + MR) h[i] = h[i + 1] + MR;
   113	
   114	    function baseY(x) {
   115	      var fi = x / STEP;
   116	      var i0 = Math.floor(fi);
   117	      if (i0 < 0) i0 = 0; if (i0 > n - 2) i0 = n - 2;
   118	      var f = fi - i0;
   119	      return base - (h[i0] * (1 - f) + h[i0 + 1] * f);
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    // place obstacles now that terrain exists
   123	    for (i = 0; i < feats.length; i++) {
   124	      var F = feats[i];
   125	      if (F.t === 'stack') {
   126	        var cols = 1 + (R() < 0.55 ? 1 : 0);
   127	        var rows = 1 + Math.floor(R() * 3);
   128	        for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
   129	          var sx = F.x + c * 66;
   130	          var gy = baseY(sx);
   131	          for (var rw = 0; rw < rows; rw++) car(sx, gy - rw * 24, rw);
   132	        }
   133	      } else if (F.t === 'bus') {
   134	        var by = baseY(F.x);
   135	        obs.push({ x: F.x, w: 168, h: 52, h0: 52, top0: by, type: 'bus', tier: 0, hue: 44, dead: false, hit: 0, wob: 0, tough: true });
   136	      }
   137	    }
   138	
   139	    // guarantee a minimum amount of stuff to crush in every arena
   140	    function freeAt(x) {
   141	      for (var q = 0; q < obs.length; q++) if (Math.abs(obs[q].x - x) < 130) return false;
   142	      return true;
   143	    }
   144	    var guard = 0;
   145	    while (obs.filter(function (o) { return o.type === 'car'; }).length < 8 && guard++ < 60) {
   146	      var gx = 420 + R() * (w - 900);
   147	      if (!freeAt(gx)) continue;
   148	      var gy2 = baseY(gx);
   149	      var rws = 1 + Math.floor(R() * 3);
   150	      for (var rr2 = 0; rr2 < rws; rr2++) car(gx, gy2 - rr2 * 24, rr2);
   151	    }
   152	
   153	    // decorative background silhouettes
   154	    var deco = [];
   155	    for (i = 0; i < 26; i++) deco.push({ x: R() * w, s: 0.4 + R() * 0.9, h: 40 + R() * 130 });
   156	
   157	    var W = {
   158	      seed: seed, w: w, base: base, step: STEP, h: h, n: n, obs: obs, deco: deco,
   159	      startX: 260,
   160	      baseY: baseY,
   161	      // ground including obstacle tops
   162	      at: function (x) {
   163	        var y = baseY(x);
   164	        var slope;
   165	        var e = 6;
   166	        slope = (baseY(x + e) - baseY(x - e)) / (2 * e);
   167	        var solid = null;
   168	        for (var k = 0; k < obs.length; k++) {
   169	          var o = obs[k];
   170	          if (o.h <= 1.5) continue;
   171	          if (x < o.x - o.w * 0.5 || x > o.x + o.w * 0.5) continue;
   172	          var top = o.top0 - o.h;
   173	          if (top < y) { y = top; slope = 0; solid = o; }
   174	        }
   175	        return { y: y, slope: slope, obs: solid };
   176	      }
   177	    };
   178	    return W;
   179	  }
   180	
   181	  return { make: make, rng: rngFrom, STEP: STEP };
   182	})();

    14	    this.segs.length = 0; this.obs.length = 0; this.cars.length = 0; this.props.length = 0;
    15	    this.gx = -600; this.gy = 0; this.lastKind = '';
    16	    this.flat(1500);
    17	  },

    22	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + len, this.gy, 'street');
    23	    this.gx += len;
    24	  },

    29	    var x0 = this.gx, y0 = this.gy;

    37	    }

    39	  },
    40	  fGap: function (d) {

    42	    this.flat(rnd(200, 330));
    43	  },
    44	  fRail: function (d) {

    46	    this.seg(x0, this.gy, x0 + len + 90, this.gy, 'street');
    47	    this.seg(x0, this.gy - 46, x0 + len, this.gy - 46, 'rail');
    48	    this.gx += len + 90;
    49	    this.flat(rnd(140, 220));

    51	  fLedge: function (d) {

    53	    this.seg(x0, this.gy, x0 + len + 70, this.gy, 'street');
    54	    this.seg(x0, this.gy - h, x0 + len, this.gy - h, 'ledge');
    55	    this.obs.push({ x: x0, y: this.gy - h, w: 11, h: h, k: 'face' });
    56	    this.gx += len + 70;
    57	    this.flat(rnd(150, 240));
    58	  },

    60	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + 300, this.gy, 'street');
    61	    this.obs.push({ x: this.gx + 130, y: this.gy - 27, w: 15, h: 27, k: 'hydrant' });
    62	    this.gx += 300;
    63	    this.flat(rnd(120, 200));
    64	  },

    66	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + 260, this.gy, 'street');
    67	    var n = irnd(1, 3);
    68	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) this.obs.push({ x: this.gx + 90 + i * 40, y: this.gy - 22, w: 14, h: 22, k: 'cone' });
    69	    this.gx += 260;
    70	    this.flat(rnd(120, 190));
    71	  },
    72	  fCar: function (d) {
    73	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + 420, this.gy, 'street');
    74	    var moving = Math.random() < 0.45;
    75	    this.cars.push({
    76	      x: this.gx + 150, y: this.gy - 52, w: 120, h: 52,
    77	      vx: moving ? -rnd(50, 110) : 0, hue: pick([8, 42, 190, 320, 265])
    78	    });
    79	    this.gx += 420;
    80	    this.flat(rnd(130, 200));
    81	  },
    82	  fRamp: function () {
    83	    var len = 130, rise = 42;
    84	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + len, this.gy - rise, 'ramp');
    85	    this.gx += len; this.gy -= rise;
    86	    this.flat(rnd(180, 300));
    87	  },
    88	  fDrop: function () { // curb drop
    89	    this.gy += 26;
    90	    this.flat(rnd(220, 340));
    91	  },
    92	
    93	  gen: function (aheadX, dist) {
    94	    var d = clamp(dist / 3000, 0, 1);
    95	    var guard = 0;
    96	    while (this.gx < aheadX && guard++ < 40) {
    97	      // keep the street from wandering off the bottom of the world
    98	      if (this.gy > 520) { this.fRamp(); this.lastKind = 'ramp'; continue; }
    99	      if (this.gy < -260) { this.fDrop(); this.lastKind = 'drop'; continue; }
   100	
   101	      var bag = ['rail', 'ledge', 'stairs', 'gap', 'hydrant', 'car', 'cone', 'flat'];
   102	      if (d > 0.25) bag.push('rail', 'stairs', 'gap');
   103	      if (d > 0.5) bag.push('ledge', 'car', 'gap', 'stairs');
   104	      var k = pick(bag);
   105	      if (k === this.lastKind && Math.random() < 0.7) k = 'flat';
   106	      this.lastKind = k;
   107	      if (k === 'rail') this.fRail(d);
   108	      else if (k === 'ledge') this.fLedge(d);
   109	      else if (k === 'stairs') this.fStairs(d);
   110	      else if (k === 'gap') this.fGap(d);
   111	      else if (k === 'hydrant') this.fHydrant();
   112	      else if (k === 'cone') this.fCone();
   113	      else if (k === 'car') this.fCar(d);
   114	      else this.flat(rnd(200, 380));
   115	      if (Math.random() < 0.22) { this.props.push({ x: this.gx - rnd(40, 160), y: this.gy, k: pick(['hyd', 'post', 'trash']) }); }
   116	    }
   117	  },
   118	
   119	  prune: function (x) {
   120	    var i;
   121	    for (i = this.segs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.segs[i].x1 < x) this.segs.splice(i, 1);
   122	    for (i = this.obs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.obs[i].x + this.obs[i].w < x) this.obs.splice(i, 1);
   123	    for (i = this.cars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.cars[i].x + this.cars[i].w < x) this.cars.splice(i, 1);
   124	    for (i = this.props.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.props[i].x < x) this.props.splice(i, 1);
   125	  },
   126	
   127	  update: function (dt) {
   128	    for (var i = 0; i < this.cars.length; i++) { var c = this.cars[i]; if (c.vx) c.x += c.vx * dt; }
   129	  },
   130	
   131	  segY: function (s, x) {
   132	    if (s.y0 === s.y1) return s.y0;
   133	    return s.y0 + (s.y1 - s.y0) * ((x - s.x0) / (s.x1 - s.x0));
   134	  },
   135	
   136	  // every walkable surface height at x -> array of {y, seg}
   137	  surfaces: function (x, out) {
   138	    out.length = 0;
   139	    for (var i = 0; i < this.segs.length; i++) {
   140	      var s = this.segs[i];
   141	      if (x >= s.x0 && x <= s.x1) out.push({ y: this.segY(s, x), s: s });
   142	    }
   143	    for (var j = 0; j < this.cars.length; j++) {
   144	      var c = this.cars[j];
   145	      if (x >= c.x + 6 && x <= c.x + c.w - 6) out.push({ y: c.y, s: { k: 'roof', x0: c.x, x1: c.x + c.w, car: c } });
   146	    }
   147	    return out;
   148	  }
   149	};

    72	function bankCombo(mulOK) {

    84	function startTrick(i) {

    87	  P.trick = t; P.tt = 0; P.trickRot0 = P.rot; P.trickFlip0 = P.flip;
    88	  if (t.boost && P.vy > -120) P.vy += t.boost;
    89	  P.tuck = (i === 3) ? 1 : 0;

    94	function popOff(power) {
    95	  P.onGround = false; P.grind = false;
   150	  if (state === 'run') updateRun(dt);
   151	  else if (state === 'bail') {
   152	    var r = P.rag; r.t += dt;
   153	    P.v *= Math.pow(0.16, dt);
   154	    var groundY = bestSurfaceY(r.x);
   155	    r.vy += G * dt; r.x += r.vx * dt; r.y += r.vy * dt; r.rot += r.rv * dt; r.vx *= Math.pow(0.55, dt);
   156	    if (groundY !== null && r.y > groundY - 12) { r.y = groundY - 12; r.vy *= -0.34; r.rv *= 0.5; r.vx *= 0.6; if (Math.abs(r.vy) > 60) Parts.spawn(r.x, groundY, 5, { c: '#9aa4bb', l1: 0.4 }); }
   157	    var gb = bestSurfaceY(r.bx);
   158	    r.bvy += G * dt; r.bx += r.bvx * dt; r.by += r.bvy * dt; r.brot += r.brv * dt; r.bvx *= Math.pow(0.7, dt);
   159	    if (gb !== null && r.by > gb - 3) { r.by = gb - 3; r.bvy *= -0.4; r.brv *= 0.6; }
   160	    camX = lerp(camX, r.x - W * 0.34, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt));
   161	    camY = lerp(camY, r.y - H * 0.6, 1 - Math.pow(0.004, dt));
   162	    if (r.t > 1.15) gameOver();
   163	    if (r.t > 0.4 && (Input.tapPress || Input.tapQuick)) { gameOver(); }
   164	  } else if (state === 'over') {
   165	    if (Input.tapPress || Input.tapQuick) reset();
   166	  }
   167	}

   169	function bestSurfaceY(x) {
   170	  World.surfaces(x, surfBuf);
   171	  var y = null;
   172	  for (var i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) if (y === null || surfBuf[i].y > y) y = surfBuf[i].y;
   173	  return y;
   174	}

   176	function updateRun(dt) {
   177	  var i, s;
   178	  // ---- speed ----
   179	  P.v = clamp(P.v + 5 * dt, 240, 660);
   180	  P.x += P.v * dt;
   181	  distPx += P.v * dt;
   182	  P.wobble = Math.max(0, P.wobble - dt * 2.5);
   183	
   184	  World.gen(P.x + W * 2.2, distPx);
   185	  World.prune(P.x - W * 1.2);
   186	
   187	  // ---- input ----
   188	  var sw = Input.swipe;
   189	  if (P.grind) {
   190	    if (Input.tapQuick) { addCombo('POP OUT', 40); popOff(600); }
   191	  } else if (P.onGround) {
   192	    if (Input.tapPress) popOff(660);
   193	  } else {
   194	    if (sw === 3) {
   195	      if (!tryLatchGrind()) startTrick(3);
   196	    } else if (sw) startTrick(sw);
   197	  }
   198	
   199	  // ---- grinding ----
   200	  if (P.grind) {
   201	    var gs = P.grindSeg;
   202	    P.grindT += dt;
   203	    var pts = 45 * dt * (1 + P.grindT * 0.5);
   204	    P.grindPts += pts;
   205	    P.y = World.segY(gs, clamp(P.x, gs.x0, gs.x1));
   206	    // balance
   207	    var ctrl = Input.balance();
   208	    P.balv += (P.bal * 3.4 + Math.sin(timeAll * 7.3) * 0.35 + rnd(-1.1, 1.1)) * dt;
   209	    P.balv -= ctrl * 4.6 * dt;
   210	    P.balv = clamp(P.balv, -3.2, 3.2);
   211	    P.bal += P.balv * dt;
   212	    if (Math.abs(P.bal) >= 1) { bail('lost balance'); return; }
   213	    P.groundRef = P.y;
   214	    Parts.spawn(P.x - 10, P.y, 1, { c: '#ffe66d', vx0: -220, vx1: -60, vy0: -120, vy1: -20, s0: 1, s1: 2.4, l1: 0.35, g: 700 });
   215	    if (P.x > gs.x1) { endGrind(); P.onGround = false; P.vy = -180; }
   216	    camFollow(dt);
   217	    return;
   218	  }
   219	
   220	  // ---- vertical ----
   221	  var prevY = P.y;
   222	  if (P.onGround) {
   223	    // stick to surface / step off
   224	    World.surfaces(P.x, surfBuf);
   225	    var found = null;
   226	    for (i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) {
   227	      var c = surfBuf[i];
   228	      if (c.y >= P.y - 7 && c.y <= P.y + 16) { if (found === null || c.y < found.y) found = c; }
   229	    }
   230	    if (found) { P.y = found.y; P.seg = found.s; P.groundRef = P.y; P.rot = lerp(P.rot, 0, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt)); }
   231	    else { P.onGround = false; P.vy = 40; P.airT = 0; }
   232	  }
   233	  if (!P.onGround) {
   234	    P.airT += dt;
   235	    P.vy += G * dt;
   236	    P.y += P.vy * dt;
   237	    // trick anim
   238	    if (P.trick) {
   239	      P.tt += dt / P.trick.dur;
   240	      var e = easeOut(clamp(P.tt, 0, 1));
   241	      P.rot = P.trickRot0 + P.trick.rot * e;
   242	      P.flip = P.trickFlip0 + P.trick.flip * e;
   243	      if (P.tt >= 1) {
   244	        P.rot = 0; P.flip = 0;
   245	        addCombo(P.trick.n, P.trick.sc);
   246	        P.trick = null; P.tuck = 0;
   247	      }
   248	    }
   249	    // land?
   250	    World.surfaces(P.x, surfBuf);
   251	    var hit = null;
   252	    for (i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) {
   253	      var su = surfBuf[i];
   254	      if (prevY <= su.y + 2 && P.y >= su.y && P.vy > 0) { if (hit === null || su.y < hit.y) hit = su; }
   255	    }
   256	    if (hit) land(hit);
   257	    else if (P.y > P.groundRef + 250) { bail('fell in the gap'); return; }
   258	  }
   259	
   260	  // ---- obstacle collision ----
   261	  var bx0 = P.x - 11, bx1 = P.x + 11, by0 = P.y - 34, by1 = P.y - 2;
   262	  for (i = 0; i < World.obs.length; i++) {
   263	    var o = World.obs[i];
   264	    if (bx1 > o.x && bx0 < o.x + o.w && by1 > o.y && by0 < o.y + o.h) { bail('clipped it'); return; }
   265	  }
   266	  for (i = 0; i < World.cars.length; i++) {
   267	    var car = World.cars[i];
   268	    if (bx1 > car.x + 4 && bx0 < car.x + car.w - 4 && by1 > car.y + 5 && by0 < car.y + car.h) { bail('ate a bumper'); return; }
   269	  }
   270	
   271	  camFollow(dt);
   272	}

   274	function camFollow(dt) {
   275	  camX = P.x - W * 0.30;
   276	  camY = lerp(camY, P.groundRef - H * 0.66, 1 - Math.pow(0.02, dt));
   277	}

   279	function tryLatchGrind() {
   280	  for (var i = 0; i < World.segs.length; i++) {
   281	    var s = World.segs[i];
   282	    if (s.k !== 'rail' && s.k !== 'ledge') continue;
   283	    if (P.x < s.x0 - 18 || P.x > s.x1) continue;
   284	    var y = World.segY(s, clamp(P.x, s.x0, s.x1));
   285	    if (P.y > y - 46 && P.y < y + 16) { startGrind(s, y); return true; }
   286	  }
   287	  return false;
   288	}

   640	    var sx = P.x - camX, sy = P.y - camY;
   641	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
   642	    var gy = bestSurfaceY(P.x);

   645	  }
   646	  ctx.restore();
   647	  if (flash > 0.01) { ctx.globalAlpha = flash * 0.5; ctx.fillStyle = flashCol; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
   648	  drawHUD();

   650	}

   654	function frame(now) {

   657	  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;

   659	  update(dt);

    13	    W = Math.min(vw, Math.round(vh * 0.62));
    14	    H = vh;
    15	    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    16	    var cap = 960 / Math.max(W, H);
    17	    S = Math.min(dpr, Math.max(1, cap));
    18	    if (Math.max(W, H) * S > 960) S = 960 / Math.max(W, H);
    19	    cv.style.width = W + 'px';
    20	    cv.style.height = H + 'px';
    21	    cv.width = Math.round(W * S);
    22	    cv.height = Math.round(H * S);
    23	    layout();
    24	  }
    25	
    26	  /* ---------------- layout ---------------- */
    27	  var L = {};
    28	  function layout() {
    29	    L.waterTop = Math.round(H * 0.30);
    30	    L.bottom = Math.round(H * 0.945);
    31	    L.depth = L.bottom - L.waterTop;
    32	    L.rod = { x: Math.round(W * 0.17), y: L.waterTop - Math.round(H * 0.135) };
    33	    L.anglerX = Math.round(W * 0.085);
    34	    L.bands = [
    35	      [L.waterTop + L.depth * 0.06, L.waterTop + L.depth * 0.30],
    36	      [L.waterTop + L.depth * 0.36, L.waterTop + L.depth * 0.62],
    37	      [L.waterTop + L.depth * 0.68, L.waterTop + L.depth * 0.94]
    38	    ];
    39	    L.xmin = W * 0.24; L.xmax = W * 0.95;
    40	    L.bandXmin = [W * 0.24, W * 0.34, W * 0.54];
    41	    var bh = 48;
    42	    L.btnLog = { x: 8, y: 56, w: 92, h: bh, t: 'LOG' };
    43	    L.btnSnd = { x: W * 0.5 - 30, y: 56, w: 60, h: bh, t: 'SND' };
    44	    L.btnNext = { x: W - 8 - 118, y: 56, w: 118, h: bh, t: 'NEXT LAKE' };
    45	  }
    46	
    47	  /* ---------------- state ---------------- */
    48	  var store = LL.load();
    49	  var today = Math.floor(Date.now() / 86400000);
    50	  var lakeSeed = (store.day === today && store.lakeSeed != null) ? store.lakeSeed : today;
    51	  var lake, fish = [], score = 0, best = store.best || 0;
    52	  var state = 'aim';
    53	  var stateT = 0;
    54	  var msg = '', msgT = 0;
    55	  var shake = 0, flash = 0, flashCol = '#fff';
    56	  var parts = [], ripples = [];
    57	  var showLog = false;
    58	  var time = 0;
    59	
    60	  var lure = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, inWater: false };
    61	  var aim = { angle: 0.95, power: 0.62, holding: false, charge: 0, chargeDir: 1, sx: 0, sy: 0, px: 0, py: 0, touched: false };
    62	  var drag = { active: false, lx: 0, ly: 0, speed: 0, moveT: 0, downT: 0, moved: 0 };
    63	  var action = 0;              // 0 slow drag .. 1 fast twitch
    64	  var strikeFish = null, strikeT = 0;
    65	  var F = null;                // fight object
    66	  var result = null;
    67	  var hold = false;            // pointer or space held
    68	
    69	  function newLake(seed, resetScore) {
    70	    lakeSeed = seed;
    71	    store.lakeSeed = seed; store.day = today; LL.save(store);
    72	    lake = LL.makeLake(seed);
    73	    fish = [];
    74	    var r = LL.rng(seed * 40503 + 7);
    75	    lake.stock.forEach(function (s) {
    76	      var b = L.bands[s.sp.band];
    77	      var x0 = L.bandXmin[s.sp.band];
    78	      var t = Math.pow((s.w - s.sp.wmin) / Math.max(0.01, s.sp.wmax - s.sp.wmin), 0.5);
    79	      fish.push({
    80	        sp: s.sp, w: s.w,
    81	        x: x0 + r() * (L.xmax - x0),
    82	        y: b[0] + r() * (b[1] - b[0]),
    83	        homeLo: b[0], homeHi: b[1], xlo: x0,
    84	        dir: r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1,
    85	        spd: 12 + r() * 20,
    86	        phase: r() * 6.28,
    87	        len: (14 + t * 34) * (s.sp.body.big ? 1.15 : 1) * Math.min(1.4, W / 390),
    88	        interest: 0, cool: 0
    89	      });
    90	    });
    91	    if (resetScore) { score = 0; }
    92	    setState('aim');
    93	    say('Flick up to cast');
    94	  }
    95	
    96	  function setState(s) { state = s; stateT = 0; }
    97	  function say(t) { msg = t; msgT = 3.2; }
    98	
    99	  function addParts(x, y, n, col, spd, up) {
   100	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   101	      var a = Math.random() * 6.283;
   102	      var v = spd * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9);
   103	      parts.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * v, vy: Math.sin(a) * v - (up || 0), life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.6, t: 0, col: col, r: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.6 });
   104	    }
   105	  }
   106	  function addRipple(x, y, r0) { ripples.push({ x: x, y: y, r: r0 || 4, t: 0, life: 0.9 }); }
   107	
   108	  /* ---------------- input ---------------- */
   109	  function pos(e) {
   110	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   111	    return { x: (e.clientX - r.left), y: (e.clientY - r.top) };
   112	  }
   113	  function inBtn(b, x, y) { return x >= b.x - 6 && x <= b.x + b.w + 6 && y >= b.y - 6 && y <= b.y + b.h + 6; }
   114	
   115	  function onDown(x, y) {
   116	    LL.initAudio();
   117	    hold = true;
   118	    if (showLog) { showLog = false; LL.sfx.ui(); return; }
   119	    if (inBtn(L.btnLog, x, y)) { showLog = true; LL.sfx.ui(); return; }
   120	    if (inBtn(L.btnSnd, x, y)) { LL.audioOn = !LL.audioOn; LL.sfx.ui(); return; }
   121	    if (inBtn(L.btnNext, x, y)) { LL.sfx.ui(); newLake(lakeSeed + 1, true); return; }
   122	
   123	    if (state === 'aim') {
   124	      aim.holding = true; aim.touched = true;
   125	      aim.sx = x; aim.sy = y; aim.px = x; aim.py = y;
   126	    } else if (state === 'water') {
   127	      drag.active = true; drag.lx = x; drag.ly = y; drag.downT = 0; drag.moved = 0;
   128	    } else if (state === 'strike') {
   129	      setHook();
   130	    } else if (state === 'result') {
   131	      finishResult();
   132	    }
   133	  }
   134	  function onMove(x, y) {
   135	    if (state === 'aim' && aim.holding) {
   136	      aim.px = x; aim.py = y;
   137	      var dx = x - aim.sx, dy = y - aim.sy;
   138	      var d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   139	      if (d > 6) {
   140	        // upward flick: dy negative
   141	        var a = Math.atan2(-dy, Math.max(8, Math.abs(dx)) * (dx < 0 ? -1 : 1));
   142	        if (dx < 0) a = Math.atan2(-dy, 8);
   143	        aim.angle = Math.max(0.17, Math.min(1.40, a));
   144	        aim.power = Math.max(0.16, Math.min(1, d / (H * 0.34)));
   145	      }
   146	    } else if (state === 'water' && drag.active) {
   147	      var ddx = x - drag.lx, ddy = y - drag.ly;
   148	      var dist = Math.hypot(ddx, ddy);
   149	      drag.lx = x; drag.ly = y; drag.moved += dist;
   150	      if (dist > 0.2) {
   151	        drag.speed = drag.speed * 0.55 + (dist / Math.max(0.008, lastDt)) * 0.45;
   152	        drag.moveT = 0.35;
   153	        retrieve(dist * 0.55);
   154	      }
   155	    }
   156	  }
   157	  function onUp(x, y) {
   158	    hold = false;
   159	    if (state === 'aim' && aim.holding) {
   160	      aim.holding = false;
   161	      if (aim.touched && Math.hypot(x - aim.sx, y - aim.sy) < 10) return; // stray tap
   162	      doCast();
   163	    } else if (state === 'water' && drag.active) {
   164	      drag.active = false;
   165	      if (drag.moved < 8 && drag.downT < 0.3) twitch();
   166	    }
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); var t = e.changedTouches[0]; onDown.apply(null, xy(t)); }, { passive: false });
   170	  cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); var t = e.changedTouches[0]; onMove.apply(null, xy(t)); }, { passive: false });
   171	  cv.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); var t = e.changedTouches[0]; onUp.apply(null, xy(t)); }, { passive: false });
   172	  cv.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); hold = false; drag.active = false; aim.holding = false; }, { passive: false });
   173	  function xy(t) { var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); return [t.clientX - r.left, t.clientY - r.top]; }
   174	
   175	  var mouseDown = false, touchSeen = false;
   176	  cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function () { touchSeen = true; }, { passive: true });
   177	  cv.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { if (touchSeen) return; e.preventDefault(); mouseDown = true; var p = pos(e); onDown(p.x, p.y); });
   178	  window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { if (touchSeen || !mouseDown) return; var p = pos(e); onMove(p.x, p.y); });
   179	  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) { if (touchSeen || !mouseDown) return; mouseDown = false; var p = pos(e); onUp(p.x, p.y); });
   180	  document.addEventListener('gesturestart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   181	  document.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   182	
   183	  var keys = {};
   184	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   185	    var k = e.key;
   186	    if ([' ', 'Enter', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'w', 'a', 's', 'd', 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   187	    LL.initAudio();
   188	    if (keys[k]) return;
   189	    keys[k] = true;
   190	    var act = (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter');
   191	    if (k === 'l' || k === 'L') { showLog = !showLog; LL.sfx.ui(); return; }
   192	    if (k === 'n' || k === 'N') { LL.sfx.ui(); newLake(lakeSeed + 1, true); return; }
   193	    if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { LL.audioOn = !LL.audioOn; return; }
   194	    if (showLog) { showLog = false; return; }
   195	    if (act) hold = true;
   196	    if (state === 'aim' && act) { aim.holding = true; aim.touched = false; aim.charge = 0.30; aim.chargeDir = 1; }
   197	    else if (state === 'water' && act) { twitch(); drag.speed = 620; drag.moveT = 0.35; }
   198	    else if (state === 'strike' && act) setHook();
   199	    else if (state === 'result' && act) finishResult();
   200	  });
   201	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
   202	    var k = e.key; keys[k] = false;
   203	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
   204	      hold = false;
   205	      if (state === 'aim' && aim.holding) { aim.holding = false; aim.power = aim.charge; doCast(); }
   206	    }
   207	  });
   208	
   209	  /* ---------------- actions ---------------- */
   210	  function doCast() {
   211	    var v = aim.power * Math.sqrt(W * H * 2.4);
   212	    lure.x = L.rod.x; lure.y = L.rod.y;
   213	    lure.vx = Math.cos(aim.angle) * v;
   214	    lure.vy = -Math.sin(aim.angle) * v;
   215	    lure.inWater = false;
   216	    setState('cast');
   217	    LL.sfx.cast();
   218	  }
   219	  function retrieve(amount) {
   220	    if (!lure.inWater) return;
   221	    lure.x -= amount * 0.60;
   222	    lure.y -= amount * 0.12;
   223	    if (lure.y < L.waterTop + 5) lure.y = L.waterTop + 5;
   224	    if (lure.x <= L.rod.x + 14) resetCast('Line in. Flick up to cast');
   225	  }
   226	  function twitch() {
   227	    if (state !== 'water' || !lure.inWater) return;
   228	    lure.y -= 9; lure.x -= 5;
   229	    if (lure.y < L.waterTop + 5) lure.y = L.waterTop + 5;
   230	    addRipple(lure.x, lure.y, 3);
   231	    LL.sfx.twitch();
   232	    if (lure.x <= L.rod.x + 14) resetCast('Line in. Flick up to cast');
   233	  }
   234	  function resetCast(m) {
   235	    setState('aim'); strikeFish = null; F = null; action = 0; drag.speed = 0;
   236	    fish.forEach(function (f) { f.interest = 0; });
   237	    if (m) say(m);
   238	  }
   239	  function setHook() {
   240	    if (!strikeFish) return;
   241	    var f = strikeFish;
   242	    F = {
   243	      f: f, tension: 0.34, progress: 0, stamina: 1,
   244	      power: 0.45 + Math.min(1.15, f.w / 11),
   245	      ph: Math.random() * 6.28, ph2: Math.random() * 6.28,
   246	      snapT: 0, slackT: 0, t: 0,
   247	      hx: f.x, hy: f.y, thrash: 0
   248	    };
   249	    setState('fight');
   250	    shake = 8; flash = 0.35; flashCol = '#ffe9a8';
   251	    LL.sfx.hook();
   252	    say('HOLD to reel, RELEASE to give line');
   253	  }
   254	  function endFight(kind) {
   255	    var f = F.f;
   256	    if (kind === 'land') {
   257	      score += f.w;
   258	      var rec = false;
   259	      var cur = store.trophy[f.sp.id] || 0;
   260	      if (f.w > cur) { store.trophy[f.sp.id] = f.w; rec = true; }
   260	      if (f.w > cur) { store.trophy[f.sp.id] = f.w; rec = true; }
   261	      if (score > best) { best = score; store.best = Math.round(score * 100) / 100; }
   262	      LL.save(store);
   263	      fish.splice(fish.indexOf(f), 1);
   264	      result = { sp: f.sp, w: f.w, rec: rec, kind: 'land' };
   265	      addParts(L.rod.x + 30, L.waterTop, 26, '#cfeaf6', 220, 90);
   266	      shake = 6; flash = 0.3; flashCol = '#bfe9c8';
   267	      if (rec) LL.sfx.record(); else LL.sfx.land();
   268	    } else {
   269	      result = { sp: f.sp, w: f.w, kind: kind };
   270	      f.interest = 0; f.cool = 6;
   271	      f.x = Math.min(L.xmax, f.x + 40);
   272	      addParts(f.x, f.y, 18, kind === 'snap' ? '#ff8b6b' : '#9fd8ea', 200, 0);
   273	      shake = kind === 'snap' ? 14 : 6;
   274	      flash = 0.4; flashCol = kind === 'snap' ? '#ff7a55' : '#8fd0e8';
   275	      if (kind === 'snap') LL.sfx.snap(); else LL.sfx.escape();
   276	    }
   277	    F = null; strikeFish = null;
   278	    setState('result');
   279	  }
   280	  function finishResult() {
   281	    result = null;
   282	    setState('aim');
   283	    lure.inWater = false;
   284	    if (fish.length === 0) say('Lake is fished out - tap NEXT LAKE');
   285	    else say('Flick up to cast');
   286	  }
   287	
   288	  /* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   289	  var lastDt = 0.016;
   290	  function update(dt) {
   291	    time += dt; stateT += dt;
   292	    if (msgT > 0) msgT -= dt;
   293	    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 26);
   294	    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.6);
   295	
   296	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   297	      var p = parts[i]; p.t += dt;
   298	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 420 * dt;
   299	      if (p.t > p.life) parts.splice(i, 1);
   300	    }
   301	    for (var j = ripples.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
   302	      var rp = ripples[j]; rp.t += dt; rp.r += 46 * dt;
   303	      if (rp.t > rp.life) ripples.splice(j, 1);
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    if (showLog) return;
   307	
   308	    // aim charge (keyboard)
   309	    if (state === 'aim') {
   310	      if (aim.holding && !aim.touched) {
   311	        aim.charge += aim.chargeDir * dt * 1.15;
   312	        if (aim.charge > 1) { aim.charge = 1; aim.chargeDir = -1; }
   313	        if (aim.charge < 0.30) { aim.charge = 0.30; aim.chargeDir = 1; }
   314	        aim.power = aim.charge;
   315	      }
   316	      var ang = 0;
   317	      if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w'] || keys['W']) ang += 1;
   318	      if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s'] || keys['S']) ang -= 1;
   319	      if (ang) aim.angle = Math.max(0.17, Math.min(1.40, aim.angle + ang * dt * 0.9));
   320	    }
   321	
   322	    if (state === 'cast') {
   323	      lure.vy += H * 2.4 * dt;
   324	      lure.x += lure.vx * dt; lure.y += lure.vy * dt;
   325	      if (lure.x > W - 6) { lure.x = W - 6; lure.vx *= -0.25; }
   326	      if (lure.y >= L.waterTop) {
   327	        lure.y = L.waterTop; lure.vy = 0; lure.vx = 0; lure.inWater = true;
   328	        addRipple(lure.x, L.waterTop, 5); addRipple(lure.x, L.waterTop, 14);
   329	        addParts(lure.x, L.waterTop, 12, '#cfeaf6', 140, 120);
   330	        LL.sfx.splash();
   331	        setState('water');
   332	        say('Drag to work the lure');
   333	      }
   334	    }
   335	
   336	    if (state === 'water') {
   337	      if (drag.active) drag.downT += dt;
   338	      // keyboard hold = slow steady drag
   339	      if (hold && !drag.active && (keys[' '] || keys['Enter'])) {
   340	        retrieve(46 * dt);
   341	        drag.speed = drag.speed * 0.85 + 60 * 0.15;
   342	        drag.moveT = 0.3;
   343	      }
   344	      drag.moveT -= dt;
   345	      if (drag.moveT <= 0) drag.speed *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   346	      var target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, drag.speed / 480));
   347	      action += (target - action) * Math.min(1, dt * 7);
   348	      // sink
   349	      if (drag.moveT <= 0) {
   350	        lure.y += 34 * dt;
   351	        var maxd = bottomAt(lure.x) - 4;
   352	        if (lure.y > maxd) lure.y = maxd;
   353	      }
   354	    }
   355	
   356	    // fish behaviour
   357	    var lively = state === 'water' && drag.moveT > 0;
   358	    for (var k = 0; k < fish.length; k++) {
   359	      var f = fish[k];
   360	      f.phase += dt * (3 + f.spd * 0.08);
   361	      if (f.cool > 0) f.cool -= dt;
   362	      if (F && F.f === f) continue;
   363	      if (strikeFish === f) continue;
   364	      var chase = false;
   365	      if (state === 'water' && f.cool <= 0) {
   366	        var d = Math.hypot(f.x - lure.x, f.y - lure.y);
   367	        var match = 1 - Math.abs(action - f.sp.pref);
   368	        if (d < 130 && lively) {
   369	          f.interest += dt * ((match - 0.40) * 2.6 + 0.18);
   370	        } else {
   371	          f.interest -= dt * 0.5;
   372	        }
   373	        f.interest = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.2, f.interest));
   374	        if (f.interest > 0.22) {
   375	          chase = true;
   376	          var ang2 = Math.atan2(lure.y - f.y, lure.x - f.x);
   377	          var cs = 26 + f.interest * 70;
   378	          f.x += Math.cos(ang2) * cs * dt;
   379	          f.y += Math.sin(ang2) * cs * dt;
   380	          f.dir = (lure.x < f.x) ? -1 : 1;
   381	          if (f.interest >= 1 && d < 30 && !strikeFish) {
   382	            strikeFish = f; strikeT = 0; setState('strike');
   383	            shake = 5; flash = 0.28; flashCol = '#ffd76a';
   384	            addRipple(lure.x, lure.y, 6);
   385	            LL.sfx.strike();
   386	          }
   387	        }
   388	      } else if (f.interest > 0) f.interest = Math.max(0, f.interest - dt * 0.8);
   389	
   390	      if (!chase) {
   391	        f.x += f.dir * f.spd * dt;
   392	        f.y += Math.sin(time * 0.6 + f.phase) * 5 * dt;
   393	        if (f.x < f.xlo) { f.x = f.xlo; f.dir = 1; }
   394	        if (f.x > L.xmax) { f.x = L.xmax; f.dir = -1; }
   395	        if (f.y < f.homeLo) f.y += 18 * dt;
   396	        if (f.y > f.homeHi) f.y -= 18 * dt;
   397	      }
   398	    }
   399	
   400	    if (state === 'strike') {
   401	      strikeT += dt;
   402	      if (strikeT > 0.8) {
   403	        strikeFish.interest = 0; strikeFish.cool = 4; strikeFish = null;
   404	        setState('water'); say('Missed the take');
   405	      }
   406	    }
   407	
   408	    if (state === 'fight') updateFight(dt);
   409	  }
   410	
   411	  function updateFight(dt) {
   412	    F.t += dt;
   413	    var run = Math.max(0, Math.sin(F.t * 1.55 + F.ph)) * (0.45 + 0.55 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(F.t * 0.82 + F.ph2)));
   414	    var pull = F.power * (0.32 + 0.68 * F.stamina) * (0.62 + 0.95 * run);
   415	    F.pull = pull;
   416	    if (hold) {
   417	      F.tension += (0.30 + pull * 0.80) * dt;
   418	      F.progress += Math.max(0.03, 0.165 - 0.055 * pull) * dt;
   419	      if (Math.random() < dt * 14) LL.sfx.reel();
   420	    } else {
   421	      F.tension -= (0.88 + 0.22 * (1 - F.stamina)) * dt;
   422	      F.progress -= 0.055 * pull * dt;
   423	    }
   424	    F.tension = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.15, F.tension));

    43	  /* ---------------- lake generation ---------------- */
    44	  LL.makeLake = function (seed) {
    45	    var r = LL.rng(seed * 2654435761 + 12345);
    46	    var name = ADJ[(r() * ADJ.length) | 0] + ' ' + NOUN[(r() * NOUN.length) | 0];
    47	    var weather = WEATHER[(r() * WEATHER.length) | 0];
    48	
    49	    // stock: every species has a chance; guarantee coverage of each band
    50	    var pool = [];
    51	    var counts = {};
    52	    LL.SPECIES.forEach(function (sp) {
    53	      var n;
    54	      if (sp.id === 'greenmouth') n = (r() * 2.2) | 0;              // 0-2 lunkers
    55	      else if (sp.wmax > 9) n = 1 + ((r() * 2.2) | 0);
    56	      else n = 1 + ((r() * 3.6) | 0);
    57	      counts[sp.id] = n;
    58	    });
    59	    // make sure something lives in each band
    60	    [0, 1, 2].forEach(function (b) {
    61	      var has = LL.SPECIES.some(function (sp) { return sp.band === b && counts[sp.id] > 0; });
    62	      if (!has) {
    63	        var cand = LL.SPECIES.filter(function (sp) { return sp.band === b; });
    64	        counts[cand[(r() * cand.length) | 0].id] = 1 + ((r() * 2) | 0);
    65	      }
    66	    });
    67	
    68	    LL.SPECIES.forEach(function (sp) {
    69	      for (var i = 0; i < counts[sp.id]; i++) {
    70	        var t = Math.pow(r(), sp.skew);
    71	        var w = sp.wmin + t * (sp.wmax - sp.wmin);
    72	        pool.push({ sp: sp, w: Math.round(w * 100) / 100, seedR: r() });
    73	      }
    74	    });
    75	    return { seed: seed, name: name, weather: weather, stock: pool };
    76	  };

   101	  function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo) {
   102	    if (!ac || !LL.audioOn) return;
   103	    var t = ac.currentTime;
   104	    var o = ac.createOscillator(), g = ac.createGain();
   105	    o.type = type || 'sine';
   106	    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
   107	    if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, slideTo), t + dur);
   108	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
   109	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.15, t + 0.012);
   110	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
   111	    o.connect(g); g.connect(ac.destination);
   112	    o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.03);
   113	  }
   114	  function noise(dur, vol, hp) {
   115	    if (!ac || !LL.audioOn) return;
   116	    var n = (ac.sampleRate * dur) | 0;
   117	    var buf = ac.createBuffer(1, n, ac.sampleRate);
   118	    var d = buf.getChannelData(0);
   119	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / n);
   120	    var src = ac.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
   121	    var f = ac.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = hp ? 'highpass' : 'lowpass'; f.frequency.value = hp || 900;
   122	    var g = ac.createGain(); g.gain.value = vol || 0.12;
   123	    src.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(ac.destination);
   124	    src.start();
   125	  }

    16	// steps/frame, remainder carries across frames, 250ms clamp on the raw
    17	// frame delta before it enters the accumulator. Replaces the prior
    18	// one-update-per-requestAnimationFrame loop, which advanced at display
    19	// refresh rate rather than a fixed rate (see reviews/sol_port_spec_review_
    20	// 2026-07-18.md "fixed-step loop is not the source loop").
    21	const STEP_MS = 1000 / 60;
    22	const MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME = 5;
    23	const FRAME_CLAMP_MS = 250;

    63	    // R6: save system. Expose it for the harness (headless scripts have no

    82	  // Runs zero or more fixed 1/60s sim steps for the elapsed real time,
    83	  // then draws once. See module header for the accumulator contract.
    84	  _loop(ts) {
    85	    if (this._lastTs === null) this._lastTs = ts;
    86	    let dtMs = ts - this._lastTs;
    87	    this._lastTs = ts;
    88	    if (dtMs > FRAME_CLAMP_MS) dtMs = FRAME_CLAMP_MS; // clamp a big stall
    89	    if (dtMs < 0) dtMs = 0; // guard against a non-monotonic ts source
    90	
    91	    this._accumulatorMs += dtMs;
    92	
    93	    let steps = 0;
    94	    while (this._accumulatorMs >= STEP_MS && steps < MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME) {
    95	      this._update();
    96	      this._traceStep();
    97	      // Input edges (pressed()) are consumed by the FIRST sim step that
    98	      // runs after the frame's input was latched. Snapshotting `prev`
    99	      // here, after that first step, means any further sim steps this
   100	      // same frame see those edges as already consumed (pressed() is
   101	      // false), while held state (left/right/up/down/A/B — read straight
   102	      // off `keys`) is unaffected and persists across all of them.
   103	      if (steps === 0) {
   104	        this.input.prev = { ...this.input.keys };
   105	        this.input.consumePressed();
   106	      }
   107	      this._accumulatorMs -= STEP_MS;
   108	      steps++;
   109	    }
   110	    // Remainder time (including any left over after hitting the 5-step
   111	    // cap during a catch-up spiral) intentionally carries into next frame
   112	    // rather than being discarded — no time is invented or dropped.
   113	
   114	    this._draw();
   115	    this.frame++;
   116	    requestAnimationFrame(this._loop);
   117	  }
   118	
   119	  // Exposes the save system as window.zelda2Save for the Phase 0.5 scenario

   152	  // Trace mode (?trace=1): a per-sim-step checkpoint of player position/hp/
   153	  // mp and a digest of the live enemy array, so the scenario harness can

   156	  _traceStep() {
   157	    if (!trace.enabled) return;
   158	    const p = this.player;
   159	    const enemies = (this.state === STATE.SIDEVIEW && this.sideview.enemies) || [];
   160	    const enemyDigest = enemies
   161	      .map(e => `${e.type}#${e.id}:${Math.round(e.x)},${Math.round(e.y)},${e.hp},${e.alive}`)
   162	      .join('|');
   163	    trace.steps.push({
   164	      frame: this.frame,
   165	      state: this.state,
   166	      player: {
   167	        x: Math.round(p.x * 100) / 100,
   168	        y: Math.round(p.y * 100) / 100,
   169	        hp: p.hp,
   170	        mp: p.mp,
   171	        owX: p.owX,
   172	        owY: p.owY,
   173	      },
   174	      enemyDigest,
   175	    });

     1	// R6 (ledger): save system design.
     2	//
     3	// No save/load existed anywhere in `src` before this (see
     4	// reviews/sol_port_spec_review_2026-07-18.md "no save or load
     5	// implementation exists"). This module is the normative save format and
     6	// implementation: a versioned JSON document covering player stats, spells,
     7	// palace flags (crystals collected — palace state itself is not
     8	// re-simulated, only crystal count), position, and all four RNG stream
     9	// states (worldRng/combatRng/townRng/fxRng), so a restored game continues
    10	// producing the exact same draw sequence a live game would have.
    11	//
    12	// Design choices (documented, not hidden):
    13	//  - Save is defined for STATE.OVERWORLD, STATE.TITLE, STATE.GAMEOVER and
    14	//    STATE.WIN. Saving mid-SIDEVIEW/TOWN still captures full player state,
    15	//    but load always resumes on the OVERWORLD at the player's last
    16	//    overworld position — palace/field/town room state is transient
    17	//    session state, not part of the save contract (matches the original
    18	//    NES password/save convention of never resuming inside a room).
    19	//  - RNG stream state is the raw 32-bit LCG state integer (SeededRng
    20	//    getState()/setState()), not the seed — this preserves stream
    21	//    POSITION, which is what parity/determinism actually depends on.
    22	//
    23	// Supported I/O: localStorage (browser), and an explicit export/import
    24	// JSON string pair (used by the ?save=<json> URL param in game.js and by
    25	// the Phase 0.5 scenario harness, which has no UI to click a button).
    26	
    27	import { worldRng, combatRng, townRng, fxRng } from './rng.js';
    28	import { STATE } from './constants.js';
    29	import { WESTERN_MAP, EASTERN_MAP } from './map-data.js';
    30	
    31	export const SAVE_VERSION = 1;
    32	const STORAGE_KEY = 'crestfall.save.v1';
    33	
    34	const PLAYER_FIELDS = [
    35	  'x', 'y', 'w', 'h', 'vx', 'vy', 'facing', 'onGround', 'state',
    36	  'attackTimer', 'attackDuration', 'iframes', 'damageTimer',
    37	  'walkFrame', 'walkTimer',
    38	  'lives', 'atkLvl', 'magLvl', 'lifLvl', 'xp', 'score',
    39	  'maxHp', 'hp', 'maxMp', 'mp',
    40	  'lifeContainers', 'magicContainers',
    41	  'selectedSpell', 'keys', 'crystals', 'owX', 'owY',
    42	];
    43	
    44	export function serializeGame(game) {
    45	  const p = game.player;
    46	  return {
    47	    version: SAVE_VERSION,
    48	    seed: game.seed,
    49	    state: game.state,
    50	    player: {
    51	      ...Object.fromEntries(PLAYER_FIELDS.map(k => [k, p[k]])),
    52	      spells: { ...p.spells },
    53	      activeSpells: { ...p.activeSpells },
    54	    },
    55	    overworld: {
    56	      region: game.overworld.region,
    57	    },
    58	    rng: {
    59	      worldRng: worldRng.getState(),
    60	      combatRng: combatRng.getState(),
    61	      townRng: townRng.getState(),
    62	      fxRng: fxRng.getState(),
    63	    },
    64	  };
    65	}
    66	
    67	export function deserializeGame(game, data) {
    68	  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
    69	    throw new Error('save: not an object');
    70	  }
    71	  if (data.version !== SAVE_VERSION) {
    72	    throw new Error(`save: unsupported version ${data.version} (expected ${SAVE_VERSION})`);
    73	  }
    74	  if (!data.player || !data.rng) {
    75	    throw new Error('save: missing required "player" or "rng" section');
    76	  }
    77	
    78	  const p = game.player;
    79	  for (const k of PLAYER_FIELDS) {
    80	    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data.player, k)) {
    81	      p[k] = data.player[k];
    82	    }
    83	  }
    84	  p.spells = { ...(data.player.spells || {}) };
    85	  p.activeSpells = { ...(data.player.activeSpells || {}) };
    86	  // Runtime-only fields that must not leak stale values across a load.
    87	  p.swordActive = false;
    88	  p.swordBox = null;
    89	  p.fireballs = [];
    90	  p.swordBeam = null;
    91	  p._pendingLevelUp = [];
    92	
    93	  if (data.overworld) {
    94	    game.overworld.region = data.overworld.region === 'east' ? 'east' : 'west';
    95	    game.overworld.map = game.overworld.region === 'east' ? EASTERN_MAP : WESTERN_MAP;
    96	  }
    97	
    98	  worldRng.setState(data.rng.worldRng);
    99	  combatRng.setState(data.rng.combatRng);
   100	  townRng.setState(data.rng.townRng);
   101	  fxRng.setState(data.rng.fxRng);
   102	
   103	  // Load always resumes on the overworld (see module header).
   104	  game.state = STATE.OVERWORLD;
   105	  game.paused = false;
   106	  game.levelUpScreen = false;
   107	  game.palaceClearTimer = null;
   108	}
   109	
   110	export function saveToLocalStorage(game, key = STORAGE_KEY) {
   111	  try {
   112	    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return false;
   113	    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(serializeGame(game)));
   114	    return true;
   115	  } catch (_e) {
   116	    return false;
   117	  }
   118	}
   119	
   120	export function loadFromLocalStorage(game, key = STORAGE_KEY) {
   121	  try {
   122	    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return false;
   123	    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
   124	    if (!raw) return false;
   125	    deserializeGame(game, JSON.parse(raw));
   126	    return true;
   127	  } catch (_e) {
   128	    return false;
   129	  }
   130	}
   131	
   132	export function exportSave(game) {
   133	  return JSON.stringify(serializeGame(game));
   134	}
   135	
   136	export function importSave(game, json) {
   137	  const data = typeof json === 'string' ? JSON.parse(json) : json;
   138	  deserializeGame(game, data);
   139	}
   140	
   141	// Resolve a ?save=<encoded-json> URL param into a parsed save object, or
   142	// null. Safe to call in non-browser (Node) contexts.
   143	export function resolveSaveFromURL() {
   144	  try {
   145	    if (typeof location !== 'undefined' && location.search) {
   146	      const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
   147	      const raw = params.get('save');
   148	      if (raw !== null) return JSON.parse(raw);
   149	    }
   150	  } catch (_e) {
   151	    // no-op: fall through
   152	  }
   153	  return null;
   154	}

    91	    if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'w' || k === 'W') { keyUp = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    92	    else if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 's' || k === 'S') { keyDn = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    93	    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
    94	      e.preventDefault();
    95	      if (state === 'over' && overT > 0.45) newFlight();
    96	    }
    97	    audioUnlock();
    98	  });
    99	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
   100	    var k = e.key;
   101	    if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'w' || k === 'W') keyUp = false;
   102	    if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 's' || k === 'S') keyDn = false;
   103	  });
   104	
   105	  function readInput(dt) {
   106	    var target = 0, active = false;
   107	    if (drag) {
   108	      target = (drag.y0 - drag.cur) / DRAG_PX;
   109	      if (target > 1) target = 1; if (target < -1) target = -1;
   110	      active = true;
   111	    }
   112	    // keyboard stops just short of the stall so a held key mushes, not spins
   113	    if (keyUp) { target = 0.85; active = true; }
   114	    if (keyDn) { target = -1; active = true; }
   115	    if (!active) target = g.inTarget * Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 1.6);
   116	    g.inTarget = target;
   117	    var rate = 5.5;
   118	    g.input += (target - g.input) * Math.min(1, dt * rate);
   119	  }
   120	
   121	  // ---------------- audio (WebAudio only) ----------------
   122	  var AC = null, master = null, varioOsc = null, varioGain = null;
   123	  function audioUnlock() {
   124	    if (AC) { if (AC.state === 'suspended') AC.resume(); return; }
   125	    try {
   126	      var C = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   127	      if (!C) return;
   128	      AC = new C();
   129	      master = AC.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.18; master.connect(AC.destination);
   130	      varioOsc = AC.createOscillator(); varioOsc.type = 'square'; varioOsc.frequency.value = 700;
   131	      varioGain = AC.createGain(); varioGain.gain.value = 0;
   132	      varioOsc.connect(varioGain); varioGain.connect(master); varioOsc.start();
   133	    } catch (e) { AC = null; }
   134	  }
   135	  var beepAcc = 0;
   136	  function vario(dt, w) {
   137	    if (!AC) return;
   138	    if (w > 0.4 && state === 'fly') {
   139	      var rate = 1.2 + Math.min(4.5, w) * 1.5;
   140	      varioOsc.frequency.value = 620 + Math.min(5, w) * 150;
   141	      beepAcc += dt * rate;
   142	      var ph = beepAcc % 1;
   143	      varioGain.gain.value = ph < 0.45 ? 0.25 : 0;
   144	    } else {
   145	      varioGain.gain.value = 0; beepAcc = 0;
   146	    }
   147	  }
   148	  function thud(freq, dur, type, vol) {
   149	    if (!AC) return;
   150	    try {
   151	      var o = AC.createOscillator(), gn = AC.createGain();
   152	      o.type = type || 'sawtooth'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, AC.currentTime);
   153	      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40, freq * 0.25), AC.currentTime + dur);
   154	      gn.gain.setValueAtTime(vol || 0.5, AC.currentTime);
   155	      gn.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, AC.currentTime + dur);
   156	      o.connect(gn); gn.connect(master); o.start(); o.stop(AC.currentTime + dur + 0.02);
   157	    } catch (e) { }
   158	  }
   159	
   160	  // ---------------- simulation ----------------
   161	  function step(dt) {
   162	    g.t += dt;
   163	    readInput(dt);
   164	
   165	    // weight-shift lag
   166	    var aCmd = A_TRIM + (g.input < 0 ? g.input * A_NEG : g.input * A_POS);
   167	    g.alpha += (aCmd - g.alpha) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.2);
   168	
   169	    var a = g.alpha;
   170	    var CL = CL0 + CLA * a;
   171	    var extraD = 0;
   172	    if (a > A_STALL) {
   173	      var ex = a - A_STALL;
   174	      CL = CL0 + CLA * A_STALL - 3.4 * ex;
   175	      extraD = 0.9 * ex;
   176	      g.stalled = Math.min(1, g.stalled + dt * 4);
   177	    } else {
   178	      g.stalled = Math.max(0, g.stalled - dt * 2.5);
   179	    }
   180	    if (CL < 0.10) CL = 0.10;
   181	
   182	    var V = g.V; if (V < 3) V = 3;
   183	    var q = 0.5 * RHO * V * V * S;
   184	    var CD = CD0 + KIND * CL * CL + extraD;
   185	    if (V > 32) { var o = (V - 32) / 10; CD += 0.022 * o * o; }
   186	
   187	    var L = q * CL, D = q * CD;
   188	    var sg = Math.sin(g.gam), cg = Math.cos(g.gam);
   189	
   190	    var dV = (-D - MASS * G * sg) / MASS;
   191	    var Vd = Math.max(6, g.V);
   192	    var dgam = (L - MASS * G * cg) / (MASS * Vd);
   193	    if (dgam > 2.8) dgam = 2.8; if (dgam < -2.8) dgam = -2.8;
   194	
   195	    g.V += dV * dt;
   196	    if (g.V < 4.5) g.V = 4.5;
   197	    if (g.V > 44) g.V = 44;
   198	    g.gam += dgam * dt;
   199	    if (g.gam > 1.35) g.gam = 1.35;
   200	    if (g.gam < -1.45) g.gam = -1.45;
   201	
   202	    var w = world.lift(g.x, g.y);
   203	    g.air = w;
   204	    g.vx = g.V * Math.cos(g.gam) + world.wind;
   205	    g.vy = g.V * Math.sin(g.gam) + w;
   206	
   207	    g.x += g.vx * dt;
   208	    g.y += g.vy * dt;
   209	
   210	    g.roll += ((g.input * 0.22) - g.roll) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
   211	
   212	    // trail
   213	    if (g.trail.length === 0 || g.x - g.trail[g.trail.length - 1].x > 6) {
   214	      g.trail.push({ x: g.x, y: g.y });
   215	      if (g.trail.length > 120) g.trail.shift();
   216	    }
   217	
   218	    // wingtip vortices when fast, sparkles when climbing
   219	    if (g.V > 23 && Math.random() < dt * 30) {
   220	      particles.push({ x: g.x, y: g.y, vx: -rnd(2, 6), vy: rnd(-2, 2), l: 0.7, m: 0.7, k: 0 });
   221	    }
   222	    if (w > 1.0 && Math.random() < dt * (8 + w * 6)) {
   223	      particles.push({ x: g.x + rnd(-40, 40), y: g.y + rnd(-25, 25), vx: rnd(-1, 1), vy: w * rnd(0.5, 1.1), l: 1.4, m: 1.4, k: 1 });
   224	    }
   225	    if (g.stalled > 0.4) shake = Math.max(shake, 2 + g.stalled * 3);
   226	
   227	    for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   228	      var p = particles[i];
   229	      p.l -= dt; if (p.l <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   230	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   300	    }
   301	    var maxTop = lowest + H / s * 0.98;
   302	    if (wantY > maxTop && agl < 200) wantY = Math.max(g.y + 30 / s, maxTop);
   303	
   304	    var k = Math.min(1, dt * 6);
   305	    cam.x += (wantX - cam.x) * k;
   306	    cam.y = 0;
   307	    cam.yTop += (wantY - cam.yTop) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
   308	  }
   309	
   310	  function sx(wx) { return (wx - cam.x) * cam.scale; }
   311	  function sy(wy) { return (cam.yTop - wy) * cam.scale; }

   314	  var skyGrad = null, skyKey = '', terrGrad = null, terrGradH = -1;
   315	  function drawSky() {
   316	    var key = W + 'x' + H;
   317	    if (skyKey !== key) {
   318	      skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   319	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a3f6b');
   320	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#2f76a8');
   321	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0.8, '#7fb6cf');
   322	      skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c9dbe0');
   323	      skyKey = key;
   324	    }
   325	    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
   326	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   327	  }

   329	  function drawClouds() {
   330	    // simple cumulus row near cloudbase, parallax
   331	    var base = 1150;
   332	    var pf = 0.35;
   333	    var step = 520;
   334	    var x0 = cam.x * pf;
   335	    var i0 = Math.floor(x0 / step) - 1;
   336	    ctx.save();
   337	    for (var i = i0; i < i0 + Math.ceil(W / cam.scale / step) + 3; i++) {
   338	      var r = ((Math.sin(i * 12.9898 + world.seed * 0.001) * 43758.5453) % 1 + 1) % 1;
   339	      if (r > 0.75) continue;
   340	      var cx = (i * step + r * 300 - x0) * cam.scale;
   341	      var cy = sy(base + r * 130) * pf + H * 0.10;
   342	      var rad = (34 + r * 26) * cam.scale;
   343	      if (cx < -rad * 3 || cx > W + rad * 3) continue;
   344	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
   345	      ctx.beginPath();
   346	      ctx.arc(cx, cy, rad, 0, 6.283);
   347	      ctx.arc(cx + rad * 0.9, cy + rad * 0.15, rad * 0.75, 0, 6.283);
   348	      ctx.arc(cx - rad * 0.85, cy + rad * 0.2, rad * 0.65, 0, 6.283);
   349	      ctx.fill();
   350	    }
   351	    ctx.restore();
   352	  }

   354	  function drawBgRidge(pf, amp, off, col) {
   355	    var s = cam.scale;
   356	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   357	    ctx.beginPath();
   358	    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
   359	    var stepPx = 10;
   360	    for (var px = 0; px <= W + stepPx; px += stepPx) {
   361	      var wx = cam.x * pf + px / s;
   362	      var hb = 120 + amp * world.n(wx / 900 + off, 5) + amp * 0.45 * world.n(wx / 320 + off * 2, 6);
   363	      var y = (cam.yTop - hb) * s * pf + H * (1 - pf) * 0.42;
   364	      ctx.lineTo(px, y);
   365	    }
   366	    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
   367	    ctx.closePath();
   368	    ctx.fill();
   369	  }

   371	  function drawTerrain() {
   372	    var s = cam.scale;
   373	    var stepPx = 4;
   374	    var pts = [];
   375	    for (var px = -stepPx; px <= W + stepPx; px += stepPx) {
   376	      var wx = cam.x + px / s;
   377	      pts.push([px, sy(world.h(wx)), wx]);
   378	    }
   379	    // body
   380	    if (!terrGrad || terrGradH !== H) {
   381	      terrGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   382	      terrGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3c6b4a');
   383	      terrGrad.addColorStop(1, '#16261f');
   384	      terrGradH = H;
   385	    }
   386	    ctx.fillStyle = terrGrad;
   387	    ctx.beginPath();
   388	    ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], H);
   389	    for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
   390	    ctx.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 1][0], H);
   391	    ctx.closePath();
   392	    ctx.fill();
   393	    // crest line
   394	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8fd6a0';
   395	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 2 * (W / 960));
   396	    ctx.beginPath();
   397	    for (i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) { if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); else ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); }
   398	    ctx.stroke();
   399	
   400	    // windward lift band shading (banded fills - cheap, no per-column gradients)
   401	    ctx.fillStyle = '#96e1ff';
   402	    for (i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i += 2) {
   403	      var wx2 = pts[i][2];
   404	      var sl = world.slope(wx2);
   405	      if (sl <= 0.09) continue;
   406	      var band = 70 + 190 * Math.min(1, sl);
   407	      var ghc = world.h(wx2);
   408	      var alpha = Math.min(0.26, (sl - 0.08) * 0.45);
   409	      var wpx = stepPx * 2 + 1;
   410	      for (var bq = 0; bq < 4; bq++) {
   411	        var f0 = bq / 4, f1 = (bq + 1) / 4;
   412	        var yA = sy(ghc + band * f1), yB = sy(ghc + band * f0);
   413	        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * (1 - (f0 + f1) / 2);
   414	        ctx.fillRect(pts[i][0], yA, wpx, yB - yA + 1);
   415	      }
   416	    }
   417	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   418	
   419	    // rising streaks over windward faces
   420	    ctx.save();
   421	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(190,240,255,0.45)';
   422	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.4 * (W / 960));
   423	    var t = tNow;
   424	    for (var px2 = 0; px2 < W; px2 += 46) {
   425	      var wx3 = cam.x + px2 / s;
   426	      var sl2 = world.slope(wx3);
   427	      if (sl2 <= 0.12) continue;
   428	      var bd = 70 + 190 * Math.min(1, sl2);
   429	      var gh = world.h(wx3);
   430	      var ph = ((t * (0.28 + sl2 * 0.3) + px2 * 0.013) % 1);
   450	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,90,0.30)';
   451	      ctx.fillRect(x1, y - 3, x2 - x1, Math.max(3, 5 * s * 0.5 + 3));
   452	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffdc5a';
   453	      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 2 * (W / 960));
   454	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y); ctx.lineTo(x2, y); ctx.stroke();
   455	      // poles + flags
   456	      var ph = Math.max(14, 26 * s * 0.6);
   457	      [x1, x2].forEach(function (px) {
   458	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, y); ctx.lineTo(px, y - ph); ctx.stroke();
   459	        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdc5a';
   460	        ctx.beginPath();
   461	        ctx.moveTo(px, y - ph);
   462	        ctx.lineTo(px + ph * 0.55, y - ph + ph * 0.16);
   463	        ctx.lineTo(px, y - ph + ph * 0.32);
   464	        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   465	      });
   466	      // centre chevron
   467	      var mid = sx(cx);
   468	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,90,0.85)';
   469	      ctx.beginPath();
   470	      ctx.moveTo(mid, y - 4);
   471	      ctx.lineTo(mid - ph * 0.3, y - ph * 0.55);
   472	      ctx.lineTo(mid + ph * 0.3, y - ph * 0.55);
   473	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   474	      // label
   475	      if (x2 - x1 > 60) {
   476	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,190,0.9)';
   477	        ctx.font = Math.round(Math.max(10, 12 * (W / 960))) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   478	        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   479	        ctx.fillText('LZ ' + k, mid, y - ph - 6);
   480	        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   481	      }
   482	    }
   483	  }

   485	  function drawThermals() {
   486	    var s = cam.scale;
   487	    world.thermalsNear(cam.x - 200, cam.x + W / s + 200, tmpTherm);
   488	    for (var i = 0; i < tmpTherm.length; i++) {
   489	      var c = tmpTherm[i];
   490	      var cx = sx(c.x);
   491	      var rp = c.r * s;
   492	      if (cx + rp < -30 || cx - rp > W + 30) continue;
   493	      var yb = sy(c.base), yt = sy(c.top);
   494	      var alpha = 0.05 + Math.min(0.10, c.s * 0.022);
   495	      var grd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, yb, 0, yt);
   496	      grd.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,238,190,' + (alpha * 1.6).toFixed(3) + ')');
   497	      grd.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(255,238,190,' + alpha.toFixed(3) + ')');
   498	      grd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,238,190,0)');
   499	      ctx.fillStyle = grd;
   500	      // wavy column
   501	      ctx.beginPath();
   502	      var segs = 10;
   503	      for (var q = 0; q <= segs; q++) {
   504	        var f = q / segs;
   505	        var yy = yb + (yt - yb) * f;
   506	        var wob = Math.sin(tNow * 1.6 + c.ph + f * 5.0) * rp * 0.13;
   507	        ctx.lineTo(cx - rp * (1 - f * 0.12) + wob, yy);
   508	      }
   509	      for (q = segs; q >= 0; q--) {
   510	        var f2 = q / segs;
   511	        var yy2 = yb + (yt - yb) * f2;
   512	        var wob2 = Math.sin(tNow * 1.6 + c.ph + f2 * 5.0 + 1.7) * rp * 0.13;
   513	        ctx.lineTo(cx + rp * (1 - f2 * 0.12) + wob2, yy2);
   514	      }
   515	      ctx.closePath();
   516	      ctx.fill();
   517	
   518	      // circling birds
   519	      if (rp > 12) {
   520	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(25,30,40,0.75)';
   521	        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.6 * (W / 960));
   522	        for (var b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
   523	          var ang = tNow * 0.9 + c.ph + b * 2.09;
   524	          var bx = cx + Math.cos(ang) * rp * 0.62;
   525	          var alt = c.base + 90 + ((tNow * 22 + b * 130 + c.ph * 60) % Math.max(120, (c.top - c.base - 160)));
   526	          var by = sy(alt);
   527	          if (by < -20 || by > H + 20) continue;
   528	          var sz = Math.max(3, 5 * (W / 960)) * (0.75 + 0.35 * Math.sin(ang));
   529	          ctx.beginPath();
   530	          ctx.moveTo(bx - sz, by);
   531	          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx - sz * 0.5, by - sz * 0.7, bx, by);
   532	          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx + sz * 0.5, by - sz * 0.7, bx + sz, by);
   533	          ctx.stroke();
   534	        }
   535	      }
   536	    }
   537	  }

   539	  function drawParticles() {
   540	    for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
   541	      var p = particles[i];
   542	      var a = p.l / p.m;
   543	      var X = sx(p.x), Y = sy(p.y);
   544	      if (X < -20 || X > W + 20) continue;
   545	      if (p.k === 0) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (a * 0.5).toFixed(3) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(X, Y, 3, 2); }
   546	      else if (p.k === 1) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,170,' + (a * 0.8).toFixed(3) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(X, Y, 3, 3); }
   547	      else { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(210,120,70,' + (a * 0.9).toFixed(3) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(X - 2, Y - 2, 4, 4); }
   548	    }
   549	  }

   551	  function drawGlider() {
   552	    var s = cam.scale;
   553	    var X = sx(g.x), Y = sy(g.y);
   554	    // trail
   555	    if (g.trail.length > 1) {
   556	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
   557	      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.6 * (W / 960));
   558	      ctx.beginPath();
   559	      for (var i = 0; i < g.trail.length; i++) {
   560	        var t = g.trail[i];
   561	        var tx = sx(t.x), ty = sy(t.y);
   562	        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(tx, ty); else ctx.lineTo(tx, ty);
   563	      }
   564	      ctx.stroke();
   565	    }
   566	
   567	    var span = Math.max(20, 11 * s);
   568	    var pitch = g.gam + g.alpha * 0.9;
   569	    ctx.save();
   570	    ctx.translate(X, Y);
   571	    ctx.rotate(-pitch);
   572	    // wing
   573	    var stalled = g.stalled > 0.35;
   574	    var col = stalled ? '#ff7a6b' : '#f2f6ff';
   575	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   576	    ctx.beginPath();
   577	    ctx.moveTo(span * 0.52, 0);
   578	    ctx.lineTo(-span * 0.48, -span * 0.20);
   579	    ctx.lineTo(-span * 0.34, 0);
   580	    ctx.lineTo(-span * 0.48, span * 0.20);
   581	    ctx.closePath();
   582	    ctx.fill();
   583	    ctx.fillStyle = stalled ? '#a63b30' : '#2c6ea8';
   584	    ctx.beginPath();
   585	    ctx.moveTo(span * 0.52, 0);
   586	    ctx.lineTo(-span * 0.48, span * 0.20);
   587	    ctx.lineTo(-span * 0.34, 0);
   588	    ctx.closePath();
   589	    ctx.fill();
   590	    // pilot under the keel
   591	    ctx.fillStyle = '#1b2733';
   592	    ctx.beginPath();
   593	    ctx.ellipse(-span * 0.02 - g.input * span * 0.10, span * 0.16, span * 0.16, span * 0.07, 0, 0, 6.283);
   594	    ctx.fill();
   595	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1b2733';
   596	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, span * 0.03);
   597	    ctx.beginPath();
   598	    ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.lineTo(-g.input * span * 0.10, span * 0.13);
   599	    ctx.stroke();
   600	    ctx.restore();
   601

   101	  World.prototype.thermalsNear = function (x0, x1, out) {
   102	    out.length = 0;
   103	    var a = Math.floor(x0 / CELL) - 1, b = Math.floor(x1 / CELL) + 1;
   104	    for (var i = a; i <= b; i++) {

   110	
   111	  World.prototype.thermalLift = function (x, y) {
   112	    var w = 0;
   113	    var a = Math.floor((x - 500) / CELL), b = Math.floor((x + 500) / CELL);
   114	    for (var i = a; i <= b; i++) {
   115	      var c = this.cell(i);
   116	      if (!c) continue;
   117	      if (y < c.base || y > c.top) continue;
   118	      var d = Math.abs(x - c.x);
   119	      if (d > c.r * 1.9) continue;
   120	      // vertical taper: ramp in at base, fade out under the top
   121	      var vt = Math.min(1, (y - c.base) / 60);
   122	      var tt = Math.min(1, (c.top - y) / 170);
   123	      var env = vt * tt * tt;
   124	      if (d <= c.r) {
   125	        var f = 1 - (d / c.r) * (d / c.r);
   126	        w += c.s * f * env;
   127	      } else {
   128	        var g = (d - c.r) / (c.r * 0.9);
   129	        w -= c.s * 0.34 * (1 - g) * (1 - g) * env;
   130	      }
   131	    }
   132	    return w;
   133	  };
